* Employee stock options

title: Software Engineer - Energy Systems
description:
We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our tech team at KanEL. You'll work on the systems that connect, test, and operate our energy assets - from integrating new battery energy storage solutions (BESS) to ensuring they perform reliably for our partners and customers.


KanEL is an AI-first energy company, where modern tools are part of how we design, operate, and improve our systems. With a small and focused team, we build and operate technology that manages real energy infrastructure.


You will work at the intersection of software, hardware, and energy systems, helping us integrate and operate battery storage and other flexible energy assets in real-world environments.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, integrate, and operate core systems that connect energy assets such as inverters, battery management systems, energy meters, and EV chargers.
* Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot energy system integrations in collaboration with our technology partners.
* Support the installation, commissioning, and testing of new energy systems.
* Identify and resolve technical issues to ensure high reliability and performance of installed systems.
* Work closely with sales, operations, and partners to ensure technical plans are realistic and well executed.
* Use modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted workflows where relevant, to improve diagnostics, documentation, and system performance.

#### **Who We Are Looking For**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience integrating and operating energy systems (inverters, loads, or BESS).
* Experience in field testing, system integration, or commissioning of hardware-based systems.
* Structured, pragmatic, and self-driven with strong problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working close to both hardware and software.
* Curious about new tools and methods, including AI-assisted engineering.
* Good communication skills in Swedish and English.
* Enjoys teamwork and working with external partners.

#### **Stand Out With**

* Experience with large-scale BESS installations or related energy storage technologies.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to diagnose, test, or automate integrations between software and physical energy systems.
* Familiarity with troubleshooting local network issues, including Modbus-based communication.

#### **Location**


Situated near the Slussen subway station in central Stockholm, we value collaboration and face-to-face interactions at the HQ, while also understanding and accommodating the benefits of a hybrid work model.

#### **Why KanEL**


This is the place to be if you're excited about transforming the energy landscape.

* Work with a small, experienced team building real energy infrastructure.
* Large freedom under responsibility.
* The opportunity to work close to both technology development and real-world deployment.
* The chance to grow in a fast-evolving industry.
* Be early and have the opportunity to shape both the company and your own role.
* Employee pension.
* Employee stock options.

title: Information Manager
description:
*Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.*
 Din roll
   

  

 Vill du vara med och skapa struktur, tydlighet och ordning i en växande organisation? Brinner du för att omsätta komplex information till smarta, säkra och användbara lösningar? Då kan du vara den Information Manager vi söker.
   

  

 Som Information Manager ansvarar du för att utveckla, förvalta och kvalitetssäkra vår informationshantering. Du blir en nyckelperson i arbetet med att skapa effektiva informationsflöden, säkra regelefterlevnad och stödja oss i vår tillväxt resa. Rollen är både strategisk och operativ – du växlar mellan att driva långsiktiga initiativ och att stödja verksamheten i det dagliga informationsarbetet.
   

  

 I rollen bidrar du också till utvecklingen av våra arbetssätt och IT-miljöer och säkerställer att verksamheten kan växa på ett tryggt och framtidssäkert sätt. Vår organisation regleras av flera regelverk, inklusive standarder för informationshantering och informationsklassificering (försvarssekretess, företagssekretess, exportkontroll). För att säkerställa efterlevnad använder vi olika IT-verktyg och nätverksmiljöer. En viktig uppgift är att leda organisationen i att inventera och strukturera tillgänglig information för att på ett effektivt sätt bidra i förändringsprojekt med fokus på säker informationshantering.
   

  

 Övergripande arbetsbeskrivning:
   

  

* Du ansvarar för helheten i vår informationshantering och agerar BA:s kontaktpunkt gentemot Saab Group och Surveillance BU:s. Du leder arbetet med att utveckla, strukturera och framtidssäkra informationsmiljön i hela affärsområdet.
* Supporterar och koordinerar med relevanta discipliner så som Informationssäkerhet.
* Du kartlägger informationsflöden och IT-miljöer och skapar förutsättningar för datadrivna arbetssätt, generativ AI och moderna utvecklingsmiljöer.
* Du identifierar förbättringsområden, fångar behov från verksamheten och driver initiativ som stärker informationsstrukturen, säkerheten och våra arbetssätt.
* Du stödjer projekt, program och team med metoder, rådgivning och utbildning inom informationshantering och informationssäkerhet, samt deltar i styrgrupper när det behövs.
* Du representerar BA:t i Process, Methods and Tools Community för Information Management och säkerställer att strategiska riktlinjer omsätts i praktiken.
* Du driver medvetenhet och kommunikation kring informationssäkerhet och informationsflöden för att skapa samsyn och förändringskraft i BA:t.


 Tjänsteort Stockholm, Göteborg eller Linköping.
   

  

 Din profil
   

  

 Vi söker en relationsbyggande ledare med god kommunikationsförmåga. Som person tror vi att du är handlingskraftig, drivs av förändring och förbättring, och sporras av tekniska utmaningar. Du är social och trivs i team, vilket gör att du effektivt kan bygga starka relationer och nätverk inom och utanför verksamheten. Integritet, lyhördhet och respekt för egna och andras expertområden är självklara egenskaper. Du har förmågan att arbeta operativt i detaljer och samtidigt hålla ett strategiskt helhetsperspektiv.
   

  

 Vi tror att du har följande kunskaper och förmågor:
   

  

* Relevant universitetsutbildning inom exempelvis IT, systemvetenskap, information management eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.
* Förståelse för IT-strukturer, systemintegration, databaser och molnlösningar
* Arbetat med informationsarkitektur och informationslivscykelhantering.
* Förmåga att strukturera, klassificera och organisera information
* Kunskap om metadata, taxonomier och ontologier
* Förmåga att se samband i komplexa strukturer och informationsflöden, både på övergripande nivå och i detaljer som påverkar helhetsbilden.
* Arbetat med rutiner för datakvalitet, spårbarhet, regelefterlevnad, riskanalyser och klassificering av information
* Grundläggande kunskap om standarder som ISO27001, ISO9001 och liknande
* Självledarskap och förmåga att organisera eget arbete
* God språkkänsla på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


 Meriterande kvalifikationer:
   

  

* Förståelse för informationsklassificering inom försvarsindustrin.
* Erfarenhet av produktutveckling inom försvarsindustrin.


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper. Passion, nyfikenhet och ett starkt intresse för informationshantering och informationssäkerhet är viktiga drivkrafter i rollen. Din motivation och engagemang för området kan väga lika mycket som formella meriter.
   

  

*Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.*
 Vad du blir en del av
   

  

 Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
   

  

 Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28,000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.
   

  

 Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här
   

  

 Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Do you thrive where business needs, architecture and emerging technology meet? Here, you help shape scalable, compliant IT solutions that support Finance capabilities and contribute to digital transformation across Mining IT.
   

  

**Why Sandvik?**
 You work in a complex, collaborative IT landscape where architecture directly supports business outcomes. This is a chance to combine Finance domain knowledge, ERP experience and curiosity for innovation in a role with broad stakeholder interaction. By joining Sandvik, you get to:
   

  

* Contribute to ERP-centric transformations and initiatives across Finance, Source to Pay and HR.
* Explore new opportunities with AI, automation, advanced analytics and low-code solutions.
* Work closely with business and IT stakeholders to turn requirements into clear, fit-for-purpose solutions.


**About The Job**
 You create, sustain and support high-level solution designs within Finance-led capability areas, while also contributing to Source to Pay and HR domains when needed. You translate business strategies and requirements into robust, scalable and compliant IT solutions aligned with Sandvik Mining target architecture, platform strategies, architectural principles and governance.
   

  

 Job responsibilities

title: Data engineer
description:
*Vill du bidra till att lösa en av vår tids största samhällsutmaningar? Trivs du i en miljö som präglas av handlingskraft och samhällsengagemang?*




 Utbetalningsmyndigheten är en innovativ myndighet under utveckling. Genom att jobba hos oss får du vara med och forma en verksamhet som upptäcker, förhindrar och förebygger välfärdsbrott och felaktiga utbetalningar från statliga myndigheter och kommuner. Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats där du får stort ansvar och mandat att påverka. Hos oss kommer ditt engagemang och din kompetens göra skillnad.
   

  





**Ansvar och arbetsuppgifter**




 Inom Utbetalningsmyndighetenär arbete med data och analys centralt. Nu söker vi dig som vill utöka myndighetens förmåga inom dataintag och dataanalys.
   

  





 I rollen som data engineer kommer du att arbeta med utveckling av it-lösningar med fokus på datahantering, datalagring och dataanalys. Du kommer arbeta i ett tvärfunktionellt utvecklingsteam och samarbeta med olika roller såsom andra data engineers, systemutvecklare, data analytiker och DevOps engineers. I rollen är det huvudsakliga uppdraget att utveckla lösningar för datahantering med direkt verksamhetsvärde. Vi arbetar kontinuerligt med att förbättra och effektivisera våra utvecklingsmiljöer samt utforma interna standarder kring kod och livscykelhantering.
   

  





 Rollen som data engineer är placerad på avdelningen data och utveckling.
   

  





**Vi söker dig som har**




 • Akademisk utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant
   

  





 • Minst tre års aktuell erfarenhet av att arbeta med systemutveckling i Python
   

  





 • Minst tre års erfarenhet av att bygga och underhålla stabila data pipelines i olika miljöer
   

  





 • Goda kunskaper i SQL och arbete med komplexa datamängder
   

  





 • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med öppna källkodslösningar
   

  





 • Vana av kodhantering i GIT och tillhörande arbetsflöden
   

  





 • God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska
   

  





**Det är meriterande om du även har**




 • Erfarenhet av Linux
   

  





 • Erfarenhet av DevOps/MLOps
   

  





 • Erfarenhet av arbete med on-premises system
   

  





 • Erfarenhet av containerbaserade lösningar
   

  





**Efterfrågade förmågor och färdigheter**




 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen har du en analytisk problemlösningsförmåga och god samarbetsförmåga. Vidare är du strukturerad,  initiativtagande och flexibel.
   

  





 Den statliga värdegrunden sammanfattar och synliggör de viktigaste kraven som gäller för statsanställda, att arbeta i staten innebär att följa den. Vi ställer också höga krav på säkerhetsmedvetenhet.
   

  





**Övrigt**




 Myndigheten är placerad i Stockholm i moderna lokaler i närheten av Gullmarsplan. Säkerhetsprövning kan bli aktuellt. Befattningen är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Sex månaders provanställning kan bli aktuellt.
   

  





 På Utbetalningsmyndigheten ska alla medarbetare ha en hållbar arbetsmiljö och balans mellan jobb och fritid. Vi eftersträvar ett nära ledarskap och du som chef har ett rimligt antal medarbetare, administrativt stöd och möjlighet till kompetensutveckling. Vi erbjuder många förmåner för dig som anställd.
   

  





 I denna rekrytering söker du med ditt CV. Istället för att bifoga ett personligt brev vill vi att du svarar på några frågor kring din kompetens kopplat till jobbet. Vi ber dig svara utförligt på dessa frågor. Läs mer om hur rekryteringsprocessen går till här. Arbetspsykologiska tester är en del av urvalsprocessen. Utbetalningsmyndigheten arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se varje persons kompetens och därmed motverka diskriminering.
   

  





**Är du intresserad?**




 Vill du veta mer om tjänsten, kontakta avdelningschef: Niclas Cederberg på telefon 010-572 7576. Vi tar gärna emot samtal från dig som är intresserad av jobbet, men tackar nej till dig som säljer annonser och rekryteringstjänster.
   

  





 Kontaktpersoner för de fackliga organisationerna är Anna Frängsmyr (Saco-S) 010-572 75 78 och Michael Ohlsson (ST) 010-5727512.

title: Senior System Administrator
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla och förvalta en modern IT-miljö i en global organisation? Vi söker nu en
 **Senior Systemadministratör** 
 som vill ta en nyckelroll i ett erfaret IT-team där du får arbeta med affärskritiska system, automation och tekniska förbättringar.
   

  

 I rollen kommer du att ansvara för administration och vidareutveckling av företagets centrala IT-plattformar, med särskilt fokus på Atlassian-produkter som Jira, Jira Service Management och Confluence. Du kommer även att arbeta med integrationer, automatisering och systemförvaltning samt bidra till att säkerställa en stabil, säker och effektiv IT-miljö.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter:**
 Som
 **Senior Systemadministratör** 
 kommer du att spela en nyckelroll i förvaltningen och utvecklingen av företagets interna IT-miljö. Du ansvarar för administration, optimering och vidareutveckling av affärskritiska system med fokus på Atlassian-plattformen. Rollen innebär även ett nära samarbete med den globala IT-organisationen där du bidrar med teknisk expertis, automation och ständiga förbättringar för att säkerställa en stabil, säker och effektiv IT-miljö.
   

  

**Kompetenskrav:**
 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* Minst 5 års erfarenhet som Systemadministratör eller IT-systemadministratör.
* Gedigen erfarenhet av administration av Jira, Jira Service Management och Confluence.
* God erfarenhet av Python för automatisering.
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla och underhålla REST API-integrationer.
* Erfarenhet av att administrera IT-system i större organisationer.
* God förmåga att dokumentera tekniska lösningar och processer.
* Stark problemlösningsförmåga och erfarenhet av felsökning.

**Meriterande:**
* Erfarenhet av Google Workspace och Okta.
* Erfarenhet av AI-plattformar, exempelvis Claude eller OpenAI.

 Humanit handlar om att göra saker lite annorlunda, att på riktigt sätta våra anställda i fokus. Vi växer tillsammans och värdesätter engagemang och ambition. För oss är det viktigt att du får chansen att vara med och påverka vägen framåt.
   

  

 I utbyte erbjuder vi kompetens- och karriärutveckling genom varierande och utmanande uppdrag. Vi är inte branschinriktade och kan därför erbjuda en fantastisk variation bland uppdragen för dig som konsult. Självklart ser vi till att du får rätt utbildning och vi är väl medvetna om att det är det livslånga lärandet som bygger vår framgång.
   

  

 Tillsammans skapar vi framtiden 🚀
   

  

* Tillsvidareanställning med fast månadslön

 : Omgående med hänsyn till uppsägningstid och när säkerhetskontroll är genomförd. Uppdraget är på heltid och är tillsvidare.

 : Stockholm (Onsite)

title: Datacenter Technician (Level III)
description:
**Who are we?**
 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
   

  

 A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
   

  

 Joining our operations team means being at the center of everything – maintaining and evolving critical infrastructure that powers the digital world and delivers real impact for our customers, communities and society. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Summary
   

  

 Equinix is the world’s leading digital infrastructure company, operating 270+ data centers across six continents. We provide secure, reliable, and sustainable interconnection services that power the digital economy.
   

  

 Our business is built on high security, high availability (99.9999%), and a commitment to operational excellence. As the industry experiences unprecedented growth, we continue to deliver simple, sustainable, and secure solutions for our customers worldwide.
   

  

 At Equinix, we care about our people. Our comprehensive benefits include:
   

  

* Competitive health and wellness programs
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Career development and growth opportunities
* Fun, wellbeing, and charity events


 Advance Your Career Quickly – Positions Open Across the Globe
   

  

 Joining Equinix means joining a global network of opportunities. Whether you want to grow into leadership roles or specialize in advanced technical areas, we provide the platform for your success.
   

  

 What We’re Looking For
   

  

 We’re seeking a Datacenter Technician (Level III) with previous experience in data center operations. This is not an entry-level role;
   

  

**Key Skills & Experience**
* Previous experience in data center operations
* Proven ability to prioritize tasks, manage escalations, and lead a team during critical situations
* Hands-on experience with data center buildouts, equipment assembly, and installation
* Knowledge of connectivity technologies, especially fiber optics, structured cabling, and cross-connects
* Experience using fiber testing equipment
* Solid understanding of IT systems, hardware troubleshooting, and network basics
* Familiarity with Change, Incident, and Escalation Management processes
* Ability to work in a shift-based environment, including on-call rotation and after-hours support
* Excellent time management, organizational, and communication skills
* Knowledge of critical infrastructure (power and cooling systems) is a plus, but not mandatory


**Responsibilities**
 Hands-on Customer Support
   

  

* Handle customer installations and troubleshooting, including fiber cross-connects and testing
* Perform advanced diagnostics and repairs on hardware and network equipment
* Manage internal and external tickets (including Smart Hands requests) in line with SLAs


 Leadership & Operational Excellence
   

  

* Lead escalations for incidents, coordinating resolution efforts across teams
* Deliver clear shift handovers and comprehensive operational status reports
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance processes and operational excellence
* Develop documentation and operational processes to standardize best practices


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Monitor infrastructure alarms (power, cooling, temperature, humidity) to maintain stable operations
* Oversee contractors, ensuring compliance with safety, cleanliness, and operational standards
* Occasional travel to other data centers for project support or escalations


**Qualifications**
* Experience in data center operations
* Expertise in hardware troubleshooting and hands-on data center work
* Ability to work in 24/7 shift rotation
* Background in IT or Telecommunications
* Strong problem-solving, multitasking, and communication skills
* Fluent in English (Swedish is a plus)


 Ready to take the next step? Apply now and become part of the team that keeps the digital world running!
   

  

 Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.
   

  

 Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
Are you curious about taking the next step into network security? Do you enjoy working with networks, security and protecting critical infrastructure tomorrow? Then this might be your next move.
   

  

 As a Network Security Engineer, you will join an international team that safeguards Vattenfall’s networks and supports our journey towards a smarter, more secure energy system.
   

  

**Your role**
 In this role, you will gradually grow into network security by working hands‑on with experienced colleagues and modern security platforms. Together, we operate and develop secure network solutions across offices, data centres and wide‑area networks.
   

  

**You Will**
* Work with the operation, development and maintenance of network security infrastructure
* Support secure connectivity across LAN, WiFi, WAN and data centre networks
* Learn how we protect Vattenfall’s networks using tools such as firewalls, proxies and intrusion prevention
* Contribute to security assessments and improvements in new and existing projects
* Collaborate closely with network, infrastructure and security teams across countries


 This role is designed to help you transition into network security, step by step, while building on what you already know.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Your profile**
 You have a solid networking foundation, combined with an experience in security.
   

  

**We Believe You Bring**
* Solid experience in network, infrastructure and security technology
* Swedish and good English, both spoken and written
* Working knowledge of routing & switching (e.g. CCNA level)
* Experience with infrastructure security technology
* The ability to work in a structured and careful way, even when things get complex
* Good communication skills and enjoyment of working together with others


**Technologies You Will Work With**
* Firewalls and network security platforms (e.g. Cisco, FortiGate, Check Point)
* Web proxy and secure internet access solutions
* IDS / IPS technologies
* Working together with Security, Network monitoring and management tools
* WAN, LAN and wireless environments
* ITIL‑based operational processes
* Basic scripting or automation (nice to explore over time)


 On‑call duty is part of the role and will be introduced gradually with proper support.
   

  

 Location & way of working
   

  

* Based at our Solna office next to Arenastaden or - in any Vattenfall IT country for Swedish speakers.
* Hybrid working model (not fully remote)
* Occasional travel for team or project meetings (on average once per month)


 Additional Information
   

  

 At Vattenfall, we are convinced that striving for diversity helps building a more profitable efficient and attractive company. Therefore we seek a harmonious balance of employees in terms of gender, age, and ethnic and cultural backgrounds. We believe in work life balance and the flexibility to work from home.
   

  

**For more information** 
 about the position you are welcome to contact IT Recruiter Marta Jura via marta.jura@vattenfall.com
   

  

**Company Description**
 Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 20 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are now taking steps to make fossil-free living possible within one generation. To be able to reach this ambitious goal we are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

title: Senior IT Operations Engineer
description:
**About 0TO9**
 0TO9 is a bank for entrepreneurship, built by and for financial innovators. We provide infrastructure for entrepreneurs ready to start and scale the next generation of financial products and platforms. Founded in 2025, we're already 75+ co-workers across Europe, and growing fast. Our name reflects our mission: from zero to success, from idea to impact, from now to what's next.
   

  

****The Role****
 We're looking for a Senior IT Operations Engineer who enables our organization to grow. You'll be part of a team that delivers IT and cybersecurity to the companies in our portfolio, supporting them whether they're onboarding a new team, setting up a new office, or choosing the right tools.
   

  

 This is a senior role with real strategic weight. You'll shape how we make forward-looking IT decisions on integrations, platforms and tooling, drive the development of our IT operations, and help us navigate technology choices as we scale. At the same time, you're not afraid to get your hands dirty, when a new office needs screens, conference systems and a printer up and running, you're happy to make it happen. You take ownership, drive work forward independently, and work closely with the rest of the team on IT processes, security and regulatory work like GDPR and DORA.
   

  

****What you'll do****
* Own IT operations for both central IT and our portfolio companies as they grow, from day-to-day support to being their long-term IT partner as their needs mature.
* Deliver hands-on IT setup and support to our portfolio companies: onboarding, tooling, office setup, meeting and conference systems.
* Drive a methodical, consolidated approach to software licenses, how we buy, manage and follow up on them, and manage the vendor relationships behind our IT portfolio.
* Make sure the services we buy actually deliver on our contracts, requirements and expectations.
* Be part of the team responsible for IT and cybersecurity, working hands-on with technical support and integrations and bringing a senior perspective.
* Build the operating model for how we scale IT support to new portfolio companies as we grow today it might be five companies, tomorrow twenty.


****Who you are****
* A senior IT operations profile with broad, hands-on experience, comfortable being third-line support one moment and a strategic sparring partner the next.
* Experienced with Google Workspace and at least one major cloud platform (AWS or GCP).
* Structured and methodical in IT administration: licenses, vendors, agreements, follow-up.
* A relationship builder who enjoys being the face of IT toward colleagues and portfolio companies, proactive, approachable and service-minded.
* Project-oriented and self-driven, you can run initiatives end to end, but you're a doer at heart, not a pure project manager.
* Comfortable in a fast-growing environment where things change quickly and no task is too big or too small.


****Bonus points****
* Experience with cybersecurity operations, endpoint monitoring (e.g. CrowdStrike), code scanning, or guiding developers on secure practices.
* A background close to development or IT product management, giving you an eye for how technical decisions play out over time.


****Why 0TO9?****
* Shape a role and a function that's being built from the ground up.
* Real ownership from day one, no layers, no bureaucracy.
* Work directly with the companies in our portfolio and see your work enable their growth.
* Grow with us as we scale across Europe.


 Find out more at 0to9.com, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior IT Engineer - Device Management
description:
**About Wolt**
 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
   

  

 Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
   

  

 The Client Platform Engineering team is responsible for configuration, management and automation of macOS, iOS, Windows, ChromeOS and Android endpoints to help DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt employees and merchants do their best work. CPE is a global team with members in the United States and Europe.
   

  

 What you’ll be doing
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior IT Engineer - Device Management who values responsibility and accountability for the management of corporate and merchant endpoints globally. Our growing environment is predominantly macOS (corporate) and Android (merchant) but includes a mix of other operating systems. You will report to the Manager, Client Platform Engineering on our Corporate Infrastructure team in the Global IT organization.
   

  

**Day-to-day in this role you’ll:**
* Support timely, technical solutions to scale endpoint management
* Look for opportunities for automation to mitigate manual processes
* Manage Android and iPadOS tablets in the merchant fleet
* Manage macOS and ChromeOS laptops in the corporate fleet
* Stay current with industry trends and best practices
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to develop processes and ideas


 Our humble expectations
   

  

* You have 3+ years experience administering an Enterprise MDM/EMM/UEM platform (Mosyle, Intune, MaaS360, Workspace ONE, SimpleMDM, etc.)
* You have 3+ years experience managing large-scale Android and/or iPadOS deployments
* You have 3+ years experience managing macOS, preferably with the following tools: Munki, AutoPkg, Santa, osquery
* You have 3+ years experience in one or more of the following programming languages: Bash, Python, Swift, GoLang
* You have experience using CI/CD for client engineering processes
* You have experience utilizing APIs for automation


 Nice to haves
   

  

* 
+ You have experience managing ChromeOS, Windows and Linux endpoints
+ You have rolled out or managed a mobile BYOD program (Apple User Enrollment / Android Work Profile)
+ You have experience deploying and managing Conditional Access / Device Trust policies and integrations (Okta / Google)
+ You have experience with configuration/infrastructure as code
+ You enjoy working with open source tools and contributing back to the community
+ You have experience working on a remote team spanning multiple time zones and continents


 Why you’ll love working at Wolt
   

  

 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in 1000+ cities in over 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
   

  

 Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
   

  

 Next steps
   

  

 All applications are reviewed by a real human, so please be patient. Qualified candidates will have the opportunity to speak with a member of our recruiting team before moving on to talk with the hiring manager. This is a highly technical role so the next step will be a live scripting/coding interview, followed by chats with members of the team and cross-functional partners.

 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

title: Azure Network Engineer
description:
Vill du utvecklas inom moderna hybridnätverk där Azure och on-prem möts? Vi söker dig som vill ta nästa steg inom nätverk och arbeta med drift, utveckling och förbättring av vår nätverks infrastruktur i en modern hybrid miljö.
   

  

**Ditt team**
 Du blir en del av ett team som består av 14 personer där arbetet leds av en team coach. Teamet arbetar med att utveckla och förvalta nätverkslösningar i en hybrid miljö där Azure och on-prem möts. Teamets uppdrag är att säkerställa en stabil, säker och modern nätverks infrastruktur som stödjer verksamhetens behov, både idag och framåt.
   

  

 I teamet arbetar ni med Azure-nätverk, DNS, brandväggar och modern infrastruktur, där Infrastructure as Code är en naturlig del av arbetet. Ni har en central roll i att möjliggöra nya tjänster och säkerställa att plattformen fungerar effektivt och säkert.
   

  

 Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med andra nätverksteam, Azureteam och olika delar av verksamheten. Det innebär en varierad vardag med både operativa uppgifter och utvecklingsinitiativ, samt goda möjligheter att bygga ett brett kontaktnät.
   

  

 Teamet präglas av en öppen och familjär kultur där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och ett prestigelöst arbetssätt står i fokus.
   

  

**Din roll**
 I denna roll arbetar du som Azure Network Engineer i en hybrid miljö där molnbaserade och traditionella nätverkslösningar integreras. Du arbetar operativt med nätverk i Azure, deltar i beredskap samt bidrar i projekt inom nätverk och infrastruktur.
   

  

 Du blir en del av en familjär och öppen miljö där vi värdesätter självgående personer och ett öppet mindset.
   

  

 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:
   

  

* Arbeta operativt med drift och utveckling av Azure-nätverk
* Delta i projekt och förändringsarbete kopplat till nätverk och infrastruktur
* Delta i beredskap för Azure-nätverksmiljön
* Felsöka, analysera och förbättra nätverkslösningar
* Samarbeta med andra team inom nätverk, Azure och verksamheten


**Din profil**
 Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och vill utvecklas inom nätverk i en modern hybrid miljö. Du trivs med att samarbeta med andra, men tar också eget ansvar och driver ditt arbete framåt. Vi ser positivt på att du är i början av din resa inom området och vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss.
   

  

 Du har med dig en grund inom nätverk, antingen genom utbildning eller arbetslivserfarenhet, och ett intresse för Azure och molnbaserade lösningar. För dig är det naturligt att vilja förstå hur saker hänger ihop och att löpande bygga på din kompetens. Vi ser gärna att det finns intresse av traditionella nätverkslösningar.
   

  

 Du känner igen dig i delar av följande:
   

  

* Intresse för eller viss erfarenhet av Azure-nätverk och hybridlösningar
* Grundläggande förståelse för nätverk, till exempel DNS och brandväggar
* Erfarenhet av eller utbildning inom nätverk (Azure eller on-prem)
* Intresse för att arbeta med Infrastructure as Code
* Förmåga att ta ansvar och arbeta självständigt i en operativ miljö
* En vilja att samarbeta och dela kunskap med andra


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av arbete i projekt eller driftmiljöer med fokus på nätverk. Har du dessutom tidigare arbetat i hybridmiljöer där moln och on-prem samverkar ser vi det som en fördel.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.
   

  

 Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handelsbanken.

title: Lead Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

 We’re looking for a Lead Platform Engineer
 
 to take ownership of our Kubernetes-based multi-cluster internal developer platform that powers mission-critical microservices across the organization.
   

  





 This role is equal parts technical leadership, hands-on engineering, product thinking
 **,** 
 and communication. You will shape the direction of the platform as a product, obsess over developer experience, and ensure the platform is intuitive, reliable, and well-documented.
   

  





 You will work closely with product teams, architects, and engineering managers to evolve our platform into a highly automated, self-service ecosystem that accelerates developer productivity and enables secure, seamless deployments at scale.
   

  





 Our technical stack includes Azure Kubernetes Service, Envoy Gateway, Opentelemetry Operator, LGTM Stack, Crossplane, KEDA, Cert Manager, External DNS, Kyverno, External Secrets Operator, Argo CD, Helm, Bicep, Github Actions.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**



* Own the technical direction of our Kubernetes platform with a strong focus on developer experience and operational excellence.
* Treat the platform as a product. This involves gathering feedback, identifying friction, and continuously improving workflows and interfaces.
* Design, build, and operate cloud-native infrastructure with an everything-as-code mindset.
* Write production-quality code (Bash, YAML, Bicep, Github Actions) - this is a hands-on engineering role.
* Drive complex features and refactoring efforts across provisioning, deployments, observability, and cluster lifecycle management.
* Partner closely with product teams to understand real workflows and deliver a frictionless self-service experience.
* Mentor engineers through collaboration and example, fostering a culture of curiosity, ownership, and learning.
* Raise the bar on maintainability and engineering craftsmanship through strong attention to detail.



  

  





**WHO YOU ARE:**



* 5+ experience in platform engineering, SRE, or application engineering roles.
* Deep expertise in Kubernetes, containers, and the cloud-native ecosystem.
* A builder mindset - you write and ship code regularly.
* Excellent technical writing skills.
* Experience operating in public cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) with modern IaC and GitOps tooling.
* Proven track record improving developer workflows, self-service capabilities, or internal platforms.
* Understanding of networking (TLS, DNS, HTTP, GRPC, proxies).
* Experience with modern observability practices and tooling (instrumentation, metrics, logs, tracing, profiling).
* Pragmatic, collaborative, and humble approach to technical leadership.
* High attention to detail and a bias for architectural simplicity and clarity.



  

  





**WHY JOIN US**



* **Make a real impact** 
 - you’ll have significant influence over the direction of the platform and shape how platform engineering works across the company.
* **Platform at the center of transformation** 
 - as the organization continues its transition to microservices, the platform sits at pole position, with rapid growth and growing strategic importance.
* **Modern, cloud-native stack** 
 - we invest in staying current with the cloud-native ecosystem and evolving our architecture accordingly.
* **Ideas matter here** 
 - we value curiosity, experimentation, and thoughtful innovation, and give engineers space to turn ideas into reality.
* **Supportive, low-ego culture** 
 - you’ll work with collaborative teammates who care about helping each other succeed and building great things together.


**Additional Information**

***Please note***
 : As our culture and teamwork are very important to us, four days (80%) per week of in-office presence in our office are required.
   

  





 This is a full-time position with placement in
 **Stockholm** 
 .
   

  





  

  





**WHO WE ARE:**
  

 Shaping the future of fashion with people, data, and tech. The fashion and retail industries are going through a transformation, driven by customers' technology and sustainability expectations. At H&M Group, we want to shape the future of fashion and lifestyle by harnessing the power of smart tech and data. With our 74-year history of innovation, we understand the need to collaborate and co-create with engineers and tech specialists around the world to achieve our vision.
   

  





  

  





**WHAT WE OFFER!** 
  

  

 You are joining a unique value-driven culture, a large tech network and community where you can be yourself. Besides the obvious perks such as staff discount card, flexible work life, learning communities, wellness benefits, parental benefits etc. There are endless opportunities to experiment and grow in any direction that you want, and when you grow, we grow. Being a major player gives us countless opportunities to make a real impact and shape the future.

title: Go-to-Market Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Netigate is a leading European Experience Management (XM) company, helping organizations turn insights into growth by understanding and acting on the experiences of their customers and employees.
   

  

 Headquartered in Stockholm with offices across Europe in Helsinki, Frankfurt and Rotterdam, Netigate serves more than 1,500 clients globally, including Erste Group, KLM/Air France and Apoteket. We are ~130 employees across the Nordic countries in Helsinki, Oslo and Stockholm and in the rest of Europe in Frankfurt, Berlin, Rotterdam, London and Paris.
   

  

 Following the recent merger with the Dutch digital experience platform Mopinion, Netigate now delivers a unique end-to-end platform for experience management - covering every touchpoint across web, mobile, and employee journeys.
   

  

****Your Role at a Glance****
 As a Go-to-Market Engineer you will build the systems that turn buyer intent into pipeline.
   

  

 Our revenue teams are evolving how we generate, qualify, and convert opportunities - and the technical setup needs to move just as fast. That means strong Salesforce architecture, clean data flows, smart automation, AI-powered workflows, and reliable integrations across the go-to-market stack. This role sits at the intersection of Revenue Operations, Growth, Sales, Marketing, Data, and AI. Working closely with the Head of Revenue Operations and the Growth Management team, the mission is to identify friction across the funnel and engineer it away.
   

  

 Salesforce is being restructured to support more advanced automation and AI use cases. This role will help land that foundation, keep it scalable, and build the systems that allow our teams to act faster, smarter, and with less manual effort.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role based in Stockholm, with 2–3 days per week in the office.
   

  

****Your Key Responsibilities****
* Build and continuously improve the technical foundation behind Netigate’s go-to-market engine, with Salesforce at the centre of the revenue tech stack.
* Shape Salesforce data models, objects, workflows, validation rules, deduplication logic, and automation standards that can scale with the business.
* Support the ongoing Salesforce restructuring and turn it into a reliable base for AI, enrichment, routing, reporting, and sales execution.
* Create lead detection, scoring, routing, and qualification systems that help sales teams respond to high-intent leads faster.
* Automate the path from buyer signal to sales action, ensuring the right lead reaches the right person at the right moment.
* Build enrichment workflows that transform raw contact, company, and account data into actionable sales intelligence.
* Connect buying signals such as job changes, funding announcements, product usage, company news, and account activity to automated go-to-market workflows.
* Design and operate AI workflows and agents for qualification, account research, outbound, follow-up, and pipeline generation.
* Integrate tools across the revenue stack using APIs, SQL, automation platforms, and light coding.
* Monitor automation performance, build error handling into workflows, and remove systems that no longer create measurable value.
* Stay close to emerging AI, automation, and GTM technology to continuously improve how Netigate generates and converts pipeline.


****Your Profile****
* Experience building go-to-market, revenue operations, growth, or sales automation systems in a fast-growing B2B SaaS company.
* Deep Salesforce expertise, including hands-on experience designing data models, automations, integrations, and scalable revenue architecture.
* Strong understanding of what a clean, reliable, and future-proof Salesforce setup needs to look like.
* Practical experience with AI tools and LLM-based workflows, including Claude, Claude Code, or comparable platforms.
* Familiarity with GTM automation, enrichment, and outbound tools such as Clay, Smartlead, HeyReach, or similar solutions.
* Confident working with SQL and able to connect systems through APIs.
* Coding ability in Python, Node.js, or a similar language, with the confidence to build integrations and automate processes independently.
* Strong understanding of how data moves between systems and how revenue teams use that data to prioritize action.
* Track record of building systems that improved speed, conversion, data quality, pipeline generation, or sales productivity.
* Ability to translate operational friction into technical solutions and move from idea to implementation quickly.


 Nice to have:
   

  

* Experience building AI agents or LLM workflows for lead scoring, account research, qualification, signal extraction, or outbound automation.
* Knowledge of cold email deliverability, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, mailbox setup, and sequencer configuration.
* Background in vertical SaaS, enterprise SaaS, or complex B2B sales environments.
* Experience supporting go-to-market teams across multiple European markets or product lines.


****What you can expect****
* A scaling international company with a strong AI first focus agenda.
* An inclusive and supportive work environment where diversity and creativity are celebrated.
* An environment where your ideas are valued, and you have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution from the start.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement within an international growing company.
* No matter your role, whether you're just starting out or in a leadership position, we focus on the value you bring to the table. Creativity and impact are what matter most.
* We believe in celebrating our achievements. Wether it's a summer festival or New Year party: we make sure to enjoy our successes and build strong team connections.


**Our Culture**
 At the heart of Netigate lies the
 **NetiMaker mindset** 
 - our foundation for how we work and grow together. Being a NetiMaker means taking ownership, staying curious, holding ourselves accountable, and driving progress with purpose.
   

  

 We believe that a great employee experience is the foundation of a great customer experience - and this belief shapes everything we do.
   

  

 At Netigate, we pride ourselves on our collaborative, imaginative, and learning-focused culture. We believe in the collective strength of diverse perspectives - the
 *power of WE* 
 . Together, we create an atmosphere where fresh ideas are shared, challenges are embraced, and individual growth is encouraged.
   

  

**We encourage all applicants to consider submitting an anonymous CV as part of our commitment to fostering a non-discriminatory and inclusive recruitment process. In line with this, we aim to ensure transparency around compensation and will share indicative salary ranges during the initial conversation.**

title: SharePoint- och informationsspecialist för framtidens flygplatser
description:
Brinner du för struktur, informationsordning och smarta digitala arbetssätt? Vill du använda din expertis inom SharePoint och Microsoft 365 för att skapa trygghet, tydlighet och verklig nytta i en komplex verksamhet? Då kan det här vara rollen där både ditt driv och din kompetens får ta plats.
   

  

**Vad innebär rollen?**
 Du är en nyckelperson i hur information hanteras, skyddas och används inom Swedavia. I gränslandet mellan IT, verksamhet och styrning ser du till att rätt information finns på rätt plats. Samtidigt arbetar du med ordning och reda utan att hämma produktiviteten, och bidrar till smartare, säkrare och mer effektiva arbetssätt i en samhällsviktig organisation.
   

  

 Du har ett operativt ansvar för samverkan med Service Delivery Manager och förvaltningsledare för slutanvändartjänster, och fungerar som en sammanhållande kraft mellan verksamhetens behov och tekniska möjligheter.

* Koordinerar kravställning och förändringsarbete tillsammans med relevanta intressenter såsom Data Governance, DPO, Cyber- och Corporate Security samt IT-leverantörer i linje med verksamhetens behov och tekniska utveckling.

* Arbetar nära både IT och operativ verksamhet, där behoven varierar och rollen blir både omväxlande och kreativ

 Vi ser att du har:
   

  

* Akademisk utbildning inom IT eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
* Erfarenhet av SharePoint och Microsoft 365 i större organisationer

* Erfarenhet av att utveckla och implementera styrande principer för informationshantering och regelefterlevnad

 In Sweden we work with more than 50 companies who are leaders in their own space. With them we have long term and trustful relationships. TCS in Sweden and Nordics has been ranked as a Top Employer for 12 consecutive years that reflects the organization’s commitment to an inclusive, empowered and entrepreneurial work culture.
 



  





**About the Role**




  





 Do you want to turn AI ideas into working, scalable solutions?
 



 We are looking for an AI Engineer who enjoys building, testing, and deploying intelligent systems in fast‑moving environments. In this role, you will work hands‑on with data, models, and platforms to deliver AI solutions that are production‑ready and demonstrable working closely with architects, customers, and rapid engineering teams.
 



 If you are passionate about engineering AI systems that actually work in real‑world settings, we invite you to join us.
 



  





**Your Role & Impact**




  





 Are you an engineer who thrives on turning concepts into working AI solutions? Do you enjoy rapid experimentation, customer‑facing demos, and collaborating with architects and partners?
 



 As an AI / ML Engineer, you will focus on the engineering and implementation of AI/ML solutions. You will help design and build end‑to‑end AI components, develop models and pipelines, and bring architectures to life through rapid demos and proofs of value. Your work will directly influence solution quality, performance, and delivery speed.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





 In this role, you will:
 


* Build and implement end‑to‑end AI/ML solutions, translating architectural designs into working systems
* Develop, train, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for real‑world use cases
* Support and participate in customer presentations and demos, explaining technical choices and outcomes
* Explore and apply new AI/ML solution paradigms from the market, including emerging tools and frameworks
* Collaborate with strategic partners to integrate platforms, APIs, and services into AI solutions
* Drive rapid demos and proofs of value together with the Rapid Engineering team.
* Contribute to improving engineering practices, code quality, and reproducibility of AI solutions



  





**What Makes You the Ideal Candidate**




  





 You combine solid software engineering skills with hands‑on experience in AI/ML. You enjoy learning new technologies and are comfortable working in environments where speed, quality, and collaboration matter.
 



 In addition, you bring:
 


* Experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions in practical environments
* Strong understanding of machine learning concepts, data pipelines, and model lifecycle
* Hands‑on programming skills and the ability to work with modern AI frameworks including Vibe Coding tools.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate with architects, engineers, and customers
* A proactive mindset with a focus on learning and continuous improvement
* Technology Stack:
 
 You do not need experience with all technologies listed below. A broad understanding of below technologies with deeper expertise in few areas will be ideal.
* Programming & Frameworks: Python, ML libraries, deep learning frameworks
* AI / ML Platforms: Managed ML services, generative AI platforms, open‑source model ecosystems
* Data & Pipelines: Feature engineering tools, data processing frameworks, batch and streaming pipelines
* MLOps: Model training, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and experimentation tooling
* RAG & Agentic Components: Vector databases, embeddings, orchestration frameworks
* Cloud & Runtime: Cloud‑native deployments, containers, scalable inference services
* DevOps & Engineering: CI/CD pipelines, source control, automated testing
* Vibe Coding Platforms and Tools. E.g. Google AI Studio, Anti Gravity, etc.



  





**What We Offer**




  





 We offer you the opportunity to join an environment where excellence in AI engineering and continual innovation are valued and encouraged. You'll be part of small, specialized teams dedicated to pushing the boundaries of advanced AI technologies and solutions.
 



 As a member of our team, you will have the autonomy and support to establish yourself as a technical authority in AI.
 



 You will work with stateoftheart AI technologies and frameworks, gaining handson experience with the latest tools and methodologies in the field.
 



 We provide competitive compensation and highly attractive employment conditions designed to recognize your contributions and support your professional growth.
 



 You will enjoy flexible work arrangements, including the possibility to work from Stockholm or Amsterdam, and be part of a vibrant, international team that values diverse perspectives.
 



  





**Ready to Build and Ship AI?**




  





 If you are motivated to engineer AI solutions, experiment rapidly, and see your work used in real environments, we invite you to apply and grow with us.

title: AI Enablement Lead
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 FDJ UNITED operates in igaming under strict regulatory oversight. Security and governance are not optional extras here — they are the baseline.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 FDJ United is hiring an
 **AI Enablement Lead** 
 to drive
 **enterprise AI transformation** 
 across our Tech function of 1,000+ people, based in South Wimbledon, London. This is a rare opportunity for a
 **Technical AI Coach** 
 or
 **AI Adoption Lead** 
 who has spent years building production systems and now wants to make entire engineering organisations better at doing the same.
 



 This is not a lecture-based training role. As our
 **AI Enablement Lead** 
 , you will be hands-on — coaching engineers, running live workshops, and embedding governance and security into every AI use case from day one. You will define what good looks like for
 **enterprise AI enablement** 
 in a regulated
 **iGaming** 
 environment.
 



 If you are an experienced
 **AI Implementation Lead** 
 or
 **AI Transformation Lead** 
 who thrives in fast-paced, high-stakes environments and has a strong instinct for teaching rather than doing, this role is for you.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





**Technical Coaching & Upskilling** 



* Design and deliver hands-on technical workshops for Tech teams as a
 **Technical AI Coach** 
 — the kind where participants build and ship working
 **AI agents** 
 themselves, not watch someone else do it
* Coach engineers and domain experts through identifying real use cases in their function, scoping them rigorously, and building their first working solutions on KAIT — your success is measured by what they can do independently
* Run structured
 **AI opportunity audits** 
 within Tech teams: helping teams assess which use cases are quick wins, which need Architect-level guidance, and which are not worth pursuing
* Create technical training content covering
 **RAG pipelines** 
 ,
 **AI agent design** 
 ,
 **prompt engineering** 
 , and
 **API integration** 
 — written for a Tech audience, grounded in real OBG scenarios
* Provide floor support during workshop sessions, including live debugging and troubleshooting — guiding participants through solving problems, not solving for them



 #AIAgentDesign #RAGPipeline #PromptEngineering #AIWorkshopFacilitator #TechnicalAICoach #APIIntegration
 



  





**Governance, Security & Process** 



* As an
 **Enterprise AI Enablement** 
 specialist, ensure security, data governance, and compliance are embedded into every use case from the start — not treated as a gate at the end
* Train teams to think about data classification, human oversight, and audit requirements as part of their design process — core to any
 **regulated industry AI** 
 role
* Upskill teams on OBG's Technology Release Process so they can self-serve: preparing documentation, completing governance checklists, and meeting production standards
* Identify gaps in existing processes, documentation, or governance frameworks and work with A&I and platform teams to close those gaps through training and upskilling



 #AIGovernance #DataGovernance #AICompliance #EnterpriseAISecurity #RegulatedIndustryAI
 



  





**Use Case Pipeline & Enablement at Scale** 



* Coach Tech Innovators through the full lifecycle as an
 **AI Adoption Lead** 
 : from identifying where AI adds genuine value, through scoping and prototyping, to handing off complex builds for Architect-level support
* For high-complexity use cases (
 **multi-system integrations** 
 ,
 **MCP connectors** 
 ,
 **RAG pipelines** 
 ), guide and upskill teams responsible for delivery — your role as an
 **AI Transformation Lead** 
 is to transfer capability, not accumulate it
* Assess incoming use cases and route them correctly: straightforward
 **AI agent** 
 builds, strategic projects needing deeper support, and cases that belong in data science or other disciplines



 #MCPModelContextProtocol #RAGPipelineEngineer #EnterpriseAITransformation #AIAgentDeveloper #AIScaleEnablement
 



  





**Developer Productivity (Secondary — ~20% of Time)** 



* Deliver structured workshops and a best-practice guide for
 **coding assistant adoption** 
 (e.g.
 **GitHub Copilot** 
 ,
 **Cursor** 
 ) across engineering teams
* Engineering team leads retain accountability for sustained adoption in their teams
* This is a secondary workstream — deprioritised if the main
 **AI enablement** 
 pipeline requires full capacity



 #GitHubCopilot #CodingAssistant #DeveloperProductivity #CursorAI #CodingAssistantAdoption
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Essential** 



* 4–7 years in a hands-on technical role — data engineering, AI/ML engineering, solutions architecture, or DevOps — with a subsequent move into enablement, consultancy, or internal transformation.
* Proven experience coaching technical teams to build and deploy AI agents or RAG pipelines in production — not just building them yourself.
* Hands-on with at least one low-code/no-code automation platform (e.g. n8n) — enough to credibly train others.

 #PromptEngineeringLead #n8nAutomation #LowCodeNoCode #DataEngineering #AIMLEngineering #SolutionsArchitecture #DevOps #APIIntegrationSpecialist
 



  





**Highly Desirable** 



* Experience in a regulated industry: igaming, fintech, or financial services.
* Hands-on n8n experience for production workflow automation.
* Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar frameworks for connecting AI agents to enterprise systems.

title: Affärs och IT kontinuitetsansvarig
description:
*Brinner du för att få människor, processer och teknik att samverka för att stå emot störningar? Hos oss får du en central roll där du driver affärs- och IT‑kontinuitet med tydligt mandat, hög synlighet och möjlighet att bygga verklig resiliens i en samhällsviktig verksamhet. Hjärtligt välkommen till Skandia!* 
 💚
   

  

**Att jobba inom säkerhet med ansvar affärs och IT kontinuitet**
 Som Affärs- och IT kontinuitetsansvarig på Skandia ansvarar du för att säkerställa att kritiska IT‑tjänster och affärsprocesser kan upprätthållas eller snabbt återställas vid störningar. Fokus ligger på att bygga robusta lösningar, förebyggande beredskap och en hög motståndskraft mot incidenter, cyberangrepp och tekniska avbrott.
   

  

 I rollen ingår bland annat;
   

  

* Att leda det strategiska och taktiska arbetet för affärs- och IT kontinuitetshantering. (Det operativa arbetet sker mestadels ute i verksamheten samt internt på IT).
* Att ansvara för att sätta styrning, följa upp och rapportera till ledning och andra intressenter.
* Att ansvara för att säkerställa att arbetssätt, processer och kontroller håller hög kvalitet och utvecklas i takt med verksamhetens behov.
* Att leda arbetet gällande kravställning och uppföljning av tredjeparts/outsourcad IT utifrån affärs- och IT kontinuitetsperspektivet.


 I ett omvärldsläge präglat av ökad digitalisering, cyberhot och beroenden av IT är rollen avgörande för att skydda verksamhetens stabilitet, kundernas förtroende och bolagets långsiktiga förmåga att leverera.
   

  

 I denna roll rapporterar du till Stabssäkerhetschefen som i sin tur rapporterar till Chef för koncernsäkerhet.
   

  

**För att lyckas i rollen**
 Vi söker dig som har;
   

  

* Relevant akademisk utbildning
* God erfarenhet av affärskontinuitetshantering, och IT Kontinuitet
* Erfarenhet att tolka regelverkskrav och kunna på ett pragmatiskt sätt applicera det inom ansvarsområdet
* Erfarenhet av informellt ledarskap och kunna motivera och engagera personal utanför ens mandat
* God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.


 För att lyckas i denna roll krävs en kombination av analytisk förmåga, ledarskap och personlig stabilitet. Du en förmåga att förstå komplexa IT‑miljöer, identifiera risker och omsätta dem i praktiska åtgärder och planer.
   

  

 Du kan se samband mellan verksamhet, IT och risk, och arbeta proaktivt med resiliens snarare än reaktiv problemlösning. Du bygger starka samarbeten och får gehör för kontinuitetsfrågor i organisationen. Du har en förmåga att omsätta styrning för planer till faktisk återhämtningsförmåga för kritiska tjänster.
   

  

 Du har god förmåga att stå framför en ledning och rapportera det egna ansvarsområdet på ett tydligt och strukturellt sätt.
   

  

**Vad händer nu?**
 Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag, men i och med stundande semestertider tar vi ett uppehåll i rekryteringsprocessen och
 **återupptar urval och intervjuerna** 
 i
 **mitten av augusti** 
 . Varmt välkommen med din ansökan, och trevlig sommar! 🌞
   

  

 Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning för att säkerställa en rättvis och objektiv bedömning.
   

  

 Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Sofia Tischler på sofia.tischler@skandia.se
   

  

 Om du har frågor kring rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta Talent Acquisition Partner Susanne Hedberg på susanne.hedberg@skandia.se
   

  

 Vi återkopplar till alla som söker, oavsett om du går vidare i processen eller inte.
   

  

**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!** 
**💚**
**Mer om IT**
 Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto!
   

  

 Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv.
   

  

 Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

title: Product Owner
description:
**Xensam: Join the Future of SAM**
 Xensam is the leader in AI-powered, cloud-based Software Asset Management. Our technology brings clarity to complex IT environments, helping users make smart, data-driven decisions and maximize software ROI.
   

  

 Recognized with the Highest Growth Award and ranked #3 Overall Champion at the Main Software 50 Awards Nordics, we’re scaling fast and looking for people who want to join the journey. At Xensam, you play a key role in a team built on energy, focus, and positivity. We value experience, but even more, the person behind it.
   

  

 Together, we build the future of SAM.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As our Product Owner at Xensam, you will be responsible to ensure effective product delivery and execution by translating the strategic direction into clear, actionable plans for the engineering team. You’ll drive the delivery of the roadmap by managing priorities, workflows, and execution consistency within your team. You will also maintain a smooth delivery flow to ensure efficient progress toward roadmap goals. In this role, being comfortable with technical concepts and decisions is key, as it allows you to effectively guide the team and turn strategy into practical outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive on-time, high-quality delivery of roadmap items.
* Research upcoming features and turn them into detailed technical specifications and requirements.
* Evaluate feature feasibility and design trade-offs, considering system architecture, dependencies, and user impact.
* Manage team priorities, planning, and daily workflows to maintain continuous progress.
* Keep backlog items clear, updated, and structured with acceptance criteria and dependencies.
* Coordinate with QA, Support, and other teams to ensure alignment and fast resolution of delivery issues.
* Contribute to the evolution of delivery processes, tooling, and collaboration frameworks as the organization scales.


**Qualifications**
* 3-5+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Agile Delivery, or a similar role working closely with engineering teams.
* Experience with software products involving agents, connectors, or system integrations.
* Proven experience managing backlog execution, sprint planning, and delivery workflows for technical software products.
* Strong familiarity with agile methods and tooling.
* Experience working in distributed teams, aligning across multiple products or subsystems.
* Excellent organizational and coordination skills - able to align multiple workstreams and dependencies.
* Strong communication and prioritization abilities to ensure clarity for all stakeholders.
* Technically confident, able to discuss software architecture, APIs, integrations, and deployment considerations.


**Bonus points if you**
* Have experience in IT asset management (ITAM), software asset management (SAM), endpoint management, monitoring, or security software.
* Have experience working in development roles and/or a degree in computer science.


**What You Get**
* A generous work culture with free drinks and snacks, office massages, and more.
* Three days in-office (with remote work on Mondays and Fridays).
* An opportunity to shape your career growth while contributing to the company’s success.
* A dynamic position embracing "freedom under responsibility".
* If sales targets are met, all employees enjoy an annual destination trip.
* Other location-specific benefits.


**Our values at Xensam**
**Rebellious**
 We challenge the norm and act with initiative – always with responsibility.
   

  

**Humane**
 We foster a caring, inclusive environment that values diversity and respects individuality.
   

  

**Harmony**
 We value balance and create a supportive workplace where people thrive.
   

  

 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on final candidates to fulfill our commitments to customers and ensure a safe work environment.
   

  

 Xensam is the leading provider of AI-powered Software Asset Management technology. Designed to provide SAM Managers and IT Leaders with valuable data, our platform offers a wealth of features to simplify SAM workloads with built-in automation and advanced functionality. We prioritize ease of use and industry-leading security for both On-premise and Cloud software, putting organizations in total control of their hybrid IT environments.

title: Solutions Architect, Software and Technology Companies (ISV)
description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about cloud technology and helping customers innovate?
   

  

 Join our AWS Solutions Architecture team in Sweden and empower Software, SaaS and Technology Companies to innovate at speed and scale with cloud technologies.
   

  

 Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. Solutions Architects are responsible for creating and presenting technical content and sharing best practices.
   

  

 They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. They help customer's validate their initiatives from ideation to proof of concept. Solutions Architects lead activities such as architecture reviews, white-boarding sessions, demos and technical workshops. They collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, Industry experts, support, service teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
   

  

 Amongst others you will be part of the design and building of reference architectures, proof of concepts and help customer deploy production workloads on AWS. You will also provide thought leadership and recommendations on cloud architecture, migration, modernization and operation. Build strong technical relationships acting as the voice of the customer internally to influence AWS service roadmaps.
   

  

 At Amazon you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of the customer. We value your passion to discover, invent and build on behalf of customers.
   

  

 Amazon has always been, and always will be, committed to diversity and inclusion. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.
   

  

 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and dedicated support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Work directly with strategic customers to accelerate their challenging, mission-critical projects and recommend best-practice architectures in line with their long-term business outcomes
* Build technical relationships with customers and operate as their trusted advisor. The best interests of the customer will shape the guidance you provide.
* Share the voice of the customer to inform the roadmap of AWS features.
* Participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts).
* Evangelise and educate customers about AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
* Contribute to the growth of the Solutions Architecture organisation by interviewing candidates and having a voice in hiring decisions. You will also be helping others develop new skills by mentoring team members and identifying talent needs in the organisation.
* Develop areas of depth in technical domains relevant to our outcomes.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to work with account managers to help customers accelerate their cloud implementation to modernize their business on AWS. Working with these customers, you will help them transform existing workloads by designing modern target architectures optimized for business agility, innovation, performance, resiliency, cost, security, and more using both native and partner solutions.
   

  

 Our teams focus on understanding customer key business drivers as well as the existing application architecture(s) to deliver a technical recommendation to the customer with a goal of designing a robust cloud architecture that can scale as their business requires.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Solutions Architecture team empowers innovators to invent on behalf of customers. We are obsessed with understanding each customer's unique objectives to deliver optimal architectures tailored to their needs. Our culture celebrates talented, curious, motivated team members who take ownership of projects. We move with urgency, take risks, learn continuously, and maintain a friendly, inclusive environment. Join our team if you are passionate about technology and delighting customers.
   

  

 Your direct team is located across the Nordics and you would work in close collaboration with team members in Sweden and across borders.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship & Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Background in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, or DevOps
* Technical Degree (Computer Science, Maths, Engineering or equivalent) and/or relevant tech experience.
* Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English
* A passion for technology and for learning


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience designing, building, refactoring or operating IT systems in the cloud
* Working knowledge of software development practices and technologies highly desired
* AWS Certification, eg. AWS Solutions Architect Associate


 Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.
   

  

 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 - AWS EMEA SARL (Sweden Branch)
