title: IT-chef till Kommunal
description:
Vill du leda en IT-verksamhet i en organisation där teknik, verksamhetsutveckling och samhällsnytta möts? Trivs du i en roll där du får kombinera strategiskt ledarskap med operativt ansvar och samtidigt vara med och forma framtidens IT-landskap?
   

  

 Då kan detta vara nästa steg i din karriär. Rollen erbjuder en unik möjlighet att driva förändring, utveckla organisation och team samt skapa långsiktigt värde genom moderna IT-lösningar.
   

  

**DIN VARDAG**
 Som IT-chef har du det övergripande ansvaret för att leda, utveckla och modernisera IT-verksamheten. Du ansvarar för både medarbetare, budget och verksamhetsutveckling och axlar ett viktigt ansvar i att säkerställa att organisationen får maximal nytta och värde av de moderna plattformar och applikationer som nyligen implementerats. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med verksamheten, ledning och externa leverantörer för att säkerställa att IT levererar rätt stöd till organisationens mål och behov.
   

  

 Du kommer att spela en central roll i att utveckla IT-organisationen, skapa tydligare styrning och struktur samt bygga upp effektiva arbetssätt kring leverantörsstyrning, avtal, licenshantering och systemförvaltning. Rollen omfattar även ansvar för att utveckla kompetens, leda förändringsarbete och skapa förutsättningar för ett hållbart och välfungerande IT-stöd för verksamheten.
   

  

 Det här är en roll för dig som vill vara med och bygga något långsiktigt. Du får möjlighet att påverka strategiska beslut samtidigt som du förväntas kunna växla mellan helhetsperspektiv och operativa frågeställningar när situationen kräver det.
   

  

**VEM ÄR DU?**
 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:
   

  

* Flerårig erfarenhet som IT-chef, IT-ledare eller motsvarande roll med personal-, budget- och verksamhetsansvar
* Erfarenhet av att leda större team och komplexa IT-verksamheter
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av digitalisering, förändringsledning och verksamhetsutveckling
* Erfarenhet av leverantörsstyrning, avtalsförvaltning och upphandling
* Gedigen kunskap inom Microsofts plattformar, exempelvis Microsoft 365, Azure och Entra ID
* God förståelse för IT-governance, ekonomisk styrning och portföljhantering
* Erfarenhet av informationssäkerhet, arkitektur, integrationsplattformar och systemförvaltning
* Förmåga att kombinera strategiskt arbete med operativt genomförande
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
* Erfarenhet från medlemsstyrda organisationer, offentlig sektor eller liknande verksamhet är meriterande


 Som person är du en trygg och tydlig ledare som skapar förtroende genom närvaro, struktur och handlingskraft. Du är van att navigera i komplexa miljöer och har förmågan att få med dig människor i förändring. Samtidigt är du prestigelös, lyhörd och kommunikativ med en naturlig förmåga att bygga starka relationer på alla nivåer i organisationen. Du drivs av att utveckla både verksamhet och människor och trivs i miljöer där du får skapa ordning, tydlighet och långsiktiga resultat. Vi förutsätter att du som söker delar Kommunals värderingar och inser värdet av fackligt arbete.
   

  

**OM KOMMUNAL**
 Kommunal är en etablerad och samhällsviktig förening med ett tydligt uppdrag och stort engagemang för Kommunals medlemmar. För människor som tycker att det är viktigt med gemenskap och vill ha ett hållbart arbetsliv med bra villkor ger Kommunal kollektiv förhandlingsstyrka och stöd när problem uppstår på jobbet. Alla medlemmar ska kunna känna sig trygga och handlingskraftiga. Verksamheten präglas av långsiktighet, professionalism och ett starkt fokus på utveckling, och Kommunal agerar med en personlighet som är välkomnande, modig och pålitlig. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i en förening där tekniska satsningar har direkt påverkan på verksamhetens förmåga att möta framtidens behov och skapa värde för många människor.
   

  

**KONTAKT**
 I denna rekrytering samarbetar Kommunal med Wise IT. Vill du veta mer, kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Sandra Åhs på sandra.ahs@wise.se eller Kristin Mörth Shakhovskoy på kristin.morth@wise.se.
   

  

 Vi kan tyvärr inte ta emot ansökningar via mail då vi värnar om din personliga integritet. Du kan läsa mer om hur vi behandlar personuppgifter enligt GDPR i Wise Group-koncernens policy för behandling av personuppgifter.

*Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!*

title: Integration Consultant within eHealth
description:
Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.
   

  

**The position**
 In your role as integration consultant at Cambio Healthcare, you will be an important part of Cambio’s technical consulting organization. Our mission is to support our customers with technical and integrational solutions linked to our EHR System - COSMIC. We are also tasked with creating a new ecosystem to facilitate third-party integrations so that we, together with others, can improve the entire chain in healthcare. You play a crucial role in our constant endeavor to support our customers in the best possible way. One of your most important tasks is to realize the benefits and opportunities that our solutions mean for the end users in healthcare. In the near future, our new customer group will introduce COSMIC, where you will be an important part of implementing successful integration solutions.
   

  

 Becoming part of our team means that you will be one of our integration consultants and work externally towards our customers and contribute with competence in our product and their technical interoperability. It also involves work integration management and development of our integration platform, Cambio Open Services (COS). COS is our open platform that enables innovation and integration by promoting collaboration with third party solutions. This makes it possible for us to create exciting new solutions to offer our customers.
   

  

**For Example, You Will Work With**
* Development of our customers competence and understanding of our solutions
* Introduction, implementation, and development of integration solutions
* Project lead and support for example implementations, education, and developments
* Guide third-party providers in connections to our integration platform


 We strive to have a team that, together with different skills and experience, can support our customers in their work going forward in the best possible way. We work to always stay at the forefront of new technologies and standards while supporting each other and sharing our knowledge.
   

  

 At Cambio, we encourage taking initiatives that contribute to the development of the company and ourselves. For us, it is important that you should have the opportunity to grow, both as a person and as an employee. Our culture is described through the words “Trust”, “Care” and “Together” which permeate everything we do.
   

  

**About You**
 For this role, we are looking for a person who is responsible, self-motivated and a humble team player. You find it easy to build relationships with our partners and are educational in your way of communicating. As a person, you are flexible, pragmatic, unprestigious and above all independent. You like to work on your own, but are also a team player of rank when required.
   

  

**Requirements** 
  

  

* Experience working with system integrations and/or APIs
* Experience of working with IT solutions for larger organizations
* Good technical knowledge in relevant areas for the role
* Ability to travel for work when required
* Proficiency in Swedish is a prerequisite for this position, as our client in the public sector specifically requires Swedish language skills.


**It's a bonus if you**
* Highly meritorious with experience of COSMIC and related integration solutions
* Knowledge of working with standards in medical informatics, preferably FHIR
* Experience in administration and/or use of API Gateways
* Experience in project management
* Experience in the consulting industry
* University degree or other higher education in IT or other relevant area


**Place of employment** 
 : Stockholm, Linköping
   

  

**Scope** 
 : Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office)
   

  

**Form of employment:** 
 Permanent employment, 6 months trial period
   

  

**Additional Information:** 
 The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate.
   

  

 We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link.
   

  

**We look forward to receiving your application!**
**CAMBIO- FOR A HEALTHIER TOMORROW**
 Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life
 **.** 
 Read more about us

**A healthier tomorrow also means taking care of those who make it possible -** 
 explore our employee benefits
   

  

 Learn more about our recruitment process here

title: Data warehouse-arkitekt
description:
*Vill du ta en ledande teknisk roll i ett team som arbetar med affärskritiska lösningar inom data och integration, CRM-system?*
*Vi söker nu en Data warehouse-arkitekt med djup kompetens inom MSSQL och integrationer som vill bli en del av ett kompetent och prestigelöst team där samarbete, innovation och verksamhetsnytta står i fokus.*
**Om rollen**
 I rollen som Data warehouse-arkitekt kommer du att ha ett övergripande ansvar för att ta fram tydliga och hållbara lösningsförslag för teamets system och integrationer. Du arbetar nära både utvecklingsteamet och verksamheten för att säkerställa att lösningarna är skalbara, effektiva och möter verksamhetens behov – både idag och framåt.
   

  

 Rollen kombinerar strategiskt arkitekturarbete med operativ utveckling, där du även kommer att arbeta hands-on som SQL-utvecklare när behov och tid finns. Du förväntas kunna växla mellan detaljnivå och helikopterperspektiv samt bidra med tekniskt ledarskap inom arkitektur, integrationer och databasutveckling.
   

  

 Du kommer att samarbeta nära utvecklare, produktägare, testare, verksamhetsrepresentanter och andra arkitekter för att säkerställa effektiva informationsflöden och lösningar som fungerar över teamgränserna.
   

  

**Att jobba som Data warehouse-arkitekt**
 Du blir en del av ett stort och tvärfunktionellt team bestående av cirka 12 personer med varierande senioritet – från juniora till mycket seniora specialister. I teamet finns bland annat teamcoach, produktägare, SQL-utvecklare, .NET-mjukvaruarkitekt, .NET-utvecklare, Dynamics-specialister och testare.
   

  

 Teamet ansvarar för att förvalta och utveckla stabila och effektiva lösningar för att samla in data och leverera rätt information i rätt tid – för att tillsammans med verksamheten möjliggöra bästa möjliga kundrelation och kundupplevelse.
   

  

 Vi arbetar enligt ett agilt arbetssätt och värdesätter samarbete, kunskapsdelning och ett öppet klimat där alla får komma till tals. Teamet sitter på Lindhagensgatan i Stockholm och arbetar enligt en hybridmodell med tre dagar på kontoret och möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån två dagar i veckan.
   

  

 Här får du möjlighet att arbeta inom ett område som ständigt utvecklas, med fokus på modernisering. Du kommer även arbeta med införande av molnbaserad lösning inom Fabric.
   

  

**För att lyckas i rollen**
 Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av att arbeta som mjukvaruarkitekt eller i en annan tekniskt ledande roll, där du har ansvarat för lösningsdesign och arkitektur i komplexa systemmiljöer.
   

  

**Vi Ser Att Du Har Erfarenhet Av**
* MSSQL och arbete med stora databaser med ett flertal integrationer och höga datavolymer
* Arbetat med prestandaoptimering av databaser både gällande laddningar och lagring
* Har koll på MSSQL standard integrationsmönster i SSIS och har erfarenhet av eventdriven arkitektur
* Har arbetat med versionshantering (GIT) både för databasprojekt och SSIS projekt
* SQL-Serverbakgrund som DBA
* Agila arbetssätt
* Att ta fram tydliga tekniska lösningsförslag och arbeta ur ett helikopterperspektiv


 Meriterande erfarenhet
   

  

* Azure
* Fabric
* ADF (Azure Data Factory)
* Azure DevOps


 Som person tror vi att du är lyhörd, social och har en mycket god samarbetsförmåga. Du trivs med att arbeta nära både team och verksamhet, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till ett öppet och positivt arbetsklimat. Samtidigt är du trygg i att ta tekniskt ansvar och arbetar på ett prestigelöst och lösningsorienterat sätt.
   

  

**Vad händer nu?**
 Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.
   

  

 Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.
   

  

 Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef, Fredrik Othberg, på fredrik.othberg@skandia.se.
   

  

 Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Talent Acquisition Specialist, Nina Fazeli, på nina.fazeli@skandia.se.
   

  

 Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
   

  

**Vi kommer att ta ett sommaruppehåll i rekryteringsprocessen och återupptar intervjuerna i augusti.**
**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan, och trevlig sommar!**
**Mer om IT**
 Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto!
   

  

 Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv.
   

  

 Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

title: CLOUD ARCHITECT / CLOUD DEVELOPER
description:
Kom och jobba på Sigma Technology Cloud – ett topprankat IT-konsultbolag inom molnlösningar!
   

  

 Sigma Technology Cloud är specialiserade inom cloudlösningar och en del av Sigma Technology-koncernen, ett globalt teknikkonsultbolag. Som Advanced Partner mot AWS och Solution Partner mot Microsoft står vi starka på marknaden och hjälper kunder av olika storlekar att skapa hållbara, skalbara och säkra molnlösningar.
   

  

 Vårt engagemang har gett resultat: vi vann 2024 Nordic AWS Partner Award, och Sigma Technology har för tolfte året i rad rankats bland Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare av Universum, med en topp tre-placering (läs mer).
   

  

 Nu söker vi en Cloud Architect / Cloud Developer som vill ta en betydande roll hos våra kunder — från design och arkitektur till hands-on-utveckling, beroende på uppdrag.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Ort: Stockholm — uppdrag hos kund (varierar beroende på projekt) Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning hos Sigma Technology Cloud Erfarenhetsnivå: Senior (minst 5 års erfarenhet)
   

  

 Som konsult arbetar du nära våra kunder med design, utveckling och implementering av moderna molnlösningar på AWS, Azure och/eller GCP — med fokus på skalbara, säkra och kostnadseffektiva arkitekturer. Uppdragen varierar från enskilda resursuppdrag till större teamleveranser, och rollen kan luta mer mot arkitektur eller mer mot utveckling beroende på projekt och din profil.
   

  

**Exempel På Vad Du Kan Komma i Kontakt Med**
 Design och implementation av molnarkitektur med fokus på skalbarhet, säkerhet, prestanda och kostnadseffektivitet Applikationsutveckling i språk som Java, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Go eller Python Serverless-utveckling (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, Google Cloud Functions) och eventdrivna arkitekturer CI/CD, DevOps och automatiserade deploymentflöden Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, ARM Templates, Ansible) Containerbaserade lösningar med Docker, Kubernetes och molnleverantörers containerplattformar Mikrotjänster, API-design och systemintegrationer AI-drivna lösningar i molnmiljö
   

  

 Du behöver inte kunna allt ovan — vi matchar dig mot uppdrag utifrån din profil, erfarenhet och intressen.

title: Product Data & Configuration Specialist for Sales tools
description:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping.
   

  

 As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.
   

  

**About The Job**
 We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive
 **Product Data & Configuration Specialist for Sales tools** 
 to join our Digital Process Solutions team. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring that our sales configuration tools are always up-to-date and accurate, directly enabling our global sales force to deliver the right solutions to customers.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Create and maintain commercial and technical product data in our database
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of product and component information
* Collaborate with various stakeholders such as Product owners, Sales team and R&D


**Your work will have a direct and visible impact on how products are configured and sold globally.**
**What You’ll Bring**
 You combine a structured and detail-oriented mindset with technical skills and a proactive, result driven attitude. You thrive in dynamic environments, collaborate effectively across teams, and take ownership to ensure high-quality outcomes.
   

  

* Core competencies: We are a small team with a high level of teamwork, the role requires agility and adaptability and a clear drive for results, paired with a quality-focused and structured way of working.

A plus is SQL knowledge, basic programming skills, and the ability to manage and structure complex data sets is required. Experience working with product data, product configuration, ERP, PLM, PIM, CPQ or similar business systems is advantageous.
* Education & languages: You may hold a degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Data Management, Business & Technology, or a related technical field. Equivalent experience gained through vocational training and relevant work experience is equally valued. Proficiency in English is required; Swedish is a strong advantage.
* Personal qualities: Curious with a high level of learning ability and solution-oriented, proactive with a strong sense of ownership, and a positive attitude with a commitment to contribute and deliver results.


**What We Offer**
* An open, employee-oriented company culture built on trust, appreciation, and collaboration
* A company mission driven by sustainability
* Hybrid working model
* A role with immediate business impact and visibility

title: Product Owner Platform Engineering Getinge Critical Care
description:
**With a passion for life**
 Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
   

  

 Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
   

  

**About This Opportunity**
 We are looking for a technically hands-on Product Owner for our Platform Engineering team at our Solna site. You will own the roadmap and backlog for the platform that enables our product teams to design, build, test and deliver software efficiently.
   

  

 You will work closely with product teams, engineering, security, compliance, and other internal stakeholders to improve the full software delivery lifecycle. GitLab is a central component of the platform, together with Kubernetes, Azure, on-prem infrastructure, and observability tooling based on the LGTM stack. The role requires a high degree of autonomy – you should be self-driven, identify needs, prioritize work, and implement improvements together with your team with limited day-to-day guidance.
   

  

 A key part of the role is to provide AI-related services, tooling, and support for both technical and non-technical users, with a strong focus on improving developer experience, productivity, and collaboration.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own and manage the roadmap and backlog for the internal software development platform, combined with hands-on technical work.
* Collaborate with product teams, security, compliance, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure the platform is reliable, scalable, secure, and easy to use.
* Provide AI services, guidance, and support to improve developer experience and productivity for both technical and non-technical users.
* Support product teams with onboarding, integrations, testing workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and platform adoption.


 This position is based in Solna, Sweden and is eligible for a hybrid work setup.
   

  

**You will bring**
 To be successful in this position, we believe that you have the following qualifications.
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, or equivalent working experience.
* Some years of experience in product ownership or a similar role, together with hands-on experience of cloud/hybrid infrastructure (Azure, on-prem) and Kubernetes, including application deployments and/or CI workload execution.
* Experience with GitLab or similar source control and CI/CD platforms, and with AI developer tools and/or AI platforms (e.g. GitLab Duo, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Azure OpenAI).
* Understanding of security, compliance, governance and auditability in software development environments.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to adapt to different audiences.
* Fluent in Swedish and English, orally and written.
* Experience with secure software supply chain practices (dependency scanning, container scanning, SAST, secret detection, vulnerability management), the LGTM stack (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir), and/or working in regulated or compliance-driven environments is meritorious.


 In addition to your technical skills, we highly value your personality. You are self-driven and comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy, identifying needs and prioritizing your own work with limited day-to-day guidance.
   

  

 We think you have an ambition for growth and an eagerness for keeping up to date with the latest platform engineering and AI developer tooling. At Getinge we see ourselves as proactive and self-driven in learning and contributing to the continued development of our products and our organization's capabilities.  We are Team Players, Forward Thinkers and Game Changers. We think you will thrive in a high-expectation environment and have an interest in our products.
   

  

**Why join Getinge**
 Getinge offers a job in a safe and informal work environment, where we appreciate close team collaboration. We keep an open dialogue between leaders and employees, as well as between teams. We are focused on developing people, and together we will create a plan for learning and competence development when you start your career with us.
   

  

 We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including wellness allowances, generous family benefits and joint company activities. Everything to ensure we support your well-being and goals.
   

  

**Application**
 Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-09-05.
   

  

 We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail. If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Hiring Manager Fredrik Ågren at email: fredrik.agren@getinge.com , or Talent Manager Emma Paulsson at email: emma.paulsson@getinge.com
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.
   

  

**About Us**
 With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Kravanalytiker
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla IT‑lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för våra kunder? På IT Liv & pension, en sektion med cirka 180 engagerade kollegor, söker vi nu en kravanalytiker som vill ta plats i ett verksamhetsnära team med stort ansvar för Folksams kommunala och kooperativa pensionsplattformar. I teamet för utbetalning och ekonomi får du en central roll i att översätta affärsbehov och regelverk till smarta, hållbara IT‑lösningar som bidrar till trygghet för människor – varje dag. Tjänsten är placerad i Skanstull.
 


  

**Det här gör du som kravanalytiker på Folksam** 
  


 Som kravanalytiker är du bryggan mellan verksamheten och IT. Du samlar in och analyserar behov från olika intressenter i organisationen, bidrar till att behoven/kraven formuleras och dokumenteras på ett sätt som gör dem utvecklingsbara och testbara och ser även till att de blir dokumenterade. Du kommer att ha många kontakter internt och till stor del samverka med Product Owner (PO) och teammedlemmar för att säkerställa att kraven förstås och implementeras korrekt.
 


  


 Som en del av ett team kommer du även att jobba med flera delar av teamets arbetsuppgifter, som till exempel att ta fram testfall och bidra till teamets leverans och mående. Vidare arbetar vi aktivt med att förbättra arbetssättet avseende kravanalys och ser gärna att du är med och bidrar till detta arbete.
 


  

**Är du den vi söker?** 
  


 Vi söker dig som har minst fyra års erfarenhet som kravanalytiker och kan tryggt navigera i agila arbetssätt. Du är van att dokumentera krav på ett strukturerat och metodiskt sätt och har erfarenhet av att arbeta i större eller komplexa organisationer.
 


  


 Utöver ovanstående ser vi att du också har:
 


  

  
* God kommunikativ förmåga och kan uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.
  
* Erfarenhet att arbeta med krav på övergripande nivå och definiera samt bryta ner features.
  
* Drivs av att utveckla arbetssätt avseende kravanalys.
  


  


  

 Det är meriterande om du har:
 


  

  
* Erfarenhet av informations-, begrepps-, och/eller processmodellering.
  
* Erfarenhet av att detaljera och analysera krav avseende webbgränssitt.
  
* Erfarenhet av test samt jobbat med att ta fram och dokumentera relevanta testfall och/eller deltagit vid systemtest.
  


  


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga förmågor och färdigheter. För att lyckas i rollen som kravanalytiker behöver du vara självgående och ha en hög analytisk förmåga. Du har lätt för att skapa kontakter och behålla goda relationer där du är kommunikativ och lyhörd. Du har dessutom en god analytisk förmåga och en nyfikenhet med stark vilja att utvecklas i din roll.
 


  

  

 Här kan du göra skillnad
   


 Välkommen till Folksam – här driver du viktiga frågor framåt. Från de avgörande detaljerna till de stora perspektiven, med fokus på att förenkla våra kunders vardag. Det gör att du bidrar till något större, oavsett roll. Här finns det många roliga, utvecklande jobb och du har goda chanser till en spännande karriär.
   

  

 Vi tror på ett hållbart arbetsliv och jobbar aktivt med inkludering och mångfald. Våra moderna kontor bjuder in till samarbete och lärande, här får vi saker att hända! Du har flexibiliteten att kunna varva arbete på kontoret med att jobba hemifrån, utifrån verksamhetens behov.
 


  


 Läs mer och se filmer om livet hos oss på folksam.se/jobb-och-karriar.

title: Cybersäkerhetsanalytiker till samhällsviktiga kommunikationstjänster
company: Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency
description:
Myndigheten för civilt försvar
   

  

*Myndigheten för civilt försvar är den ledande, inriktande och samordnande myndigheten i det civila försvaret. Vi säkerställer att samhället är förberett för kris, höjd beredskap och krig.*
 Vi gör Sverige redo. Vill du vara med och arbeta för att leda det civila försvaret? Då kanske du är vår nästa kollega!
   

  

 Vi söker cybersäkerhetsanalytiker till enheten för samhällsviktiga kommunikationstjänster. Här får du möjlighet att bidra till att skydda och stärka system som är avgörande för Sveriges samhällsaktörer. Din insats blir en nyckel för att säkerställa robust och trygg kommunikation i hela samhället.
   

  

 Ditt ansvar och dina arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 Som cybersäkerhetsanalytiker kommer du att bidra i arbetet med att etablera och vidareutveckla vår CSOC-funktion (Cyber Security Operations Center). Du kommer att ingå i ett engagerat team där ni tillsammans arbetar för att utveckla och stärka våra tjänsters säkerhetsförmåga. Rollen erbjuder en teknisk miljö där du får utvecklas i rollen och arbeta med kritiska säkerhetsfrågor i en samhällsviktig verksamhet. I rollen ingår även omvärldsbevakning och att följa teknikutvecklingen, så att vi kontinuerligt kan anpassa och förbättra våra säkerhetslösningar.
   

  

**I Dina Arbetsuppgifter Ingår**
* Övervakning och analys av säkerhetshot, i realtid övervakar nätverk och system för att identifiera och hantera säkerhetshot.
* Utforma säkerhetslösningar. Du utvecklar och implementerar strategier för att skydda data och system från intrång och andra cyberhot.
* Incidenthantering. Du hanterar säkerhetsincidenter och arbetar med att återställa system efter attacker.


 Dina kunskaper och kompetenser
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som**
* är i början av din karriär och nyligen har genomfört en relevant eftergymnasial utbildning.
* har kunskap om logganalys, nätverkstrafikanalys och säkerhetsövervakning.
* har kunskap om hantering av IT-säkerhetsincidenter.
* god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.


**Det Är Meriterande Om Du Har**
* erfarenhet från arbete inom CSOC/SOC eller annan övervakningsfunktion inom IT-säkerhet.
* kunskap om standarder inom informations- och IT-säkerhet, såsom ISO 27000, CIS Controls, NIST.
* erfarenhet av att arbeta med säkerhetslösningar som brandväggar, kryptering och autentisering.
* certifiering inom informationssäkerhet, exempelvis CISSP eller motsvarande.


 I allt vårt arbete, både internt och externt, ska vi agera utifrån den statliga värdegrunden. Som alla medarbetare och ledare hos oss förväntas du agera utifrån myndighetens förhållningssätt.
   

  

 Förhållningssätten gäller i vardag, kris och krig. De ska ses som en helhet och bygger på varandra; samarbetsinriktad – proaktiv - handlingskraftig.
   

  

 Läs mer om våra förhållningssätt
   

  

 För att passa i rollen som är det avgörande att du arbetar noggrant och med stor medvetenhet om säkerhetskrav och kvalitetsstandarder. Du har en analytisk förmåga som gör att du kan identifiera, bryta ner och lösa komplexa säkerhetsutmaningar på ett strukturerat sätt. Eftersom hotbilden ständigt förändras är du också flexibel och anpassar snabbt ditt arbetssätt utifrån nya risker och säkerhetsmål.
   

  

 Om anställningen
   

  

 Vi erbjuder dig en anställning tillsvidare på heltid som inleds med en provanställning.
   

  

 Din placeringsort kommer att vara Stockholm och resor i anställningen förekommer.
   

  

 Arbetstiden är förlagd till skiftarbete, vilket innefattar arbete på kvällar, nätter och helger. Inledningsvis är arbetstiden dagtid.
   

  

 Majoriteten av våra anställningar innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Vid placering i säkerhetsklass kommer säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. De flesta medarbetare på Myndigheten för civilt försvar är krigsplacerade.
   

  

 Om oss
   

  

 Sektionen kontinuitet och säkerhets uppgift är säkerhetsskydd, signalskydd, fysiskt skydd,
   

  

 informationssäkerhet, IT-säkerhet och kontinuitet inom samhällsviktiga kommunikationstjänster. I detta ingår att utbilda, vägleda och stödja verksamheten i säkerhets- och kontinuitetsrelaterade frågor samt att tillse regelefterlevnad på säkerhetsområdet. I uppgiften ingår security operations center (SOC). På sektionen är vi idag 9 medarbetare som finns i både Karlstad och Stockholm.
   

  

 Vi har aktivitetsbaserat kontor där du kan välja arbetsplats efter egna behov. Vi erbjuder dig också en möjlighet att ta ut friskvårdstimme och du får även ett friskvårdsbidrag. För dig som statligt anställd finns också förmånliga semestervillkor.
   

  

 Alla vi som arbetar på Myndigheten för civilt försvar förväntas och ska bidra till ökad jämställdhet och likabehandling för en arbetsmiljö och ett samhälle fritt från diskriminering.
   

  

 Läs mer om vår organisation, förmåner och hur det är att arbeta hos oss
   

  

 Vill du veta mer?
   

  

 Har du frågor är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Stefan Jakobsson. Fackliga företrädare är Carl Önne (Saco-S), Jan Herremo (ST) och Ann-Britt Paradis eller Josefin Berglund (SEKO). Samtliga nås via växelnumret 0771-240 240. Samtliga nås via växelnummer 0771-240 240.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**HAYPP GROUP**
 We address one of the world’s biggest problems – how to end smoking. There are 1,1 billion smokers in the world. Around 8 million people die every year from smoking-related diseases. Our goal is to significantly reduce death rates, save lives and inspire people to choose smoke-free enjoyment. How? By offering people other nicotine products online.
   

  

 Haypp Group is one of the Nordics’ leading e-commerce groups with eleven store brands, present in seven countries where we serve more than 1 million active consumers. Through brands such as Snusbolaget.se, Northerner.com, Nicokick.com etc., we sell nicotine pouches, Swedish style snus online as well as disposable vapes. With our headquarters located on Östgötagatan in Stockholm we are 300 team members mainly but not exclusively based in Sweden. Also, we are an innovative and fast-moving company that is growing rapidly, driving sustainable business and are changing the world in the process. We are currently on an exciting expansion journey, converting more and more smokers to smoke-free alternatives across all our markets globally.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help shape the future of data at Haypp Group. As part of our Data Engineering team, you'll play a key role in building and scaling the data platform that powers decision-making across the entire business.
   

  

 Working with a modern AWS-based stack including Redshift, dbt, Airflow, Docker and Terraform, you'll design and develop robust data solutions that transform complex e-commerce data into actionable insights. Your work will enable everything from business-critical analytics to advanced machine learning initiatives, helping us make smarter decisions at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 As a Senior Data Engineer in Haypp, you’ll find modern technologies, agile workflows, and tight integration at the heart of the business. Implement, develop, and maintain data pipelines connecting to multiple data sources such as in-house e-comm platform, shipping providers, warehouse systems etc.
   

  

 You will be working with the following things daily:
   

  

* Build and maintain scalable, testable and reliable data pipelines using best practices.
* Build and main robust data infrastructure in a version-controlled way
* Work closely with Analytics team colleagues to ensure integrity and quality of data.
* Liaise with stakeholders from all parts of the organisation to develop the data infrastructure to meet the prioritised business projects.
* Together with the tech team, drive the data infrastructure and its architecture forward.
* Learn, grow, be challenged and have fun!


**What We Want From You**
 Technical skills are important, but so is the way we work together. We're looking for someone who enjoys collaborating across teams, sharing ideas, and contributing to an open and supportive culture.
   

  

* Previous experience in Data Engineering roles.
* Fluency in using SQL and Python is a must to succeed at this role.
* A strong understanding on data governance, security, maintainability and observability.
* Experience working in and managing a cloud environment, such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
* Experience modeling data using industry standard tools such as dbt, and with data modeling concepts such as star schema, dimensional modeling etc.
* A commitment to ensuring data quality for downstream users of data.
* Technical ownership and familiarity with agile ways of working.
* You have a technical and commercial mindset, meaning you can take a business request and implement it technically.
* Are a team player – needs to be able to interact with the team, be adaptable.
* A good communicator, both with technical and non-technical counterparts.
* Fluent in English. Swedish is not a requirement but can be a plus.
* Ambitious with a will to learn and develop.


**What We Offer**
 We are a value driven company with our values
 *We team up* 
 ,
 *Innovation Drives Us* 
 ,
 *Inclusion and Non-Hierarchy* 
 and
 *Going the Extra Mile* 
 at the heartbeat of everything that we do. With us you can always expect to get help from people who want to achieve things together and to be able to speak your mind in every social constellation you are part of. We highly value all ideas no matter where they come from, and we are not afraid to try new things out. We are also welcoming, inclusive and everyone at Haypp Group has a voice. In addition, we seize opportunities by putting in hands-on, hard work and celebrating when we reach our goals. With us, you should always feel safe, appreciated and valued but at the same time challenged and excited.
   

  

 Because we recognize that our team members are our most important differentiator, we offer our team members generous benefits. We offer the following perks to everyone at Haypp Group:
   

  

* Competitive occupational pension
* Insurance plan, including private healthcare
* 30 days of paid vacation
* Parental pay lift
* Wellness allowance of 5,000 SEK per year
* Lots of social happenings


**As many of us will be on summer holidays, things may move a bit slower during mid-July. We will continuously review applications, but plan to pick up pace again and start conducting interviews in August.**
**In the meantime, feel free to check out our** 
**website** 
**if you are interested in learning more about us and what we're currently up to!**
**SEND US YOUR APPLICATION TODAY!**
 If this sounds like a place where you would want to contribute and grow, let us know you’re interested by submitting your application!
   

  

 Haypp Group is committed to equality and diversity, and we welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, and marital status. We want to offer you great recruitment experience, and if there is anything we can do to make you more comfortable in the process with us, please let us know.
   

  

 If you have any questions about the role or what it’s like to work at Haypp Group in general, feel free to reach out to our responsible recruiter Lea Sjösten at lea.sjosten@hayppgroup.com. We look forward to hearing from you!
   

  

 The Haypp Group is spearheading the global transformation from smoking to healthier product alternatives. With origins in Scandinavia our extensive experience from pioneering markets in smoke free alternatives, as well as being a leader in the e-commerce sector, we now fully bring our vision to a global scale.
   

  

 With 11 e-commerce brands, the Haypp Group is present in seven countries where we serve more than 1 100 000 consumers.

title: System Data Scientist
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 The RAN System Management & Architecture sector leads and enables a distributed systemization and engineering of the constituent parts of the RAN system. We are seeking for an experienced System Data Scientist to establish and lead our RAN data platform across system development, research, AI/ML and agentic workflow initiatives.
   

  

 In this role, you will build comprehensive data systems and analytical frameworks that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. You will combine advanced AI/ML expertise (LLMs, GenAI, traditional ML) with full-stack data science capabilities and end-to-end system ownership. Leading a team of data scientists, you will design scalable data architectures, implement analytical systems, and deliver high-impact insights. Working closely with the Senior Data Platform Architect, you will define system requirements, optimize data pipelines, and ensure analytical infrastructure supports organizational needs.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Lead AI/ML initiatives including GenAI, LLMs, and traditional machine learning across diverse use cases and business scenarios
* Develop and deploy production ML models with expertise in model versioning, monitoring, and A/B testing (MLOps practices)
* Build and implement GenAI applications and LLM including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions
* Extract actionable insights from complex data and drive data-driven decisions across CI/CD optimization, research experimentation, product metrics, and business operations
* Perform advanced feature engineering and model optimization to ensure high-performance analytical solutions
* Build time series forecasting models for CI/CD predictions and capacity planning
* Collaborate with data platform and engineering teams to define requirements and implement solutions
* Lead and mentor a team of 4-6 data analysts, fostering innovation and continuous improvement


**The skills you bring:**
* 3+ ML models deployed to production with hands-on experience in LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source) and GenAI applications (chatbots, code assistants)
* Advanced Python programming for production environments and expertise in snowflake or Apache Spark for large-scale data processing
* SQL mastery including complex queries and optimization; experience with data lakehouse technologies (Iceberg, Delta Lake, Parquet)
* Understanding of distributed systems, production data pipelines, and MLOps practices
* Advanced statistical methods (hypothesis testing, regression, causal inference) and ability to translate business questions into analytical solutions
* Can articulate model architecture choices and technical tradeoffs
* Nice-to-have: Kubernetes/Docker, Apache Airflow, streaming data processing (Kafka, Spark Streaming), dbt, and software development metrics dashboards
* Master's or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field
* Optional certifications: Google Professional ML Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, Databricks ML Professional


**Location**
 Kista, Stockholm (Sweden), Athlone (Ireland), work from one of our Ericsson offices in these locations.

To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Account Executive
description:

*If so, this could be your next great opportunity!*
**Your Role: Prospect, Connect, and Grow:**

 As our new Account Executive, you will independently lead the charge to expand our market presence in Sweden. With the backing of an established, market-leading organization, you will proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities, build lasting client relationships, and drive revenue growth.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who is hungry for a fresh challenge, comfortable owning their pipeline from first contact to closed deal, and eager to make a real impact in a company that continuously seeks new growth horizons.
   

  

**Join a market leader with real ambition**
 You will become part of EG, the leading supplier of software solutions for the property sector in the Nordics. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions that not only meet but consistently exceed our customers' expectations. As a key player in our Swedish growth strategy, you will be at the forefront of shaping how the real estate industry manages and optimizes its operations.
   

  

**Drive results and create customer value**
 Your primary focus will be selling our SaaS-based facility management solution to real estate companies across Sweden. Day to day, this means generating new business, nurturing strong customer relationships, and contributing to high levels of customer satisfaction. Experience selling software - particularly within property management or facility management - is a significant advantage.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to take on a role with real scope and responsibility, where your skills and ambitions directly influence both your own success and ours. We expect you to have:
   

  

* Strong knowledge of SaaS software sales or high motivation to develop expertise in the field, with experience selling software to the real estate sector in Sweden.

* Structured and results-oriented approach with a strong customer focus.
* Professional proficiency in English, both written and verbal.

**What's in it for you?**
* An interesting and challenging everyday life in dialogue with customers and colleagues.

* Our values: respect for each other, focus on the customer and delivery of what we promise are at the center.

* A hybrid work model with great flexibility to support your work-life balance.

 If you would like more information before you apply, please contact Senior Sales Manager, Jussi Kaasalainen on +358 45 672 3313 or mail juska@eg.fi.  Our industry-specific software help people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.

title: Sales Associate
description:
**About The Role**
 We are currently seeking an individual to join our Locker Network Division in Sweden, with the exciting opportunity to be part of our significant growth journey. Our locker network has rapidly expanded to thousands of boxes across multiple countries, and we have ambitious plans for the future. This role offers the chance to contribute directly to one of Sweden's fastest-growing companies and play a key role in enabling our continued expansion.
   

  

**Some Of Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a Locker Location Sales Associate, you will play a crucial, highly commercial role in driving our expansion. This position demands a high level of activity, relentless solution-oriented thinking, and true grit. You will be actively involved in identifying and securing partnerships with location hosts for our lockers across various regions. In this role, you will:
   

  

* Proactively identify, approach, and secure new locker locations through outreach, pitches, and negotiations.
* Build lasting relationships with property owners, retailers, and other potential partners.
* Manage the full sales cycle: lead generation, pitching, negotiation, and closing agreements.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to ensure smooth roll-out of new locker locations.
* Spot new market opportunities and bring creative ideas that help expand and optimize our locker network.


**About You**
 We’re seeking a proactive, sales-driven individual with a strong "can-do" attitude - someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can manage a large volume of contacts simultaneously, and consistently pushes discussions forward to close deals and deliver results.
   

  

**We Believe You Possess The Following Qualities**
* Competitive and results-oriented Sales-driven with a focus on closing.
* Pragmatic and efficient in your workflow.
* A proactive doer who takes full ownership of their tasks.


**You Should Also**
* Be motivated by ambitious goals and thrive on the challenge of working towards them.
* Exhibit a strong drive for negotiations and problem-solving.
* Apply a creative mindset to support the growth of our network.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrated success in B2B sales or a related commercial field.
* Experience working with or within the grocery chain sector is highly meritorious, as understanding the retail landscape is key to our expansion strategy.
* Experience from a fast-paced industry where high activity is the norm.
* Strong verbal communication and negotiation skills.
* A bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience is a plus, but not required.


**What We Offer**
 We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!
   

  

**Benefits**
 Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:
   

  

* 🌇 Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.
* 🐶 Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!
* 🏓 Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.
* 👶 Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.
* 🎂 A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!
* ⏰ Hybrid setup and flexible working hours


 Diversity and inclusion are very important to us and we are committed to creating an inclusive work environment. We want to be a workplace where everyone’s perspectives and opinions are valued, and we are dedicated to creating opportunities for all employees to thrive and reach their full potential.
   

  

**Get to know us**
 In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.
   

  

 We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.
   

  

*This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.*
**Please note that, due to the summer holiday period, we will begin reviewing applications in August. We appreciate your patience and will be in touch with all candidates once the recruitment process resumes.**
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: Head of Data
description:
**Join our highly skilled team of engineers, data scientists and product managers — breaking new ground and shaping the future of retail.** 




  





**We dare to dream big, we have the courage to keep raising the bar, and we’re committed to being a force for good in retail - helping both established and fast-growing brands meet the ever-changing expectations of their customers.** 




  





**Sitoo is a fast-growing technology company exploring how far we can take innovation to deliver the world’s best Unified Commerce Platform and Point of Sale. Our technology is used in more than 20 countries - a number that keeps growing thanks to our incredible teams in Engineering & Product. And we have no intention of slowing down. Are you the Head of Data we’re looking for?** 




  





**Your mission at Sitoo** 




  





 At Sitoo, we believe that the most sophisticated technology should feel the most simple to the person using it. As Head of Data, you will lead a small but growing Data & Analytics team through its next phase, staying close to the work while building trusted data products, scalable analytics capabilities and better decision-making across Product, Engineering and the business. You will be a hands-on data leader who guides our data team into the next phase of maturity. This is a role for a doer who enjoys being close to execution, building the foundation with the team, and operationalizing our data strategy while we grow, all while reporting directly to the CPO.
 



  




* Execute and scale Sitoo’s data strategy, including internal analytics and selected customer-facing data opportunities.
* Own and prioritize the Data & Analytics roadmap, balancing foundational platform work with high-impact business and product use cases.
* Strengthen data quality practices for critical data domains, making data more reliable, observable and trusted.
* Build a governed data layer that can support better analytics, automation and future AI use cases.



  





**What you'll do** 




  




* You'll partner with the CPO and product leads to influence what gets built, bringing data-driven thinking into prioritization and ensuring we build for scale and insight.
* Own the data roadmap, evolving analytics from internal reporting to customer-facing value drivers.
* Establish a new data operating model, documenting workflows and using automation to remove organizational friction.
* Implement data quality and observability frameworks linked to product release cycles to increase reliability.
* Lead, mentor, and grow the data team through hands-on daily execution and priority setting.
* Drive a data-first culture by championing data literacy and ensuring actionable insights across the organization.
* Act as the primary data evangelist, using storytelling and operational alignment to foster organizational change.



  





**What you’ll bring to the table** 




  





 We are looking for a pragmatic data leader with a strong business mindset and the ability to turn data strategy into practical execution and business value. Whether your background is in Retail, Fintech, or complex Enterprise SaaS, what matters is your ability to operate as a strategic peer who can bridge the gap between technical infrastructure and business value.
 



  




* Proven track record of data leadership in fast-paced environments, with experience building and developing high-performing data teams
* Strategic thinking within a SaaS/Retail environment, with the ability to shape product prioritization through data-backed evidence
* Extensive experience with modern data infrastructure, cloud data warehouses, and implementing scalable governance frameworks
* Experience leveraging AI and machine learning models within data products to solve complex business problems
* Proven experience from building data platforms from the ground up and a strong desire to stay hands-on with implementation, data modelling, and architectural decisions.



  





**Why Sitoo** 




  





 We are forward thinkers. By turning curiosity into knowledge — and knowledge into continuous improvement — we break new ground and shape the future of retail.

title: Partner Account Manager
description:
*Are you excited by the opportunity to drive growth and shape the partner strategy for GlobalConnect in Sweden—connecting the Nordics’ leading fiber infrastructure provider with Swedish businesses and the connectivity solutions they need?*
 GlobalConnect has successfully built a strong partner business in Norway and Denmark, and now we’re accelerating the same journey in Sweden. As our new Partner Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in building and scaling our partner ecosystem; creating new revenue opportunities, expanding market reach, and enabling partners to win with GlobalConnect’s full portfolio.
   

  

 This is a high-impact opportunity for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategic partnerships, business development, and commercial execution in a market with a significant potential.
   

  

**What You Need To Succeed**
* Experience working with partner sales, channel sales, or partner management
* A strong background in B2B sales and business development
* Fluent Swedish and English
* Experience building relationships and driving business through indirect sales channels


**About The Role And The Team**
 You will be based in Stockholm and join a growing organization focused on expanding GlobalConnect's presence and growth in Sweden. You will work closely with colleagues across Sweden, Norway, and Denmark, as well as teams within sales, marketing, product, and delivery.
   

  

 The role is central to our ambition of building a strong partner network that can help bring GlobalConnect's solutions to more customers across the Swedish market.
   

  

**What You'll Be Working On**
* Identify and develop new partners across Sweden
* Build strong relationships with existing and future partners
* Support partners in understanding and selling the GlobalConnect portfolio
* Plan and execute partner events, webinars, and enablement activities
* Participate in customer meetings together with partners
* Drive revenue growth through partner-generated opportunities and sales


**Who We Are Looking For**
 You are a self-driven commercial professional who enjoys creating opportunities and building long-term relationships. You are motivated by achieving results and thrive in environments where you can take ownership and make an impact.
   

  

 You are comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with multiple stakeholders across different teams. Experience from telecom, IT or related industries is beneficial, but most importantly, you bring a strong understanding of how successful partner ecosystems are built and developed.
   

  

 Does the opportunity to establish and grow a partner business in Sweden sound exciting to you? Then this could be the next step in your career.
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
* Talent Acquisition Screening interview
* Hiring Manager interview
* Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition
* Case interview with Hiring Manager and peer/stakeholder
* Final alignment meeting
* References


 This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of GlobalConnect's partner business in Sweden while working with a proven model that has already delivered strong results in other markets.
   

  

 No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.
   

  

***Due to summer vacations we will continue the process mid august.***
 Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!
   

  

**About Us**
 GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.
   

  

 We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

title: Account Executive - Slack - Sweden
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Sales
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

 Slack is where work happens. Slack has transformed business communication.  Unleash Your Potential
