title: Produktägare inom Elmarknadsstöd
description:
Vill du arbeta i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT och vara med och utveckla hur elmarknadsdata tillgängliggörs och används? Som produktägare får du en central roll i att balansera behov, driva utveckling och säkerställa att lösningarna fungerar – både idag och i framtiden.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 I rollen som produktägare inom publicering av elmarknadsdata ansvarar du för att säkerställa att produktområdet effektivt stödjer verksamhetens förmågor, både idag och i framtiden. Du balanserar verksamhetens, användarnas och IT‑organisationens behov för att förvalta och vidareutveckla befintliga lösningar samt etablera nya vid förändrade krav. Du har ansvar för en eller flera produkter, där en produkt utgör en kombination av verksamhets- och IT‑komponenter som stödjer viktiga förmågor i kraftsystemet.
   

  

 Området ansvarar för lösningar som tillgängliggör elmarknadsdata för aktörer i Sverige och Europa och spelar därmed en viktig roll i elektrifieringen och utvecklingen av framtidens energisystem. Du kommer att samarbeta med experter både internt på Svenska kraftnät, hos andra Systemansvariga och leverantörer.
   

  

 Arbetsuppgifter:
   

  

* Inom ramen för de produkter du ansvarar för leder du produktens förvaltning och vidareutveckling samt etablering av nya lösningar utifrån förändrade behov, i nära samarbete med ett tvärfunktionellt förvaltningsteam.
* Ha nära kontakt med intressenter, förstå deras behov och balansera dem mot verksamhetens mål, tekniska förutsättningar och arkitekturprinciper.
* Skapa förståelse för produktområdet och hur förändringar i energisystem, regelverk och marknad påverkar det, samt bidra till dess utveckling för framtida behov av tillgängliga och transparenta elmarknadsdata.
* Driva både operativa och strategiska frågor med fokus på att säkerställa att produkten är ändamålsenlig och utvecklas i linje med verksamhetens långsiktiga behov.
* Representera produktområdet i nationella och internationella forum samt bidra med verksamhets- och produktperspektiv i frågor som rör produktens utveckling.


 Du tillhör enheten Elmarknadsstöd, som ansvarar för att stödja kärnverksamhetens processer inom drift och elmarknad med olika IT-stöd. Enheten består av 16 medarbetare med bred kompetens och olika roller. Här främjas tvärfunktionellt samarbete både inom division System och i nära samverkan med division IT, samt med andra delar av Svenska kraftnät och aktörer i Norden och Europa. Samarbete, ömsesidig stöttning och jämställdhet är centrala i det dagliga arbetet.
   

  

**Om dig**
**Skallkrav:**
 Då rollen innebär nära samarbete både internt och externt söker vi dig som trivs i samspel med andra och har förmåga att bygga och vårda förtroendefulla relationer. Du arbetar prestigelöst mot gemensamma mål och driver arbetet framåt på ett engagerat och målinriktat sätt.
   

  

 Du har en god analytisk förmåga och kan förstå komplexa sammanhang, se samband och fatta välgrundade beslut utan att tappa den långsiktiga strategiska riktningen. Du håller dig uppdaterad inom ditt område och följer utvecklingen för att säkerställa att produkten möter verksamhetens behov över tid.
   

  

 Du ska också leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden.
   

  

 I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

 Vidare har du en civilingenjörs- eller masterexamen inom relevant område (exempelvis energisystem), alternativt annan utbildning och/eller arbetserfarenhet som Svenska kraftnät anser likvärdigt.
   

  

 Du har även:
   

  

* Minst 5 års erfarenhet från produktledning med ansvar för produktförvaltning och produktutveckling, där rollen innefattat arbete på operativ och strategisk nivå i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT.
* Erfarenhet av IT system med hantering av stora datamängder samt komplexa dataflöden och systemintegrationer.
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av kravhantering, inklusive att samla in, analysera och konkretisera behov.
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.


**Meriterande**
 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Arbete med öppna data (open data), dataplattformar eller lösningar för data publicering och transparens.
* Arbete med regelverk och regulatoriska krav inom energimarknaden, exempelvis transparenskrav och EU-reglering (t.ex. ENTSO-E, REMIT).
* Arbete inom svensk eller nordisk elmarknad som inkluderat internationella samarbeten.
* Erfarenhet av kontrollrumsnära verksamhet.
* Arbete inom förvaltningsmodellen pm3 eller liknande förvaltningsmodell.


**Bra att veta**
* Tjänsten är placerad i Sundbyberg.
* Möjlighet till distansarbete upp till 50 % .
* Resor inom och utanför Norden kan förekomma.
* Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning.
* Sista ansökningsdag är den 17 augusti 2026.
* Istället för att bifoga ett personligt brev till din ansökan besvarar du ett antal frågor i ansökningsformuläret.
* Individuell lönesättning tillämpas och sker i enlighet med de centrala löneavtalen RALS/RALS-T.
* Förmåner | Svenska kraftnät


**Vid frågor, kontakta gärna följande personer:**
* Vid frågor om tjänsten: Madalena Afram, rekryterande chef, 010 475 82 99.
* Vid frågor om rekryteringsprocessen: Linda Mattsson, ansvarig rekryterare, 010 350 91 47.
* Annika Ingeborn, facklig representant SACO, 010 475 87 72.
* Erica Midfjäll, facklig representant ST, 010 475 87 31.


 Under semestertider nås vi via e-post: Förnamn.Efternamn@svk.se. Svarstiden under denna period kan vara längre än vanligt. Vi går igenom ansökningar och återkopplar om du går vidare i processen först efter sista ansökningsdag.
   

  

 Jobba här – bli en viktig del av vår energiframtid | Svenska kraftnät
   

  

 Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare i samband med rekrytering, vi har upphandlade avtal som gäller för Svenska kraftnät som statlig myndighet.
   

  

 Övrig information
   

  

 Vi ställer höga krav på våra medarbetares säkerhets- och sekretess-medvetenhet. Inför anställning genomförs säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) vilket innefattar grundutredning och om anställningen avser befattning i säkerhetsklass kommer säkerhetsprövningen även att innefatta en registerkontroll. För anställning på Svenska kraftnät kan det vara ett krav på svenskt medborgarskap i vissa befattningar. Med anställningen följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. För mer information om personalsäkerhet på svenska kraftnät. https://www.svk.se/sakerhet-och-beredskap/sakerhetsskydd/personalsakerhet

title: International Key Account Manager
description:
Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for building long-term client relationships on a global scale? We are seeking an experienced and driven International Key Account Manager to lead and grow relationships with our most critical international clients. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for global accounts, working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver tailored solutions, drive merchant success, and ensure consistent value delivery across markets. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of high-impact partnerships and contribute directly to our global growth strategy.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 In this role, you won’t just manage accounts – you’ll be responsible for developing deep relationships with international merchants, understanding their business needs, and aligning our solutions to support their long-term success. You’ll work cross-functionally to ensure that Instabee delivers a seamless experience, while also using data and insights to identify growth opportunities and track performance.
   

  

**Strategic Account Management:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of Global Merchants. Build long-term partnerships by deeply understanding their business goals and offering tailored solutions.
   

  

**Business Growth:** 
 Drive merchant adoption of our services.
   

  

**Market Expertise:** 
 Stay abreast of trends in European e-commerce. Use insights to advise merchants on best practices and future-proof strategies.
   

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Work closely with internal teams such as product development, operations and merchant success to ensure merchants have a seamless experience with Instabee. Data-Driven Insights: Leverage data analytics to monitor merchant performance, identify areas for improvement, and track the success.
   

  

**Advocacy:** 
 Represent the voice of Global merchants within the organization, advocating for their needs to influence product enhancements and service delivery.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 We believe you are a relationship builder at heart, with the ability to navigate complex organisations and influence senior stakeholders. You are equally comfortable driving strategic conversations with executives as you are digging into performance data to identify practical improvements. With a balance of commercial acumen and strong interpersonal skills, you know how to create value for both merchants and Instabee.
   

  

* Education in Business Administration or a related field
* Ability to take initiative and work independently
* Proven experience in managing global or key accounts
* Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
* Ability to navigate complex organizations
* Proficiency in CRM tools and data-driven decision making
* Cross-cultural awareness and adaptability
* Strong negotiation and presentation skills
* Willingness to travel internationally as required


**What You’ll Get**
 We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!
   

  

**Benefits**
 Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:
   

  

* 🌇 Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.
* 🐶 Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!
* 🏓 Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.
* 👶 Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.
* 🎂 A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!
* ⏰ Hybrid setup and flexible working hours


 Diversity and inclusion is very important to us and we are committed to creating an inclusive work environment. We want to be a workplace where everyone’s perspectives and opinions are valued, and we are dedicated to creating opportunities for all employees to thrive and reach their full potential.
   

  

**Get to know us**
 In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.
   

  

 We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.
   

  

*This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.*
**Please note that, due to the summer holiday period, we will begin reviewing applications in August. We appreciate your patience and will be in touch with all candidates once the recruitment process resumes.**
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: Lead Operator (Clinical Team Lead)
description:
**Mission**
 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
   

  

 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The Lead Operator is responsible for the day-to-day performance of the operator team and the overall quality of scanning operations and member experience. Reporting to the Clinic Lead, the Lead Operator acts as the primary interface between HQ operational functions and the clinic floor, translating standards and priorities into consistent, high-quality delivery.
   

  

 This role is for someone who leads by example: a technically excellent operator who brings genuine people leadership capability, and a strong commitment to member experience. You will directly manage the operator team and work in close partnership with the Clinic Lead to keep the clinic running at its best every day.
   

  

**What You'll Deliver In The First 6–12 Months**
* Lead and coach the operator team through structured 1:1s, clear standards, and consistent embedding of Neko values.
* Act as the operational escalation point on the floor, triaging issues calmly and decisively.
* Own daily operator workflow, room readiness, and shift scheduling so the clinic runs efficiently at all times.
* Monitor operator KPIs, and drive continuous improvement.
* Support operator recruitment and lead on-floor training and competency checks.
* Ensure safety compliance and clinic floor standards, escalating equipment or environmental issues as needed.
* Partner with Operations, People, Training, Facilities, Tech, and Governance on scheduling, performance, and audit readiness.
* Remain hands-on and visible as a scanning operator, role-modelling the standards expected of the team.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Healthcare education background, preferably as a registered nurse or assistant nurse.
* Highly proficient clinician, leading by example in phlebotomy, and hands-on clinical/technical experience.
* Previous team management experience.
* Proficiency in Swedish and English.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously without compromising quality or patient experience.
* Clear, direct, and effective communicator across all levels of the team and with patients.


**Application Deadline**
 10th August. Please note that applications will be reviewed after the application deadline.
   

  

**About Titles At Neko**
 We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so internal titles may differ from market‑facing role titles. Scope, impact and level of the role are fully aligned and will be clearly discussed throughout the process.
   

  

**Hiring Process**
 Candidates progress from application and structured screening through thoughtfully designed interviews culminating in a formal offer and final pre-employment checks before joining the team.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity & Inclusion Statement**
 Neko Health is committed to inclusive hiring and member-first care. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to request reasonable adjustments to support your application.

title: ILS Engineer
description:
Har du en strukturerad och analytisk arbetsstil och är prestigelös i ditt sätt att samarbeta?
   

  

 MilDef expanderar sitt team i Stockholm (Rosersberg) och söker nu engagerade ILS-ingenjörer som vill vara med och forma framtidens försvarssystem.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder en dynamisk arbetsmiljö, där det händer mycket och där din roll kommer att utvecklas över tid.
   

  

****Din nya utmaning****
 Som ILS-ingenjör hos oss kommer du att arbeta med att säkerställa effektivitet och hållbarhet hos framtidens försvarssystem genom hela dess livscykel. Det innebär att du kommer planera, analysera och optimera allt från underhåll och reservdelar till teknisk information och driftsäkerhet. Du kommer att samarbeta med olika verksamhetsområden, inklusive projektledning, systemsäkerhet, inköp och konstruktionsavdelning.
   

  

 Vi söker både dig som har erfarenhet av områden inom ILS eller dig som är i starten av din ILS-karriär.
   

  

 Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av ett eller flera om följande områden:
   

  

**Planering och Ledning**
* Ansvara för att leda, planera och genomföra ILS arbete i tid och enligt specifikation.
* Förbättra och utveckla arbetsmetoder, arbetssätt och verktyg för ILS-arbetet.


**Analys och Beräkningar**
* Driftsäkerhetsanalyser (ARMS)
* Livscykelkostnadsanalyser (LCC)
* Felmodsanalys (FMECA):
* Level of Repair Analysis (LORA)
* Underhållsberedning och analyser runt reservdelsbehov/optimering.


****Teknisk Information****
* Utarbeta teknisk information
* Säkerställa att all teknisk dokumentation är uppdaterad och följer relevanta standarder (t.ex. ASD S1000D).
* Skapa och uppdatera underhållsplaner och instruktioner
* Hantering av förnödenhetsregister (GOF): Administrera och uppdatera register över förnödenheter och reservdelar.


****Vi söker dig med****
 Vi söker dig som har en eftergymnasial teknisk utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet och som har ett genuint intresse för teknik och systematiskt arbete. Du har viss eller längre erfarenhet av ILS-arbete och en god teknisk förståelse, liksom god IT-vana och kunskaper i Office-paketet.
   

  

 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet inom ILS eller närliggande områden, kunskap om ILS-standarder eller bakgrund inom Försvarsmakten. Som person är du analytisk, noggrann och detaljorienterad – samtidigt som du trivs med att samarbeta och bidra till teamets gemensamma mål.
   

  

 Du talar och skriver flytande svenska och engelska. Resor i tjänsten kan förekomma.
   

  

****Vad vi erbjuder dig****
* En engagerande och utvecklande roll i ett ledande företag i en expansiv bransch.
* Möjlighet att arbeta med projekt som bidrar till nationell säkerhet och försvar.
* En samarbetsvillig och stöttande arbetsmiljö med engagerade kollegor.
* Kollektivavtal (Teknikföretagen).
* Wellnessteam och friskvårdsbidrag.
* Eget gym med bastu.
* Årliga hälsoundersökningar.
* Happiness-team som ordnar med roliga och personalvårdande aktiviteter.
* Arbete i nybyggda ändamålsenliga lokaler vid Rosersbergs pendeltågsstation.


****Lär känna oss****
 På MilDef blir du en del av ett företag som värdesätter praktiskt engagemang, gemenskap och utveckling av ledande försvarsteknik. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla nya färdigheter, bidra i tvärfunktionella projekt och göra en konkret skillnad för vår fortsatta framgång. title: Research Engineering Lead
description:
**TL;DR** 
 - We’re looking for a hands-on research and engineering leader to get the best performance out of commercial and open source frontier models, in order to power the future of AI software engineering. You’ll own experiments end-to-end—from dataset design to model alignment and performance optimization. Must be curious, experimental, and obsessed with squeezing the most out of models.ae
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with plain English. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Over 2 million people in 200+ countries already use Lovable to launch businesses, automate work, and bring their ideas to life. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* Led or contributed to cutting-edge LLM research at top AI labs
* Fine-tuned large-scale transformer models on datasets including code, natural language, and multimodal inputs`
* Developed state-of-the-art models for code generation
* Designed high-quality experiments and have strong sense for effective evaluation
* A natural leader obsessed with building the best technical team in the world
* Mentored team of researchers / engineers, and led collaborative projects across research, engineering, and product teams
* Bonus: Published at top ML/AI conferences on LLMs, code intelligence, or agentic reasoning


**What You’ll Do**
**In one sentence** 
 : Build the most powerful ensemble of LLMs into lovable products.
   

  

* Design and execute experiments grounded in real coding and product use cases
* Define, track and optimize product-centric LLM performance metrics
* Partner with engineering leads to hire and hone a world-class team
* Own training pipelines, distillation workflows, and synthetic data generation systems
* Work closely with infra and product engineers to scale and ship model improvements


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:
   

  

* Frontend: React for lightning-fast interfaces
* Backend: Golang and Rust for serious performance
* Cloud: Cloudflare, Google Cloud Run, AWS, Terraform
* DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, observability, infra-as-code


 And always on the lookout for what's next!
   

  

**How We Hire**
* Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with the team.
* Complete the take-home exercise
* Show us how you approach problems during two technical interviews
* Join us for trial work lasting 2 days preferably on-site. We'll see how you tick and you get to meet the team and explore whether joining Lovable feels right for you.


**About Your Application**
* Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal

title: Team Manager – Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
description:
Som Team Manager för ERP leder du ett DevOps-team som har nordiskt ansvar för både utveckling och drift av affärskritiska system. Du kliver in i en roll där du får ett helhetsansvar för ett erfaret team och där ni tillsammans med andra, driver utveckling, stabilitet och affärsvärde i en komplex och central del av vår svenska och danska IT-miljö.
  
  

Om rollen
  
  

I rollen som Team Manager inom Enterprise Solutions får du ett brett ansvar där teknik, affärsnytta och ledarskap möts. Du leder ett team på cirka 12 personer, inklusive konsulter, med ansvar för utveckling, drift och förvaltning av produktområdet ERP.
  
  

Du arbetar nära arkitekter, plattformsteam, produktägare och slutanvändare för att säkerställa att lösningarna stödjer både affärsbehov och tekniska mål. En viktig del av rollen är att bidra till harmonisering av systemlandskap och processer i en nordisk kontext där finans-, logistik-, samt HR-organisationer i både Sverige och Danmark ska fungera tillsammans.
  
  

Du ansvarar för teamets roadmap, kapacitetsplanering och prioriteringar, samt säkerställer en stabil och säker drift genom ett aktivt arbete med livscykelhantering, incidenthantering och regelefterlevnad. Rollen innefattar även att driva och vidareutveckla teamets arbetssätt genom att ta DevOps-arbetet till nästa nivå. En central del av uppdraget är att driva automatisering av flöden, där AI är ett naturligt verktyg för att effektivisera och förbättra kvaliteten för både ditt och affärsområdenas team.
  
  

I din roll som ledare
  
  

Som ledare på Tre är du tydlig och framåtriktad samtidigt som du är närvarande och coachande i vardagen. Du skapar förutsättningar för teamet att ta ett gemensamt ansvar för hela leveransen – från analys, utveckling, till produktion och vidare drift.
  
  

Du driver aktivt en kultur präglad av samarbete, ansvarstagande och kontinuerligt lärande. I rollen ingår du i ledningsgruppen för Enterprise Solutions, där ni tillsammans driver den övergripande utvecklingen av området. Du verkar i en miljö under förändring som ställer höga krav på ett tryggt, tydligt och engagerande ledarskap.
  
  

Du kan se fram emot att
  
  

leda ett team med bred kompetens och stort ansvar i en affärskritisk del av verksamheten
  
tillsammans med andra teknikledare driva utvecklingen mot en mer mogen DevOps-organisation med fokus på kontinuerliga förbättringar, automatisering och AI-katalysator
  
vara en del av att leverera kritisk infrastruktur och bidra direkt till samhällsnyttan
  
ta dig an en roll som både utvecklar och utmanar dig i ditt ledarskap
  
vara en del av en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place To Work, samt arbeta i en organisation som är stolt samarbetspartner till Women in Tech och Tjejer Kodar
  
Några av våra medarbetare
  
Julia Maxén
  
Gruppchef
  
"Jag vill att mitt team ska få de bästa förutsättningarna för att göra sitt jobb på bästa sätt. Det är så vi utvecklar oss som team, men även utvecklar Tre framåt."
  
Henrik Sundvall
  
Digital projektledare
  
"Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"
  
Jayasri Battola
  
Utvecklare
  
"The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."
  
  

Lite mer om dig
  
  

Ditt ledarskap präglas av ett coachande och situationsanpassat förhållningssätt. Du är trygg i att leda andra, bygger tillit genom tydlighet och närvaro och drivs av att utveckla både individer och team. Du är nyfiken och trivs i förändring, där du aktivt itererar arbetssätt för att nå i mål tillsammans med andra.
  
  

Du har en stark teknisk förståelse och erfarenhet av att arbeta i komplexa IT-miljöer där många system samverkar. Du är van vid DevOps, systemutvecklingens livscykel och agila arbetssätt, och har själv en operativ bakgrund inom en teknikorganisation. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med Oracle ERP.
  
  

Vi ser att du har flera års erfarenhet av att leda teknisk leverans, där du tagit ansvar för prioritering, planering och genomförande. Du har mångårig erfarenhet av informellt ledarskap och det är meriterande om du haft personalansvar.

title: Engineering Support Analyst
description:
Job Description
  
To support and maintain the Kindred Racing Platform (KRP) and Kindred Sports Platform (KSP) through debugging and analysis, and to assist global stakeholders in minimising downtime during incidents.
  
Main Duties / Responsibilities
  
As an Engineering Support Analyst, you will be responsible for identifying and resolving issues within various components of critical business systems. Your role will involve providing dynamic service and acting as a software detective to ensure the smooth functioning of systems. This includes triaging bugs, escalating tickets with comprehensive information, responding to alerts, and initiating On-Call when necessary, all while maintaining clear and effective communication.
  
Working alongside stakeholders including Traders, Developers, DevOps, and SRE teams.
  
Provide technical support for critical business systems, ensuring timely identification and resolution of issues.
  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to maintain seamless system functionality.
  
Conduct root cause analysis to identify and address underlying issues and implement preventive measures to avoid future occurrences.
  
Demonstrate a solid understanding of software engineering principles and practices.
  
Collaborate / Handover with colleagues in Bangalore and Australia (IST & AEDT).
  
  

Key Accountabilities / Measures
  
Provide comprehensive support for global stakeholders.
  
Drive issues to resolution efficiently and effectively.
  
Monitor and utilise alerts to promptly address incidents.
  
Enhance reliability by pushing capabilities forward and innovating for continuous improvement.
  
  

Preferred Experience and Knowledge
  
2-3 years of proven experience in providing technical support for critical business systems.
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, essential for working with global stakeholders.
  
Extensive knowledge of support principles, including incident and problem management.
  
Desirable knowledge in server stack and website support.
  
Extensive experience in issue debugging, analysis, and resolution.
  
Required experience and understanding of the following toolsets:
  
Experience
  
Elastic / Grafana / Splunk
  
Prometheus / Loki / Tempo
  
Understanding
  
Kubernetes/Docker
  
Linux / Windows
  
Solace / Kafka
  
Postgres
  
Experience in creating Grafana dashboards, integrating metrics, logs, and traces to provide a proactive approach to error detection.
  
Testing experience is a definite advantage.
  
  

Essential Educational and/or Training Qualifications & Certificates
  
A tertiary qualification in an Information Technology-related discipline is highly desirable.

title: Product Manager - Private Markets Platform
description:
### **About ROYC**


ROYC is the operating system for private markets. Founded by leaders from Blackstone, Nordea, and Klarna, we provide one operating layer for every private markets workflow, helping fund managers, private banks, wealth managers and multi-family offices deploy private market strategies at scale. By combining technology, structuring and operational services, ROYC replaces fragmented tools and manual processes with one structured operating layer across the full lifecycle: from investor readiness and KYC to subscriptions, capital calls, reporting, and long-term servicing. Our goal is to become the leading AI-native private markets infrastructure platform for launching, marketing and operating funds across Europe, the Middle East and Asia.


Our team is a diverse and international group of people who bring creativity, energy, and a sharp eye for what actually matters to every situation. We offer a fun and dynamic scale-up atmosphere, paired with the resources to deliver, and a rapid path from concept to production.

### **What we're looking for**

* 5+ years of experience in product management, ideally shipping complex B2B, fintech (or other regulated industries) products used by demanding professional users
* Strong experience turning product requirements into well-scoped, shippable work in close collaboration with design and engineering
* Ability to make smart trade-offs between speed and polish, knowing when to ship and when to refine
* Strong understanding of the frontend ecosystem (React/TypeScript) and enough technical fluency to work closely with engineers on trade-offs and feasibility
* Experience translating complex, regulated workflows into simple, intuitive product experiences
* Proficiency in AI supported prototyping tools (Figma/Lovable/Claude) for collaborating on flows, wireframes, and specs
* Strong product sense with an eye for detail, data-informed decision-making, and usability
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to align stakeholders across design, engineering, and business

### **What you'll do**


In one sentence: Help shape and deliver ROYC's product experience, turning complex financial workflows into intuitive, magical experiences.

* Own and drive execution across key parts of the platform, working closely with design and engineering to ship high-quality features
* Translate product priorities into clear requirements, specs, and well-organized backlogs
* Partner closely with design to shape new interaction patterns and experiences, and with engineering to scope and ship them
* Support discovery efforts with fund managers, private banks, wealth managers, and multi-family offices to understand user needs and pain points
* Help define and track success metrics, using data and user feedback to continuously improve the product
* Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, design, and product teams to bring complex financial workflows to life in a seamless way
* Help balance regulatory and compliance requirements with a best-in-class user experience

### **Our tech stack**


We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

* **Frontend:** React, TypeScript, Tailwind
* **Backend:** TypeScript, NestJS, Python
* **Cloud:** AWS, with infrastructure-as-code via CDK
* **DevOps & Tooling:** GitHub Actions, Datadog
* **Project Management:** Notion our main working tool

### **How we hire**

* Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call
* Connect with the team and learn more about how we work
* Show us how you approach problems during a hands-on case study or product exercise

### **Benefits**

* Competitive compensation structure including bonus scheme
* Health benefits including fitness allowance
* Work with some of the best in the industry

**About Your Application**
--------------------------


This is a full-time, permanent position. We review applications on a rolling basis, the right candidate can start immediately.


Location: Central Stockholm (Hybrid, 3 days/week in office)


Please submit your application in English, it's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.

title: Testledare
description:
Om Kriminalvården Kriminalvården växer – vi bygger nytt, bygger om och bygger till och söker nu fler medarbetare. Vårt viktigaste mål är att minska återfall i brott – att bryta den onda cirkeln. Lyckas vi med det blir samhället tryggare och säkrare för alla. Vi är den myndighet som ansvarar för anstalter, frivård, häkten och klienttransporter.


Vill du vara med och bidra till ett tryggare samhälle? Vår IT-avdelning genomför en stor satsning med fokus på en digital Kriminalvård. Tillsammans jobbar vi för att skapa förutsättningar och lösningar som gör skillnad i vår verksamhet. IT-avdelningen är under stark tillväxt. Vi söker dig som har ett stort IT-intresse, kunskaper och erfarenheter som kan berika vår digitaliseringsresa och som vill vara med och göra skillnad i samhället inom just din profession.


Sektionen för IT applikationer HR, Ekonomi och Fastighet inom IT-avdelningen har ansvar för att driva utveckling och förvalta myndighetens standardapplikationer inom dessa områden som nyttjas av både kärnverksamheten men även i våra stödprocesser.

### **Arbetsbeskrivning**


I rollen som Testledare på Kriminalvården arbetar du med att leda och driva testarbetet inom flera olika områden. Du kommer att arbeta tätt tillsammans med övriga kollegor inom både verksamhet och IT. Testledaren arbetar både i löpande förvaltning med exempelvis uppgraderingar, men kan även bli involverad i projekt. De upphandlingsprojekt som Kriminalvården bedriver kräver också testledning för att verifiera att de krav som är ställda på systemen är uppfyllda

### **Kvalifikationer**


Vi söker dig som är självgående och som tar ett stort ansvar över dina uppgifter. Du är strukturerad och planerar, organiserar och prioriterar ditt arbete på ett effektivt sätt samt driver dina processer framåt med gott resultat. I ditt arbete sätter du både upp och håller tidsramar och deadlines. Vidare är du initiativtagande och flexibel. Du sätter igång aktiviteter som driver arbetet framåt men du har också en förmåga att kunna anpassa dig utifrån ändrade omständigheter. Du ser möjligheterna som kommer med förändring. Slutligen har du förmågan att samarbeta med andra människor och är både lyhörd och smidig i din kommunikation.


För oss är det viktigt att du delar Kriminalvårdens grundläggande värderingar om en human människosyn, respekt för individen samt tron på människans vilja och förmåga att utvecklas. Du är även medveten om och har förståelse för hur bakgrund, kultur och grupptillhörighet påverkar dig själv och andra. Vidare förväntas du med ditt förhållningssätt bidra till att alla blir likvärdigt bemötta. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.  

  

Vi söker dig som har:

* Akademisk examen inom relevant ämnesområde som exempelvis datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller liknande alternativt annan utbildning i kombination erfarenhet som Kriminalvården bedömer relevant
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av testledning i komplexa miljöer
* Arbetat med att ta fram teststrategier och planer samt uppföljningen av planerade tester.
* Erfarenhet av att säkerställa att testfall är spårbara från krav och har rätt nivå
* Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt som exempelvis Scrum eller Kanban
* Erfarenhet av att leda och samverka med andra inom IT och verksamhet
* Erfarenhet av acceptanstestning och förmåga att leda verksamheter genom testprocessen
* Kunskap om testfallsdesign
* Förmåga att uttrycka sig väl i tal och skrift på svenska.

#### **Det är även meriterande med:**

* Certifiering inom testledning (ISTQB)
* Erfarenhet av arbete med Azure DevOps Testplans
* Erfarenhet av arbete med testautomation
* Erfarenhet av arbete med integrationer
* Erfarenhet av arbete med upphandlade standardsystem
* Erfarenhet av testledning för standardsystem


Övrigt Kriminalvården har valt att ta bort det personliga brevet och ersatt det med urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Svaren i urvalsfrågorna och CV ligger till grund för om du är kvalificerad att gå vidare i processen. För att bli aktuell för anställning inom Kriminalvården krävs att du motsvarar högt ställda krav gällande lämplighet, omdöme, säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetande och att du följer gällande lagar. Det innebär att du står upp för demokratiska värderingar och den statliga värdegrund som gäller för Kriminalvårdens verksamhet. Vissa befattningar är placerade i säkerhetsklass och då kommer en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll att genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas. För vissa säkerhetsklassade tjänster krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Kriminalvården välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Läs mer om säkerhetsprövning här: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/rekryteringsprocessen/sakerhetsprovning-vid-rekrytering/ Befattningen kan innebära krigsplacering vid Kriminalvården. Läs mer om krigsplacering här: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/rekryteringsprocessen/krigsplacering/ Individuell lönesättning tillämpas. Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas. Kriminalvården strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ökad mångfald. För att skicka in din ansökan, klicka på ansökningslänken i annonsen. Frågor om hur du ansöker och lägger in ditt CV ställer du direkt till Varbi. Frågor om specifika jobb besvaras av den kontaktperson som anges i annonsen. Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av rekryteringsannonser. Kriminalvården har upphandlade avtal.

title: Solutions Architect, Software and Technology Companies (ISV)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you passionate about cloud technology and helping customers innovate?  

  

Join our AWS Solutions Architecture team in Sweden and empower Software, SaaS and Technology Companies to innovate at speed and scale with cloud technologies.  

  

Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. Solutions Architects are responsible for creating and presenting technical content and sharing best practices.  

  

They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. They help customer's validate their initiatives from ideation to proof of concept. Solutions Architects lead activities such as architecture reviews, white-boarding sessions, demos and technical workshops. They collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, Industry experts, support, service teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.  

  

Amongst others you will be part of the design and building of reference architectures, proof of concepts and help customer deploy production workloads on AWS. You will also provide thought leadership and recommendations on cloud architecture, migration, modernization and operation. Build strong technical relationships acting as the voice of the customer internally to influence AWS service roadmaps.  

  

At Amazon you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of the customer. We value your passion to discover, invent and build on behalf of customers.  

  

Amazon has always been, and always will be, committed to diversity and inclusion. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.  

  

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and dedicated support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Work directly with strategic customers to accelerate their challenging, mission-critical projects and recommend best-practice architectures in line with their long-term business outcomes
* Build technical relationships with customers and operate as their trusted advisor. The best interests of the customer will shape the guidance you provide.
* Share the voice of the customer to inform the roadmap of AWS features.
* Participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts).
* Evangelise and educate customers about AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
* Contribute to the growth of the Solutions Architecture organisation by interviewing candidates and having a voice in hiring decisions. You will also be helping others develop new skills by mentoring team members and identifying talent needs in the organisation.
* Develop areas of depth in technical domains relevant to our outcomes.

  

A day in the life  

You will have the opportunity to work with account managers to help customers accelerate their cloud implementation to modernize their business on AWS. Working with these customers, you will help them transform existing workloads by designing modern target architectures optimized for business agility, innovation, performance, resiliency, cost, security, and more using both native and partner solutions.  

  

Our teams focus on understanding customer key business drivers as well as the existing application architecture(s) to deliver a technical recommendation to the customer with a goal of designing a robust cloud architecture that can scale as their business requires.  

  

About the team  

Our Solutions Architecture team empowers innovators to invent on behalf of customers. We are obsessed with understanding each customer's unique objectives to deliver optimal architectures tailored to their needs. Our culture celebrates talented, curious, motivated team members who take ownership of projects. We move with urgency, take risks, learn continuously, and maintain a friendly, inclusive environment. Join our team if you are passionate about technology and delighting customers.  

  

Your direct team is located across the Nordics and you would work in close collaboration with team members in Sweden and across borders.
  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship & Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Background in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, or DevOps
* Technical Degree (Computer Science, Maths, Engineering or equivalent) and/or relevant tech experience.
* Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English
* A passion for technology and for learning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience designing, building, refactoring or operating IT systems in the cloud
* Working knowledge of software development practices and technologies highly desired
* AWS Certification, eg. AWS Solutions Architect Associate

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: DevOps Engineer, Kafka
description:
At Tele2, we challenge the telecom industry to create more valuable solutions for our customers. Guided by our challenger mindset, we deliver high-quality connectivity and digital services, ranging from mobile and fixed networks to TV, streaming and global IoT.
   

  

 Sustainability is an integral part of how we work. Tele2 has been recognized as a climate leader in Europe by the Financial Times and named Sweden’s most sustainable company, reflecting our long-term commitment to reducing our environmental impact and advancing circular solutions together with our customers.
   

  

 Our values – Be Brave, Take Action, Make it Simple and Act Cost-efficiently – guide our culture, how we collaborate and how we turn ideas into action.
   

  

***Are you a passionate developer ready to build the data backbone for the future of AI?***
 Join our Data Distribution team and become a master of Kafka!
   

  

 You will be part of our dynamic team at Tele2, where Digital Capabilities & Technology (DCT) is the engine behind our products and services. As the essential enabler of our commercial ambitions, DCT brings automation and simplicity to the telecommunications industry, revolutionizing the way we connect and communicate.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will be a part of the IAM & Data Distribution group, where you will take on a key role in managing and evolving Kafka, one of Tele2's strategic platforms. We enable the seamless and secure flow of data between all our critical systems. With a growing focus on data as the primary enabler for AI and advanced analytics, you will be at the center of innovation, helping us take our Kafka service to the next level.
   

  

 This is a role truly with the DevOps mindset in its foundation. You will help the organization in how to federate data, making it accessible in various forms for our many stakeholders and above all always with the bigger picture in mind – Enabling Tele2 to become automated & data-driven.
   

  

 Your tasks and responsibilities will include (but not be limited to):
   

  

* Develop, maintain, and enhance our strategic Kafka platform.
* Support, improve & be part of the governance structure so everyone follows the same guidelines
* Implement and manage comprehensive monitoring and alerting to ensure service reliability and performance.
* Collaborate closely with various development teams and stakeholders to support their data integration needs.
* Act as a key player in the evolution of our data distribution services, driving improvements and adopting new technologies & ways of thinking.
* Embrace a true DevOps mindset, taking full ownership of the service from code to production.


**What We Look For**
 To be successful in this role, we believe you are a developer who loves to build robust code and understands the bigger picture. You are driven by the desire to be involved, exert influence, and create an impact while prioritizing quality and reliability.
   

  

 To thrive in this role, we believe that you have:
   

  

* Solid experience in software development (e.g., Java, Python & Go are preferable but not mandatory).
* A strong interest in data streaming, event-driven architecture, and technologies like Kafka (direct Kafka experience is a plus, but not a requirement).
* A good understanding of system integrations and how data flows between applications.
* A curious mindset with a passion for learning and tackling new challenges.
* A DevOps mindset, with an appreciation for automation, monitoring, and the operational aspects of a service.


**Benefits**
 Pension and health care
   

  

 Hybrid and flexible work life balance
   

  

 Career opportunities
   

  

 Parental benefit
   

  

 Employee benefits and Tele2 discounts
   

  

 Inclusive workplace

title: Senior Infrastructure Platform Engineer
description:
Flightradar24 is one of the most successful growth-stage tech companies in Stockholm. Each month more than 50 million aviation enthusiasts visit Flightradar24 (app/website) and our Commercial services team has many of the biggest names in aviation on its customer list.
 



 We are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Platform Engineer to join our growing Infrastructure team and help us build, scale, and maintain our cloud infrastructure and services in AWS.
 



  





**The position requires that you are able to work in Stockholm, Sweden. Relocation is not offered for this role.** 




  





**What you’ll do** 




**Your responsibilities include:** 



* Design, implement, and manage reliable infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code principles
* Work closely with developers to streamline CI/CD pipelines and improve deployment speed and stability
* Ensure high availability, security, and performance across our AWS services
* Monitor systems, troubleshoot incidents, and continuously improve observability and resilience
* Own database infrastructure, incl. provisioning , migrations, backups, replication, performance tuning
* Build and operate an internal developer platform that provides reproducible environments.



  





**Required technical competence** 



* Hands-on experience with AWS services such as EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, and IAM
* Experience with Terraform, Ansible, Docker and Kubernetes
* Cloud & Data Platform on AWS, Streaming & Messaging: Kafka, RabbitMQ
* Databases & Storage: SQL/NoSQL systems (e.g. MySQL/MariaDB/Postgres, Redis, DynamoDB, data lake/warehouse patterns)

* Self-driven and comfortable making technical decisions independently

* Flexible and social work environment with free beverages, fruit, and snacks

title: Senior Platform Engineer

* Hands-on experience running Kubernetes production environments.

 Tech Stack / Environment: GCP, GKE, ArgoCD, Gatekeeper, Cilium, Terraform, CircleCI, GitHub, Cloudflare, Datadog, incident.io, Snowflake, DBT, Hex, Go, Python, Next.js
   

  

**Nice To Have**

* Strong networking knowledge across cloud and Kubernetes environments.
* Interest in the Agentic AI ecosystem

**What We Offer**
 At EQT, you will work in a collaborative and high-trust environment where your ideas and contributions matter. You will have the opportunity to shape a modern engineering platform, work with experienced colleagues, and continue to grow your skills while delivering meaningful impact.

title: Engineering Manager - Cloud & Platform Operations
description:
At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for an Engineering Manager for Cloud & Platform Operations for the next phase of growth.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Engineering Manager for Cloud & Platform Operations, you will bridge the gap between technical execution and business impact by taking end-to-end ownership of our foundational internal systems and workplace technology architecture. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will lead a critical function that optimizes company-wide efficiency, secures our digital environment, and ensures our platforms scale seamlessly alongside our growing fintech operations - from core cloud operations to the internal systems and workplace tooling the company relies on. This is a mission-oriented leadership role where your strategic planning directly empowers employees across the bank.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Own cloud infrastructure operations across all markets - availability, performance, resilience, and disaster recovery.
* Run FinOps: cost visibility, forecasting, Reserved Instances/Savings Plans, and per-account budgeting - with clear reporting to leadership.
* Build self-service platform capabilities (CI/CD, IaC, observability, secrets) that reduce friction for product teams.
* Embed regulatory controls (DORA, EBA outsourcing, GDPR) into how we operate, with audit readiness as a default.
* Manage data residency, IAM, least-privilege, and third-party/concentration risk.
* Implement and govern privileged access management (PAM) - just-in-time access, and audit trails for sensitive systems.
* Drive workplace IT automation and run a set of internal services streamlining employee permissions, SaaS management, and the day-to-day tooling the company relies on.
* Hire, grow, and retain a strong team while managing a broad ownership scope.


 What we’re looking for
   

  

 We are looking for a leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and brings a structured approach to technical operations. You have a proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment with legal, security, and engineering teams while maintaining a strong proactive mindset. You are motivated by building scalable frameworks, minimizing security risks, and automating manual workflows to eliminate operational friction.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Several years of technical leadership or people management experience within a Cloud Infrastructure function, with a style that's hands-on enough to be credible and strategic enough to scale a lean team.
* Proven experience with cloud environment billing structures, specifically AWS cloud, GCP/Google Workspace, and SaaS license management.
* Strong grounding in platform/SRE practices: IaC, observability, incident management, and automation for access management and identity provisioning.
* Background working in regulated environments, banking, or fintech, with a solid understanding of ICT compliance, audits, and security controls is highly preferred.


 Why Qred?
   

  

 This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!
   

  

 One Last Thing
   

  

 This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
   

  

*Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.*
 Qred is an international FinTech scale-up that specializes in digital financing solutions for small businesses, with operations in the Nordics, Benelux, Germany and Brazil. We are passionate about helping small businesses thrive and grow, by providing them with business loans and credit cards. Right now we’re in an exciting phase of our journey that focuses on growth through smart product development and technology fueled by international expansion.

Hos oss blir du en nyckelspelare i ett självorganiserande team där vi kombinerar teknisk spets med djup förståelse för bankverksamhet.

 Teamet, som är en del av Financial Crime Prevention, utvecklar applikationer och tjänster för att effektivt arbeta förebyggande mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism. Teamet arbetar tvärfunktionellt mot hela Svea-koncernen och du kommer att ha stora möjligheter att påverka både ditt och teamets arbete. Ditt fokus ligger på backend (.NET/C#), men du rör dig obehindrat i hela stacken för att skapa enkla lösningar i en regulatoriskt komplex miljö. Vi arbetar värdedrivet, med korta feedbackloopar och kontinuerliga förbättringar. Vi lägger stor vikt vid arkitektur, och ser att du har både intresse och förmåga att bygga skalbara system som möter höga krav på säkerhet.
   

  

**Erfarenheter och kvalifikationer**

* Arkitektur: Erfarenhet av mikrotjänster, Event Sourcing och Azure DevOps.
* Domän: Vi ser det som ett stort plus om du har erfarenhet från Bank & Finans och har erfarenhet av arbete med regulatoriska krav.
* Utbildning: Universitetsutbildning inom data/IT eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
* Språk: Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift


**Vem är du?**
 Du är en driven och kreativ person med en genuin passion för mjukvaruutveckling och en nyfikenhet för affären. Du drivs av att skapa stabila, skalbara och användarvänliga lösningar, även i komplexa miljöer. Samtidigt är du trygg i sammanhang där säkerhet, stabilitet och efterlevnad av regulatoriska krav är centrala, och ser kvalitet och noggrannhet som en självklar del av ditt arbete. Du har arbetat med utveckling ett tag och är självgående och trygg i dina kunskaper, samt vill och kan dela med dig av dessa till ditt team. **Om Svea**
*Svea är en finansiell koncern med över 2000 anställda och verksamhet i flertalet europeiska länder. Med mer än 40 års erfarenhet är vi stolta över att erbjuda innovativa och hållbara finansiella lösningar till våra kunder. Svea präglas av en familjär företagskultur där varje medarbetare bidrar med sin unika kompetens och engagemang. Vår företagskultur betonar gemenskap, handlingskraft, och balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Välkommen att följa med oss på vår spännande resa!*
**Ansökan**
 Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och vi önskar att tillsätta tjänsten så snart som möjligt så skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Har du frågor kring tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterare Fredrika Engelin på fredrika.engelin@svea.com
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Product Owner Platform Engineering Getinge Critical Care
description:
**Date:** Aug 5, 2026
  
  

**Location:**  

Solna, SE
  
  

**Company:** Maquet Critical Care AB
  
**Remote Work:** 1-2 days at home (site based)
  
  

With a passion for life
  
  

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
  
  

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
  
  

About this opportunity
  
  

We are looking for a technically hands-on Product Owner for our Platform Engineering team at our Solna site. You will own the roadmap and backlog for the platform that enables our product teams to design, build, test and deliver software efficiently.
  
  

You will work closely with product teams, engineering, security, compliance, and other internal stakeholders to improve the full software delivery lifecycle. GitLab is a central component of the platform, together with Kubernetes, Azure, on-prem infrastructure, and observability tooling based on the LGTM stack. The role requires a high degree of autonomy – you should be self-driven, identify needs, prioritize work, and implement improvements together with your team with limited day-to-day guidance.
  
  

A key part of the role is to provide AI-related services, tooling, and support for both technical and non-technical users, with a strong focus on improving developer experience, productivity, and collaboration.
  
  

What you will do
  
  

Own and manage the roadmap and backlog for the internal software development platform, combined with hands-on technical work.
  
  

Collaborate with product teams, security, compliance, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure the platform is reliable, scalable, secure, and easy to use.
  
  

Provide AI services, guidance, and support to improve developer experience and productivity for both technical and non-technical users.
  
  

Support product teams with onboarding, integrations, testing workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and platform adoption.
  
  

This position is based in Solna, Sweden and is eligible for a hybrid work setup.
  
  

You will bring
  
  

To be successful in this position, we believe that you have the following qualifications.
  
  

Bachelor's degree in computer science, or equivalent working experience.
  
  

Some years of experience in product ownership or a similar role, together with hands-on experience of cloud/hybrid infrastructure (Azure, on-prem) and Kubernetes, including application deployments and/or CI workload execution.
  
  

Experience with GitLab or similar source control and CI/CD platforms, and with AI developer tools and/or AI platforms (e.g. GitLab Duo, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Azure OpenAI).
  
  

Understanding of security, compliance, governance and auditability in software development environments.
  
  

Strong communication skills with the ability to adapt to different audiences.
  
  

Fluent in Swedish and English, orally and written.
  
  

Experience with secure software supply chain practices (dependency scanning, container scanning, SAST, secret detection, vulnerability management), the LGTM stack (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir), and/or working in regulated or compliance-driven environments is meritorious.
  
  

In addition to your technical skills, we highly value your personality. You are self-driven and comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy, identifying needs and prioritizing your own work with limited day-to-day guidance.
  
  

We think you have an ambition for growth and an eagerness for keeping up to date with the latest platform engineering and AI developer tooling. At Getinge we see ourselves as proactive and self-driven in learning and contributing to the continued development of our products and our organization's capabilities. We are Team Players, Forward Thinkers and Game Changers. We think you will thrive in a high-expectation environment and have an interest in our products.
  
  

Why join Getinge
  
  

Getinge offers a job in a safe and informal work environment, where we appreciate close team collaboration. We keep an open dialogue between leaders and employees, as well as between teams. We are focused on developing people, and together we will create a plan for learning and competence development when you start your career with us.
  
  

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including wellness allowances, generous family benefits and joint company activities. Everything to ensure we support your well-being and goals.
  
  

Application

title: SMB Account Executive - Sweden
description:
We are looking for an **SMB Account Executive** to join our Nordic sales organization and strengthen our presence in **Sweden**.

##### **About the role**

**Based in or near Stockholm**, you will proactively identify, develop, and close opportunities with customers in the **SMB segment** (up to 1,000 employees).


You will develop relationships with prospective SMB decision-makers, uncover business needs, and communicate the value of our market-leading SaaS backup solution. As part of an established, high-performing team, you will have the collaboration and support needed to drive new business and make a real impact.

**You will:**

* Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including product demos and presentations.
* Actively hunt for new business in the SMB segment (up to 1,000 employees) and build a healthy pipeline of opportunities.
* Engage directly with decision-makers to understand their needs and position Keepit’s solution effectively.
* Proactively manage and prioritize your pipeline, ensuring accurate forecasting on a monthly and quarterly basis.
* Continuously identify new ways to reach prospects and open opportunities in Sweden.
* Contribute insights and best practices to continuously improve the sales approach across the team.

##### **About you**

* Proven track record in new business sales within the SMB segment (up to 1,000 employees).
* Solid understanding of B2B SaaS or IT solution sales, ideally within cloud, backup, or related technologies (preferred, not required).
* Confident managing the entire sales cycle independently.
* Skilled at building trust-based relationships with prospective decision-makers.
* Self-driven, proactive, and adaptable, with a strong hunter mentality.
* Fluent in **Swedish and English**.
* Comfortable with **frequent travel in Sweden** to meet customers and partners.

##### **We offer:**

* Competitive salary.
* Pension scheme.
* A modern, energetic global work environment.
* Flexible work-life balance.
* Regular team-building activities.
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* Compensation is based on experience and skill set.

##### **About us**


Our platform provides customers with an immutable, historical archive of their data in systems such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, Entra ID, Dynamics 365, and Zendesk.


We protect our customers against everything, from ransomware to simple accidents.


We pride ourselves on backing up hundreds of petabytes of data in a performant, reliable, and predictable way.

*We kindly ask you not to provide us with any sensitive categories of personal data when applying for a job with us. When applying for the vacancy, Keepit will process your personal data, and therefore we recommend that you also* ***read our*** ***privacy policy****, which describes our processing of personal data and your rights as a data subject.*

title: Business Development Manager Nordics - Services
description:
**Job Purpose:**  

The Services BDM plays a pivotal role in accelerating the growth of TD SYNNEX-delivered services through our extensive partner ecosystem. This individual is responsible for strategically driving the adoption, integration, and revenue growth of our complex services portfolio, which spans Support Managed Services, Professional Services, and Supply Chain/Integration Solutions. The role requires a blend of commercial acumen, technical understanding, and strategic influence. The IT services market is in high-growth, driven by increasing demand for business outcomes where products and services together solve IT challenges to deliver business results and value. To effectively capture this opportunity and expand market share, TD SYNNEX must invest in highly specialized talent with deep expertise in both technology and solution selling. These resources are critical not only for articulating the business value of services, but also for helping partners move beyond transactional sales toward outcome-focused, solution-led engagements. This shift enables TD SYNNEX to unlock new revenue streams, deepen partner relationships, and position itself as a trusted, strategic services provider in an increasingly competitive landscape.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

* Lead commercial negotiations and contracting, working with legal, finance, and delivery teams to define win-win service agreements that support long-term relationships and profitable growth.
* Prioritize outreach to high-potential resellers using insights from sales analytics and input from account teams, based on factors such as readiness, market opportunity, and past performance
* Gather and leverage intelligence on reseller organizations and key contacts in collaboration with internal stakeholders to tailor outreach and messaging
* Lead reseller engagement efforts, scheduling meetings and delivering compelling, needs-based service value propositions in partnership with other sales teams.
* Drive partner activation and acceleration, working directly with resellers to identify service opportunities, co-create go-to-market plans, and embed TD SYNNEX-delivered services into their core offerings.
* Ensure consistent follow-through from signed agreements to actual service transactions by coordinating closely with internal account managers.
* Engage service specialists as needed, including for scoping, resource planning, and positioning advanced service offerings.
* Track and drive performance against key metrics, including the services sales funnel (e.g., meetings held, contracts signed) and revenue/profit growth from assigned accounts.
* Develop and execute a services growth strategy aligned to regional and vertical priorities, with clear goals for increasing service attach rates, recurring revenue, and partner engagement across all portfolio areas.


**Knowledge, Skills and Experience:**  

* 10 to 15 Years of relevant work experience
* Any Bachelors Degree, Masters preferred
* Strong understanding of IT services and solution selling, with proven success in attach or upsell initiatives.
* Experience in Advanced Solutions (e.g., data center, software, cloud)
* Analytical thinker with a track record of using data to identify partner opportunities and shape go-to-market strategies.
* Strong influencing skills to align internal stakeholders and drive collaboration across sales, services, and operations teams.
* Demonstrated ability to build and sustain strategic relationships with external partners
* High level of commercial acumen and a proactive, results-oriented sales approach
* Solution selling


**At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do:** Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.
  
What’s In It For You?
  
  

* Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* Diversity, Equity Inclusion: It’s not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.


Don’t meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.
  
At TD SYNNEX, we’re proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you’re excited about working for our company and believe you’re a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we’re looking for!
