title: Customer Success Manager, Nordics
description:
About Us  



  

SUSE is a global leader of enterprise open source software. By transforming community innovations into secure, sovereign and AI-ready solutions, SUSE empowers customers to escape vendor lock-in and regain control of their IT destiny. Through industry-leading Linux, Kubernetes, Edge and AI infrastructure solutions, SUSE delivers the flexibility to innovate everywhere—from the data center to multi-cloud and out to the edge. Only SUSE also manages many Linux and Kubernetes distributions. At SUSE, Choice Happens because we prioritize community, interoperability and relentless innovation. Discover how we power mission-critical resilience at www.suse.com .


Customer Success Manager, Nordics  

**Job Description**

**Why This Role**

Customer Success at SUSE is a strategic function that owns the customer's realized value across the full lifecycle. As a CSM you guide enterprise customers from ambition to outcome: the customer drives the transformation, and you make sure they have the strategy, the enablement and the SUSE resources to succeed. You will own a portfolio of enterprise accounts in the Nordics and be accountable for our three Customer Success pillars: retention, adoption and expansion. Through these, you help to positively impact SUSE's GRR and NRR, giving your work direct visibility at the heart of the business.


Focus Area


* Shape the success strategy together with your customers. Co-create outcome-based Customer Success Plans that reflect their business objectives, and keep customer and SUSE teams aligned on shared goals through regular executive touchpoints.
* Turn adoption into measurable value. Guide customers from deployment to value realization across the SUSE portfolio (Linux, Cloud Native, Edge and AI solutions), and make that value visible to their leadership in their language: resilience, sovereignty, cost of ownership, time to market.
* Own retention and shape growth. Carry accountability for renewal health and gross retention across your accounts, maintain clear insights into the status of your accounts and renewals, and partner with Sales to convert value delivered into expansion.
* Build trusted executive relationships. Foster management-level connections between your customers and SUSE leadership, and grow into the advisor customers involved early in their strategic decisions.
* Orchestrate SUSE around the customer. Mobilize Support, Consulting, Engineering and Training & Enablement behind your customers' priorities, and keep the customer experience connected and consistent across all SUSE teams.
* Bring the customer's voice inside. Translate real-time customer health and adoption insight into input for our product, services and go-to-market teams, so the portfolio evolves with the market.

  

About You


* Proven experience in a Customer Success or comparable (post)sales strategic role in the Nordics enterprise market
* Based in Sweden; this role requires regular on-site presence with a strategic customer
* Right to work in Sweden, and eligibility to obtain and maintain any security clearance required for public sector customer engagements
* Fluent in English and Swedish; both are required for this role (Finnish is a plus)
* Experience with the telecom/network provider industry is strongly desired
* Comfortable engaging senior IT and business leaders, and skilled at mobilizing internal cross-functional teams
* A track record of driving retention and account growth through strong customer outcomes
* Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and strong commercial instincts
* Knowledge of the IT infrastructure and open source markets; affinity with Kubernetes, Linux and cloud native ecosystems is a plus

  

**If you don't tick every box but recognize yourself in this role, we encourage you to apply.**

**Job**

Revenue Generation Non-Sales
**What We Offer**

**We empower you to be bold, driving your career to create the future you want. We celebrate and reward your achievements.**

SUSE is a dynamic environment that is evolving rapidly, thus requiring agility, strong entrepreneurship and an open mind.


This is a compelling opportunity for the right person to join us as we continue to scale and prosper.


If you’re a big thinker, obsessed by execution and thrive in a dynamic environment in which you can tangibly create a lasting legacy, !


We give you the freedom to be yourself. You will work in a global community of unique individuals – like you – with different backgrounds, talents, skills and perspectives. A truly open community where everyone is welcome, has a voice and is encouraged to reach their full potential regardless of age, gender, race, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or any other characteristics.


**Sounds like the right fit for you?** . A recruiter will contact you if your skills match our current or any future positions. In the meantime, stay updated on the latest SUSE news and job vacancies by joining our **Talent Community** **.**

  

**SUSE Values**

SUSE's culture is centered on four key values - Choice, Community, Trust, and Innovation - which are deeply integrated with our open source ethos. SUSE fosters a diverse and inclusive environment where our people are encouraged to be themselves.  



  

**Choice:**

We are continuously making choice happen


We are accountable for our choices


We never get complacent  



  

**Community:**

Nobody is smarter than everybody


We embrace diversity of thought


We are “open source first, upstream first” where collaboration benefits all  



  

**Trust:**

We are trusted to deliver with integrity


We offer trust by default, and do not wait for it to be earned


We foster an environment where everyone trusts each other  



  

**Innovation:**

We foster a culture of experimentation, and embrace change by challenging the norm


We are committed to continuous improvement, creativity and adaptability


Ideas are great, but without execution they are just ideas

description:
Vi står nu med öppna armar, redo att välkomna vår nästa buddy till 3Butiken Mall Of Scandinavia. 3Butikerna är en av Tres viktigaste kanaler när det kommer till att skapa nöjda och lojala kunder. Detta gör vi genom vårt servicefokus, vår kunskap och vårt engagemang!
  
  

En dag som Säljare i vår 3Butik
  
  

Det är starten på en ny dag. Du ser till att göra butiken i ordning för dagen, ser till att butiken är städad och fin, kollar försäljningsresultat och sätter därefter mål för dagen. Du läser på om vår senaste produktlansering och om våra pågående kampanjer. Snart öppnar du butiken och är redo för dagens första kundmöte.
  
  

Under dagen kommer du och din chef att gå igenom försäljning, kundnöjdhet, daglig drift och du kommer att få regelbunden coachning. Du håller dig uppdaterad vad gäller utbildningar, nya produkter, kampanjer och tjänster. Tillsammans med dina kollegor strävar du efter att nå butikens budget och leverera kundmöten med hög kvalitet.

Att vara en del av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place To Work samt att vi är stolt samarbetspartner till Women in Tech och Tjejer Kodar

Kontinuerlig utbildning och utveckling
  
En företagskultur vi är mycket stolta över
  
Kul på jobbet! Bland annat genom kvartalsvisa tävlingar som ger en möjlighet till fina priser
  
Att vara en del av att leverera kritisk infrastruktur och bidra direkt till samhällsnyttan
  
Några av våra medarbetare
  
Julia Maxén
  
Gruppchef

Digital projektledare

Jayasri Battola
  
Utvecklare

Vem är du?
  
  

Vi tror att du är serviceinriktad och intresserad av försäljning. Som person är du relationsskapande och kommunikativ, och drivs av att arbeta mot mål. Vi ser också att du är ansvarstagande och en riktig buddy! Att arbeta som Säljare i 3Butik innebär att arbetstiden är förlagd på både dagtid och kvällstid samt vardagar och helger, så en förutsättning är att detta passar din livssituation. Du behöver också vara minst 18 år och kunna svenska och engelska.

Att söka jobbet är enkelt och går snabbt, du behöver bara besvara några urvalsfrågor direkt i annonsen. Vi tar inte emot CV eller personligt brev, eftersom vi är mer intresserade av vem du är och vad du kan bidra med, än vad du gjort tidigare.

Rekryteringen pågår parallellt med den händelserika vardagen i 3Butiken, så det kan ibland ta lite tid innan du hör från oss, men vi går igenom ansökningar löpande och återkopplar så snart vi kan!

Friskvårdsbidrag, föräldrarlön, pension & försäkringar enligt kollektivavtal

title: SMB Account Executive - Sweden
description:
We are looking for an SMB Account Executive to join our Nordic sales organization and strengthen our presence in Sweden.
  
  

About the role
  
  

Based in or near Stockholm, you will proactively identify, develop, and close opportunities with customers in the SMB segment (up to 1,000 employees).
  
  

You will develop relationships with prospective SMB decision-makers, uncover business needs, and communicate the value of our market-leading SaaS backup solution. As part of an established, high-performing team, you will have the collaboration and support needed to drive new business and make a real impact.
  
  

**You will:**  

Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including product demos and presentations.
  
  

Actively hunt for new business in the SMB segment (up to 1,000 employees) and build a healthy pipeline of opportunities.
  
  

Engage directly with decision-makers to understand their needs and position Keepit’s solution effectively.
  
  

Proactively manage and prioritize your pipeline, ensuring accurate forecasting on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  
  

Continuously identify new ways to reach prospects and open opportunities in Sweden.
  
  

Contribute insights and best practices to continuously improve the sales approach across the team.
  
  

About you
  
  

Proven track record in new business sales within the SMB segment (up to 1,000 employees).
  
  

Solid understanding of B2B SaaS or IT solution sales, ideally within cloud, backup, or related technologies (preferred, not required).
  
  

Confident managing the entire sales cycle independently.
  
  

Skilled at building trust-based relationships with prospective decision-makers.
  
  

Self-driven, proactive, and adaptable, with a strong hunter mentality.
  
  

Fluent in Swedish and English.
  
  

Comfortable with frequent travel in Sweden to meet customers and partners.
  
  

**We offer:**  

Competitive salary.
  
  

Pension scheme.
  
  

A modern, energetic global work environment.
  
  

Flexible work-life balance.
  
  

Regular team-building activities.
  
  

Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
  
  

Compensation is based on experience and skill set.
  
  

About us
  
  

Our platform provides customers with an immutable, historical archive of their data in systems such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, Entra ID, Dynamics 365, and Zendesk.
  
  

We protect our customers against everything, from ransomware to simple accidents.
  
  

We pride ourselves on backing up hundreds of petabytes of data in a performant, reliable, and predictable way.
  
  

We kindly ask you not to provide us with any sensitive categories of personal data when applying for a job with us. title: Service Owner Infrastructure, AD/Entra - Lindab Group
description:
Are you ready to play a key role in shaping Lindab Group's Identity & Access Management strategy and digital transformation? As a Service Owner Infrastructure – AD/Entra, you will be part of Lindab Group's Infrastructure & Operations (I&O) team, responsible for the ownership, governance, and continuous development of the company's identity services based on Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.



Lindab Group is on an exciting journey to modernize and strengthen its IT capabilities. In this role, you will have a unique opportunity to drive the evolution of the organization's identity platform, ensuring secure, scalable, and efficient authentication and authorization services across the enterprise. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the business, security teams, external service providers, and IT colleagues to ensure that identity services support both operational excellence and business growth.



Your expertise in identity management, service ownership, security, and cloud technologies will be instrumental in delivering secure and user-friendly services that enable Lindab's digital future.



You will report to the Manager for Infrastructure Services.


**Main responsibilities**


* Own and manage Lindab Group's Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID services throughout their entire lifecycle.


* Manage incidents, problems, risks, and service requests related to identity and access management services, ensuring timely resolution and continuous service improvement.


* Oversee and continuously improve disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities for Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and related authentication services, ensuring service resilience and operational continuity.


* Define and drive the roadmap for Identity & Access Management services, aligned with business requirements and the overall IS/IT strategy.


* Lead the transition towards modern identity services, supporting cloud-first initiatives and Zero Trust principles.


* Ensure secure and efficient management of hybrid identity environments between on-premises Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.


* Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to strengthen identity security through Conditional Access, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Identity Governance, and related capabilities.


* Monitor service performance, availability, security, and compliance, ensuring that service levels are met and continuously improved.


* Manage relationships with external service providers and partners, ensuring high-quality service delivery and operational excellence.


* Participate in projects and initiatives requiring identity integrations and authentication services.


* Establish and maintain governance, policies, standards, documentation and best practices for identity management across the organization.


* Ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and security standards.


* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and identify opportunities to modernize and optimize identity-related services.


* Support the business with identity-related changes, service requests, and operational requirements.


* Monitor service investments, business value, risks, and future development needs.


**Previous experience and competencies**


* At least 5 years of experience within IT infrastructure, Identity & Access Management (IAM), or related areas.


* Proven expertise in Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID administration and architecture.


* Strong experience working with hybrid identity environments and identity synchronization solutions.


* Knowledge of modern authentication protocols and technologies such as SAML, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, Kerberos, and LDAP.


* Experience implementing and managing Conditional Access, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Identity Governance.


* Experience with Microsoft 365 identity services and integrations.


* Experience managing outsourced IT service delivery from either a customer or supplier perspective.


* Good understanding of cybersecurity principles, identity security, and compliance requirements.


* Knowledge of IT service management frameworks such as ITIL and experience with service lifecycle management.


* Relevant Microsoft certifications within Azure, Entra ID, Security, or Identity Management are considered an advantage.


* Experience working within an international matrix organization is highly valued.


**To Succeed in This Role, We Believe You Have the Following Skills**


* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess risks and develop effective solutions.


* Ability to balance business needs, security requirements, and operational efficiency.


* Proactive and self-driven approach with a strong sense of ownership.


* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.


* Strong collaboration skills and ability to work across teams, functions, and external partners.


* Results-oriented mindset with a focus on service quality, security, and continuous improvement.


* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.


* Adaptability and resilience in a dynamic and evolving technology landscape.


* Fast learner with a genuine interest in identity, security, and cloud technologies.


* Fluent in English and Swedish, both spoken and written.



Does this sound like the opportunity you’ve been looking for? Join Lindab Group and play a key role in shaping our digital future!


**Additional Information**



Start: Per agreement  

Location: Malmö, Sweden



This recruitment process is handled by A-hub, and at Lindab Group’s request, all inquiries regarding this position will be managed by A-hub and Linus Nilsson.

title: Head of Data
description:
**Join our highly skilled team of engineers, data scientists and product managers — breaking new ground and shaping the future of retail.**  

  

**We dare to dream big, we have the courage to keep raising the bar, and we’re committed to being a force for good in retail - helping both established and fast-growing brands meet the ever-changing expectations of their customers.**  

  

**Sitoo is a fast-growing technology company exploring how far we can take innovation to deliver the world’s best Unified Commerce Platform and Point of Sale. Our technology is used in more than 20 countries - a number that keeps growing thanks to our incredible teams in Engineering & Product. And we have no intention of slowing down. Are you the Head of Data we’re looking for?**  



#### **Your mission at Sitoo**


At Sitoo, we believe that the most sophisticated technology should feel the most simple to the person using it. As Head of Data, you will lead a small but growing Data & Analytics team through its next phase, staying close to the work while building trusted data products, scalable analytics capabilities and better decision-making across Product, Engineering and the business. You will be a hands-on data leader who guides our data team into the next phase of maturity. This is a role for a doer who enjoys being close to execution, building the foundation with the team, and operationalizing our data strategy while we grow, all while reporting directly to the CPO.

* Execute and scale Sitoo’s data strategy, including internal analytics and selected customer-facing data opportunities.
* Own and prioritize the Data & Analytics roadmap, balancing foundational platform work with high-impact business and product use cases.
* Strengthen data quality practices for critical data domains, making data more reliable, observable and trusted.
* Build a governed data layer that can support better analytics, automation and future AI use cases.

#### **What you'll do**

* You'll partner with the CPO and product leads to influence what gets built, bringing data-driven thinking into prioritization and ensuring we build for scale and insight.
* Own the data roadmap, evolving analytics from internal reporting to customer-facing value drivers.
* Establish a new data operating model, documenting workflows and using automation to remove organizational friction.
* Implement data quality and observability frameworks linked to product release cycles to increase reliability.
* Lead, mentor, and grow the data team through hands-on daily execution and priority setting.
* Drive a data-first culture by championing data literacy and ensuring actionable insights across the organization.
* Act as the primary data evangelist, using storytelling and operational alignment to foster organizational change.

#### **What you’ll bring to the table**


We are looking for a pragmatic data leader with a strong business mindset and the ability to turn data strategy into practical execution and business value. Whether your background is in Retail, Fintech, or complex Enterprise SaaS, what matters is your ability to operate as a strategic peer who can bridge the gap between technical infrastructure and business value.

* Proven track record of data leadership in fast-paced environments, with experience building and developing high-performing data teams
* Strategic thinking within a SaaS/Retail environment, with the ability to shape product prioritization through data-backed evidence
* Extensive experience with modern data infrastructure, cloud data warehouses, and implementing scalable governance frameworks
* Experience leveraging AI and machine learning models within data products to solve complex business problems
* Proven experience from building data platforms from the ground up and a strong desire to stay hands-on with implementation, data modelling, and architectural decisions.

**Why Sitoo**


We are forward thinkers. By turning curiosity into knowledge — and knowledge into continuous improvement — we break new ground and shape the future of retail.  

  

We believe in an inclusive culture where everyone feels like they belong. We support each other, win together, celebrate success together, and overcome challenges together.  

  

Today, we are close to 100 dedicated experts with a positive and solution-oriented mindset. Most importantly, we take care of each other, and we never forget to have fun.

title: Ai Tech Lead
description:
#### **About us**


Pinecone Group is a European venture platform combining a venture-platform , a forthcoming venture fund and corporate innovation across Sweden, Norway and the United Kingdom. We identify, validate and build technology companies together with exceptional entrepreneurs, with the ambition of creating investment-ready ventures that can be spun out within approximately 12 months.


At the core of our platform is Pinecone OS, our proprietary operating system that standardizes how we source opportunities, validate ideas, build companies and compound knowledge across the organization.


We are now looking for an AI Tech Lead who will make artificial intelligence one of Pinecone's greatest competitive advantages. You will design and build the AI-powered systems, tools, and workflows that enable a small team to identify, validate, build and launch companies with exceptional speed and quality.


Beyond building Pinecone's internal AI capabilities, you will serve as the technical lead for our newest venture companies during their earliest stages, ensuring a smooth transition to future CTOs while acting as the primary technical advisor to Pinecone's leadership team.

#### **Responsibilities**

#### **Build Pinecone OS**


You will own the technical development of Pinecone OS, the shared operating platform that powers our entire venture creation model.


Your responsibilities include:

* Transforming our venture creation process, from opportunity screening and validation sprints to scorecards and investment decisions, into software used across the organization.
* Building AI-powered workflows for founder sourcing, customer discovery, market validation and investment analysis.
* Instrumenting every critical process so that speed, quality, conversion rates, costs and decision-making are measured rather than estimated.
* Establishing documentation standards that stand up to institutional investor due diligence.
* Standardizing workflows across Sweden, Norway and the UK so knowledge compounds instead of remaining siloed.

#### **Multiply the Organization with AI**


AI should become embedded in every part of how Pinecone operates.


You will:

* Design and build agentic AI systems that create real operational leverage.
* Develop evaluation frameworks and feedback loops that continuously improve AI quality.
* Determine where AI should operate autonomously and where human judgment creates greater value.
* Build internal AI tools used across the organization.
* Personally leverage cutting-edge AI technologies to accelerate strategic and operational execution.
* Manage AI agents with the same discipline as leading high-performing engineering teams, through clear objectives, quality standards and continuous iteration.
* Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving AI landscape and make thoughtful build versus buy decisions.

#### **Build the Next Generation of Venture Companies**


As AI Tech Lead, you will play a critical role in building Pinecone's portfolio companies from day one.


You will:

* Prototype new products within days to validate demand with real customers.
* Rapidly identify and kill ideas that lack sufficient commercial potential.
* Serve as Tech Lead for new ventures during months 0-6, leading development through the first production release.
* Build systems that are robust enough for an incoming founding CTO while remaining pragmatic enough to maximize execution speed.
* Support ventures throughout months 6-12 to ensure a successful transition to their permanent engineering teams.

#### **Qualifications**

* Experience with modern cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for deploying and scaling AI applications.
* Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in AI development, such as Python or TypeScript.
* Stockholm, Sweden (20 km range) or nearby areas.


We believe you have:

* Significant experience as a Senior Tech Lead, Staff Engineer, Engineering Manager or CTO.
* A proven track record of building and deploying production-grade AI systems.
* Hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, RAG, context engineering, memory architectures, tool integration and evaluation frameworks.
* Demonstrated experience taking products from an empty repository to paying customers.
* Strong technical judgment on where AI creates value and where conventional software is the better solution.
* The ability to make strategic build-versus-buy decisions in a technology landscape that evolves every month.

#### **Nice to Have**


Experience with:

* Building internal platforms that measurably improve organizational productivity.
* Optimizing AI pipelines across quality, latency and cost.
* Venture studios, startups, consulting firms or environments where multiple products are built in parallel.
* Security architecture, data governance and AI infrastructure at scale.

#### **Why Pinecone?**


At Pinecone, you won't just build AI products, you'll shape how one of Europe's most ambitious venture platforms creates companies. You'll work alongside founders, investors and senior leadership while helping define the operating system that powers our future ventures. If you're excited about combining AI, entrepreneurship, venture creation and product development at the frontier of technology, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Data Scientist

**WHAT YOU’LL DO** 
**​**
  

 As a Senior Data Scientist, you will work hands on to solve complex business and product problems using data and machine learning. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams and be expected to work pragmatically, navigate ambiguity, and focus on delivering measurable impact.

 ​

 ​

 The Enterprise Account Executive is responsible for building client relationships with enterprise businesses within a specified region.  This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high visibility, high impact projects at a very exciting time for the company. * Experience determining customer requirements and presenting appropriate solutions.
* Pro-active, independent thinker with high energy and a positive attitude.

title: Commercial Account Executive - Expansion
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

**The Role**
 You won't just carry a bag — you'll run a franchise. As a Commercial Expansion Account Executive at Snowflake, you own a portfolio of existing customers and are accountable for defending the base, driving healthy consumption growth, and expanding into new workloads and use cases. You'll partner with Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, and Services Delivery to turn customers into advocates and single-workload accounts into strategic platforms.
   

  

 This is not a renewals desk. You'll prospect within your install base, identify whitespace, build multi-threaded executive relationships, and close net-new expansion business — all while ensuring your customers are consuming Snowflake efficiently and getting measurable business value.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Territory Strategy & Pipeline Generation**
 Own a defined patch of commercial accounts (<500 employees) and build a data-driven territory plan using propensity scoring, technographic signals, and consumption health indicators
 - Apply strategic tiering (20/80 rule) to focus time on high-potential "Sleeping Giants" — accounts with high whitespace relative to current spend

- Consistently achieve 10+ external customer meetings per week through disciplined outreach rhythms

- Map accounts to campaign plays (e.g., BI Consolidation, AI/ML expansion, Databricks defence) based on their tech stack and business signals

**Account Expansion & Deal Execution**
* Source, progress, and close expansion use cases using MEDDPICC methodology
* Identify and articulate value hypotheses (Why Anything? Why Now? Why Snowflake?) tailored to each account's business priorities
* Navigate complex, multi-persona deals — from technical champions to CFO-level economic buyers
* Negotiate renewals, multi-year commitments, and capacity deals anchored in business value, not discounts


**Consumption Health & Customer Success**
* Distinguish between healthy and unhealthy consumption; proactively address inefficiencies before they become churn risk
* Understand modern data architecture (transformation layers, BI performance, serverless economics) to advise customers on optimising their Snowflake deployment
* Convert cost savings from efficiency improvements into budget for new workloads — turning defence into offence


**Competitive Defence**
* Protect the install base against competitive threats (Databricks, AWS-native, Azure Synapse) using TCO analysis, architectural advantages, and "Serverless Tax" positioning
* Build proactive competitive strategies rather than reactive objection handling


**What We're Looking For**
**Must-Have**
* 3+ years in a quota-carrying SaaS sales role with demonstrable pattern of achievement (top 20% attainment preferred)
* Experience managing and expanding an existing customer book — not exclusively net-new acquisition
* Ability to articulate technical value propositions to both technical practitioners and C-level executives
* Proven prospecting discipline within an install base: pipeline self-sourced, not inherited
* Familiarity with consumption-based or usage-based commercial models
* Fluency in a structured sales methodology (MEDDPICC, MEDDICC, or equivalent)


**Strongly Preferred**
* Experience selling data, analytics, AI/ML, or cloud infrastructure solutions
* Understanding of modern data stack architecture (data warehousing, ELT, BI tooling, data engineering)
* Demonstrated use of AI/automation tools to enhance productivity (meeting prep, follow-up, personalisation, research)
* Track record navigating competitive displacement scenarios
* Experience with multi-year deal structuring and commercial negotiation (including MSA-level discussions)


 Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
   

  

 How do you want to make your impact?
   

  

 For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

title: Software Engineer (AI Training)
description:
**About The Role**
 What if the code you write could directly shape how the next generation of AI understands and generates software? We're looking for Software Engineers in Stockholm to build, evaluate, and improve AI-generated code — helping train AI systems to think like real developers.
   

  

 Stockholm is one of Europe's most celebrated technology ecosystems — the city that gave the world Spotify, Klarna, and a generation of world-class engineers. Now you can bring that engineering culture to the frontier of AI development, entirely on your own schedule.
   

  

 You'll write solutions, review AI outputs, and provide the expert-level feedback that makes AI coding assistants smarter, safer, and more reliable. This is hands-on engineering work — not theoretical, not bureaucratic, and not boring.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you can write clean code and explain your reasoning, we want to hear from you.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Write, debug, and optimize code across a range of languages, frameworks, and problem domains
* Review and evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, efficiency, readability, and best practices
* Identify bugs, logic errors, security issues, and performance bottlenecks in AI outputs
* Provide structured, detailed feedback explaining why code works — or doesn't
* Design challenging coding prompts and edge-case scenarios to stress-test AI capabilities
* Compare and rank multiple AI-generated solutions based on engineering quality
* Work independently and asynchronously — fully on your own schedule


**Who You Are**
* Proficient in one or more programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, Go, TypeScript, or similar)
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles
* Able to read, write, and reason about code with clarity and precision
* Strong problem-solving instincts and a systematic debugging approach
* Clear written communicator — you can explain technical decisions in plain language
* Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without supervision
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience


**Nice to Have**
* Experience across multiple languages or tech stacks (full-stack, backend, systems, data engineering)
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, LLMs, or prompt engineering
* Background in code review, technical writing, or mentoring junior developers
* Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps, or distributed systems
* Competitive programming, open-source contributions, or side projects that demonstrate your craft
* Advanced degree in Computer Science or related discipline


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work from anywhere
* Freelance autonomy with intellectually stimulating, high-impact work
* Directly influence how AI writes, understands, and reasons about code
* Sharpen your own engineering skills by evaluating diverse problems daily
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Sambla Group is a fintech company with a clear goal – to be your trusted financial partner. We’ve grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies - bridging the gap between borrowers and lenders - thanks to the 500+ amazing people who work here.**
 As a Data Engineer at Sambla Group you will play a key role in building and maintaining the systems that power data-driven decision making across the company. You'll join a central Data Platform team, and work closely with an Engineering Manager and a Product Manager, contributing to everything from reliable data pipelines to enabling self-serve analytics and putting data to work in our operational tools.
   

  

 We're building a modern, AI-native data platform, and we're looking for someone who doesn't just adapt to new tooling but actively drives how we adopt it. That means using AI-assisted development in your day-to-day work, exploring where LLMs and intelligent automation can make our platform smarter, and helping set the standard for how the team works with these tools going forward.
   

  

 You will work with modern cloud-native technologies on GCP - including BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Build and Artifact Registry - alongside tools like DBT, Prefect and Terraform.
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
* Design, build and maintain data pipelines and integrations (streaming, batch, API-based) that feed our data products
* Develop and maintain our Data Warehouse and contribute to data platform improvements
* Ensure data quality, data governance and GDPR compliance
* Architect scalable and secure solutions in GCP and BigQuery
* Use AI tooling to accelerate development and explore where it can add value across our data work
* Collaborate with stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams


**Must Have**
* At least 3 years of experience in data engineering or a similar role
* Strong Python skills (e.g. Polars, Flask/FastAPI or similar)
* Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex joins
* Hands-on experience with GCP or AWS, preferably GCP
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows
* Ability to manage and communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders


**Nice To Have**
* Experience with dbt and data modelling concepts (dimensional modelling, SCD etc.)
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI or similar)
* Experience with observability, monitoring and alerting for data systems
* Background in fintech or financial data
* Experience mentoring or coaching colleagues
* Ability to communicate confidently in Swedish


**We might be a little different from most companies. Instead of defining personal values, we’ve built a shared way of working - a rhythm that guides how we collaborate, support our customers, and move forward together.** 
**We call it Drive & Jive - a shared rhythm that creates momentum through direction, collaboration, and human connection.**
***Applicants must already have the legal right to work in***
***Sweden***
***, as we do not provide visa sponsorship or relocation assistance for this position.***
 Sambla Group is the new generation of brokers. Our ambition has always been the same - to challenge the banks’ offers so that our customers, regardless of the conditions, should always have the same opportunity to obtain the best possible loan solution. Sambla Group has grown to over 500 employees, established itself in Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark with offices in all markets.

**Vi Erbjuder Bland Annat**

* Stor möjlighet att påverka teknikval och vidareutveckling av plattformen

title: Senior System Administrator
description:

 **Senior Systemadministratör** 
 som vill ta en nyckelroll i ett erfaret IT-team där du får arbeta med affärskritiska system, automation och tekniska förbättringar.
   

  

 I rollen kommer du att ansvara för administration och vidareutveckling av företagets centrala IT-plattformar, med särskilt fokus på Atlassian-produkter som Jira, Jira Service Management och Confluence. Du kommer även att arbeta med integrationer, automatisering och systemförvaltning samt bidra till att säkerställa en stabil, säker och effektiv IT-miljö.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
 Som
 **Senior Systemadministratör** 
 kommer du att spela en nyckelroll i förvaltningen och utvecklingen av företagets interna IT-miljö. Du ansvarar för administration, optimering och vidareutveckling av affärskritiska system med fokus på Atlassian-plattformen. Rollen innebär även ett nära samarbete med den globala IT-organisationen där du bidrar med teknisk expertis, automation och ständiga förbättringar för att säkerställa en stabil, säker och effektiv IT-miljö.
   

  

**Kompetenskrav**
 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* Minst 5 års erfarenhet som Systemadministratör eller IT-systemadministratör.

* God erfarenhet av Python för automatisering.
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla och underhålla REST API-integrationer.

 Humanit handlar om att göra saker lite annorlunda, att på riktigt sätta våra anställda i fokus. Vi växer tillsammans och värdesätter engagemang och ambition. För oss är det viktigt att du får chansen att vara med och påverka vägen framåt.
   

  

 I utbyte erbjuder vi kompetens- och karriärutveckling genom varierande och utmanande uppdrag. Vi är inte branschinriktade och kan därför erbjuda en fantastisk variation bland uppdragen för dig som konsult. Självklart ser vi till att du får rätt utbildning och vi är väl medvetna om att det är det livslånga lärandet som bygger vår framgång.
   

  

 Tillsammans skapar vi framtiden 🚀

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
A hands-on engineering role building and optimising scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and Lakehouse architectures across a modern multi-cloud platform using Python, Spark, Airflow, and dbt.
 



  





 Requires 5+ years of data engineering experience with strong expertise in SQL, CI/CD, data quality frameworks, and cloud technologies (S3, Athena, Redshift), with a plus for streaming and AI tooling experience.
 



  





**Overview** 




 A Senior Data Engineer position within an agile team, focused on building scalable data pipelines and modernizing a multi-cloud data platform. The role involves working with streaming technologies, Lakehouse architectures, and leveraging automation/AI to improve efficiency.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  




* **Pipeline Development:** 
 Build ETL/ELT pipelines (Python, SQL), optimize Spark/PySpark jobs, manage Airflow DAGs, and implement dbt transformations.
* **Lakehouse Architecture:** 
 Design medallion-style architectures using S3 and modern table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake) with optimized layouts.
* **Platform Infrastructure:** 
 Create reusable frameworks, enforce data contracts, build CI/CD pipelines, and establish observability practices.
* **Data Quality:** 
 Implement validation frameworks, data contracts, and SLIs/SLOs for critical pipelines.



  





**Your experience** 




**Required** 



* **5+ years** 
 in data engineering
* Strong Python, advanced SQL, Airflow, Spark/PySpark, dbt, and CI/CD proficiency
* Experience with Lakehouse architectures, dimensional modeling, and cloud data warehouses (S3, Athena, Redshift)
* Data quality frameworks, monitoring, and schema evolution expertise



**Nice-to-Haves** 



* Streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis)
* AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot)
* Terraform, Kubernetes/Docker
* Data catalog/metadata management experience

title: CTO / Lead Developer - Platform Team
description:
Hacksaw Studios is looking for a highly experienced CTO / Lead Developer to join and lead our platform team.
   

  

 The platform team is responsible for building, maintaining, and continuously improving the core remote gaming server platform used across the group. This is a high-volume, transactional system operating in the online gaming industry, where scalability, security, reliability, and code quality are critical.
   

  

 This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. You will take ownership of the ongoing development and maintenance of the remote gaming server platform, as well as other platform-related services including API gateway solutions, back-office systems, integrations, and future unannounced projects.
   

  

 The role
   

  

 As CTO / Lead Developer for the platform team, you will be expected to combine strong technical leadership with hands-on development. You will work closely with the engineering team, senior management, and other departments to ensure that our platform continues to scale, perform, and meet the high standards required in a regulated industry.
   

  

 You will be responsible for driving technical decisions, improving architecture, reviewing and writing code, mentoring developers, and ensuring that the platform remains stable, secure, and maintainable as the business grows.
   

  

 A key part of the role will also be communication. You will need to clearly explain technical decisions, platform changes, risks, priorities, and ongoing work to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This includes regular reporting to senior management, as well as close collaboration with departments such as Frontend, DevOps, Sysadmin, and Support to ensure they understand the platform, upcoming changes, operational impact, and how best to support the systems in production.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical direction and development of the remote gaming server platform
* Take ownership of platform architecture, scalability, performance, and security
* Write, review, and deliver high-quality C# code
* Maintain and improve core transactional systems handling high volumes of traffic
* Work with SQL databases and ensure strong data integrity, performance, and reliability
* Support and improve related platform services, including API gateways and back-office systems
* Report progress, priorities, risks, and technical decisions to senior management
* Communicate clearly with DevOps, sysadmin, support, and other departments about platform functionality, changes, incidents, and operational requirements
* Help educate relevant teams on how the platform works and how changes may affect their areas
* Promote strong engineering practices, including unit testing, code reviews, and maintainable architecture
* Help the team operate effectively in a highly regulated industry
* Mentor and support developers while remaining deeply involved in day-to-day implementation
* Contribute to future platform initiatives and new technical projects


**Requirements**
* Extensive professional experience with C# and .NET
* Strong experience building scalable, production-grade backend systems
* Very strong SQL skills, including performance optimization and data modelling
* Understanding of caching principles in Redis or similar
* Experience working with transaction-based systems, ideally in online gaming, fintech, payments, trading, or similar industries
* Experience designing and operating horizontally scaled systems
* Strong understanding of system architecture, API design, reliability, and security
* Experience working with high-volume systems where uptime and correctness are critical
* A strong focus on code quality, testing, and maintainability
* Comfortable being hands-on and spending a significant amount of time coding
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience working across departments such as DevOps, infrastructure, support, product, or operations
* Ability to make pragmatic technical decisions in a fast-moving environment


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience from the online gaming or gambling industry
* Experience working in regulated environments
* Experience with remote gaming server platforms, payment systems, or other mission-critical transactional platforms
* Experience designing analytics systems for handling very large data sets for reporting purposes
* Experience leading engineering teams or acting as a technical owner for a major platform
* Experience with back-office systems, API gateways and integrations into third-party systems
* Experience reporting to or working directly with senior management


 What we are looking for
   

  

 We are looking for someone who enjoys taking real technical ownership who is a strong, hands-on developer. You should be excited by complex backend systems, care deeply about quality, and be comfortable balancing long-term architecture with hands-on delivery.
   

  

 You should be able to lead from the front, contribute directly to the codebase, and help the team make good technical decisions while keeping the platform secure, scalable, and reliable.
   

  

 Just as importantly, you should be a strong communicator. The platform team works closely with DevOps, sysadmin, support, and senior management, and this role will be expected to create clarity across those teams. You should be comfortable explaining what the platform team is doing, why certain technical decisions are being made, what risks or priorities exist, and how other departments are affected.
   

  

**About Hacksaw**
 Hacksaw is a fast-growing company in the online gaming industry, building products and platforms used by operators and players across multiple markets. We work in a highly regulated environment and place strong emphasis on quality, reliability, and responsible technical delivery.
   

  

 If you are an experienced C# developer and technical leader who wants to take ownership of a critical high-volume gaming platform, we would like to hear from you.
   

  

 Practical Details
   

  

* This is an on-site position in Stockholm.


 Ready to Join the Game Makers?
   

  

 Apply now! We review applications on a rolling basis.

title: Product Specialist
description:
**Bannerflow is a fast-growing global SaaS company building a Creative Intelligence Platform that enables enterprise brands to predict, create, and optimize advertising across channels. We're on a company-wide AI transformation journey, where AI and agentic workflows are becoming a core part of how we build and innovate, with high expectations on adoption across all teams. We are looking for a Product Specialist to join our US team and play a key role in how our existing customer base adopts and gets the most value out of Bannerflow.**
 You'll work in close partnership with our Customer Success Manager (CSM) in the US, acting as the technical backbone of the customer relationship, helping customers succeed with the platform, troubleshooting technical issues hands-on, and ensuring a smooth, scalable support experience across US business hours. Beyond the existing customer base, you'll also lend technical expertise to pre-sales conversations, helping the team win new business. You'll also work in tight dialogue with our teams in Stockholm, representing the voice of US customers in product discussions and helping shape and enable how support scales in this time zone.
   

  

 This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to combine deep technical problem-solving with direct customer impact, and to help build a strong local support foundation from the ground up.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Partner closely with the US CSM to drive product adoption and value realization across our existing customer base.
* Support pre-sales efforts for new revenue opportunities, providing technical expertise during demos, evaluations, and scoping conversations with prospective customers.
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex integration, feed, and implementation issues, troubleshooting hands-on rather than just guiding at a conceptual level.
* Configure and debug account setups, data feeds, HTML-based creative implementations, and API-based integrations directly with customers.
* Deliver in-depth product training and value-focused demos to existing customers.
* Collaborate with Product and Tech at HQ to resolve root causes of recurring technical issues and feed learnings back into the product.
* Help design, document, and roll out first-line support coverage for the US time zone, laying the groundwork for a scalable local support model.
* Represent US customer feedback and technical insights in product discussions with the Stockholm team.


**What You Bring**
* Proven experience in a Product Specialist, Solutions Engineer, Technical Support, or similar customer-facing technical implementation role.
* Hands-on technical proficiency with HTML/CSS, data feeds, and API-based integrations, comfortable debugging issues independently.
* Deep knowledge of creative tech, digital marketing, or SaaS customer workflows.
* Great communication skills, confident presenting, teaching, and troubleshooting with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* A collaborative, self-starting mindset with the ability to work effectively across time zones with a distributed team.
* Comfortable working in a lean, cross-functional setup where you help build processes, not just follow it.


**What We Offer**
 The opportunity to shape how Bannerflow supports and grows its US customer base, working shoulder to shoulder with our US CSM. It's a role built on collaboration, passion for our customers, and the kind of challenge that keeps things exciting. You'll be part of a supportive team culture that spans time zones, with close ties to our Stockholm HQ.
   

  

 Sound like you? We'd love for you to join us and be part of the journey.
   

  

 Note: this role is a direct US hire; not a relocation position.

title: Utveckla AI och low code för framtidens flygplatser
description:

 Hos oss får du en bred och utvecklande roll där du kombinerar teknik, verksamhetsförståelse och regelverk, och där ingen dag är den andra lik.
   

  

**Vad innebär rollen?**
 Som Delivery Manager för Power Platform och Copilot ansvarar du för att skapa ordning och reda i en växande värld av AI, low code och egenutvecklade lösningar i M365. Idag bygger många lösningar med Power Apps, Power Automate och Copilot, där ditt jobb blir att skapa en tydlig och hållbar förvaltningsstruktur.
   

  

 Rollen innebär bland annat att:
   

  

* Utveckla, implementera och förvalta styrning och livscykelhantering för Power Platform, Copilot och AI i M365.
* Möjliggöra säker, kontrollerad och affärsdriven användning av AI och low code.
* Ansvara för förvaltningsmodell samt incident-, problem- och ändringshantering för aktuellt ansvarsområde.
* Samordna kravställning och förändringsarbete med relevanta funktioner och leverantörer.
* Driva utbildningsinsatser och stärka organisationens AI- och IT-mognad.
* Säkerställa regelefterlevnad, informationssäkerhet samt teknisk- och användardokumentation.


 AI-mognaden är idag varierande i organisationen, du får därför möjlighet att tänka framåt, driva utveckling och bidra till att höja kompetensen kring AI, automation och Power Platform i hela verksamheten.
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* Akademisk utbildning inom IT eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
* Erfarenhet av Microsoft Power Platform i större/komplex organisation, inklusive Dev/Test/Prod, Dataverse och relaterade M365-verktyg (t.ex. Purview, Copilot Studio, Power Apps och Power Automate).
* Erfarenhet av förvaltningsstyrning för gemensamma plattformar eller tjänster.
* Förmåga att driva utbildnings- och förändringsinsatser i tvärfunktionell miljö, internt och externt.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.


 Meriterande med erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Power Platform-styrning i större skala och uppbyggnad av nya förvaltningsobjekt.
* ITIL och relevanta M365-certifieringar.
* Kunskap om DLP-policys, informationsklassning, behörighetsstyrning, informationssäkerhet och GDPR i M365.


 Som person är du strukturerad, kommunikativ och pedagogisk. Du trivs i samarbeten, är lösningsorienterad och har lätt för att skapa förtroende och samsyn mellan olika intressenter. Du gillar variation, är kreativ i ditt arbetssätt och motiveras av att effektivisera och förbättra.
   

  

**Vad erbjuder vi dig?**
 En nyckelroll i vår AI- och automationsresa och möjlighet att forma förvaltningen av Power Platform och Copilot, arbeta med modern teknik och utvecklas. Du samarbetar med engagerade kollegor och kan påverka både ditt eget arbete och organisationens framtid.
   

  

 Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Lena Thorén, lena.thoren@swedavia.se
   

  

**Sista ansökningsdag är den 26 augusti, urval sker löpande och annonsen kan stängas tidigare så tveka inte att söka redan idag!**
**Hur är det att arbeta på Swedavia?**
 Vårt fokus är att möjliggöra hållbart resande och uppmuntra nytänkande för att skapa en välkomnande, trygg och inkluderande arbetsgemenskap där du kan växa och göra verklig skillnad – läs mer här! Jobba hos oss | Om Swedavia
   

  

 För en objektiv och rättvis rekrytering använder vi arbetspsykologiska tester som en del av urvalsprocessen.
   

  

 Då flygplatser är säkerhetskänslig verksamhet genomgår samtliga kandidater som går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen en bakgrundskontroll. Innan anställning sker även en säkerhetsprövning i enlighet med Transportstyrelsens regler om luftfartsskydd samt Säkerhetsskyddslagen. Swedavia är även en drogfri arbetsplats med nolltolerans mot droger. Drogtester genomförs före anställning och sker slumpmässigt under anställningen.

title: Salesforce Architect
description:
Capgemini är sedan 2007 strategisk partner till Salesforce och ledande i Europa inom strategi, design och implementation av innovativa lösningar. Vi fokuserar på branschspecifika Industry Clouds som Communication, Revenue, Education och Energy & Utilities, samt avancerade tjänster inom Agentforce och Data 360. Som ledande aktör inom agentisk AI skapar vi lösningar med Agentforce som optimerar affärsvärde och effektiviserar processer. Vi är en av Nordens största aktörer inom Salesforce och arbetar med spännande uppdrag tillsammans med våra kunder.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Vi söker en erfaren Salesforce-arkitekt till vårt team på Kungsholmen i centrala Stockholm.I denna nyckelroll kommer du att vara en drivande kraft i att designa, utveckla och implementera hållbara och skalbara Salesforce-lösningar för våra kunder. Du arbetar nära både kunder och interna team i en agil miljö, där du fungerar som teknisk expert och rådgivare inom Salesforce-plattformen.
   

  

*I denna roll kommer du att få:*
* Säkerställa att våra Salesforce-lösningar uppfyller både affärsbehov och tekniska krav.
* Spela en nyckelroll i kunders digitala transformationsresor och framtidens CRM-lösningar.
* Bidra med teknisk expertis i design och utveckling av skalbara lösningar.
* Delta aktivt i vår interna Salesforce Guild, där vi tillsammans utvecklar kompetens, delar erfarenheter och driver innovation inom plattformen.


**Din profil**
* 5+ års erfarenhet som Salesforce-utvecklare med både anpassad utveckling och konfigurering av Salesforce i ett eller flera projekt.
* Erfarenhet av Apex, LWC, JavaScript och Salesforce-integrationsmönster (REST/SOAP API, MuleSoft m.fl.).
* Djupgående kunskap om Salesforce-plattformen (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud m.fl.) inklusive datamodellering och säkerhetsarkitektur.
* Erfarenhet av IAM, Release Lifecycle samt att agera rådgivare gentemot kunder och andra intressenter.
* Certifiering som Salesforce Application Architect och/eller System Architect.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.


*Meriterande*
* Erfarenhet av Industry Clouds.


**Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas**
* Möjlighet till utbildning och certifiering för dig som vill ligga i framkant.
* Generöst friskvårdsbidrag, sjukvårdsförsäkring & tjänstepension.
* Flexibla arbetsförhållanden & Work-from-Home Policy.
* Tech communities.


**Ansökan**
 Tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan. Vi kommer att intervjua löpande och ser fram emot att hitta vår nästa kollega. Varmt välkomna med din ansökan!
   

  

*Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.*
**Om Capgemini**
 Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,1 miljarder euro för 2024.
   

  

**Make it real**

title: Team Manager – Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
description:
Som Team Manager för ERP leder du ett DevOps-team som har nordiskt ansvar för både utveckling och drift av affärskritiska system. Du kliver in i en roll där du får ett helhetsansvar för ett erfaret team och där ni tillsammans med andra, driver utveckling, stabilitet och affärsvärde i en komplex och central del av vår svenska och danska IT-miljö.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 I rollen som Team Manager inom Enterprise Solutions får du ett brett ansvar där teknik, affärsnytta och ledarskap möts. Du leder ett team på cirka 12 personer, inklusive konsulter, med ansvar för utveckling, drift och förvaltning av produktområdet ERP.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära arkitekter, plattformsteam, produktägare och slutanvändare för att säkerställa att lösningarna stödjer både affärsbehov och tekniska mål. En viktig del av rollen är att bidra till harmonisering av systemlandskap och processer i en nordisk kontext där finans-, logistik-, samt HR-organisationer i både Sverige och Danmark ska fungera tillsammans.
   

  

 Du ansvarar för teamets roadmap, kapacitetsplanering och prioriteringar, samt säkerställer en stabil och säker drift genom ett aktivt arbete med livscykelhantering, incidenthantering och regelefterlevnad. Rollen innefattar även att driva och vidareutveckla teamets arbetssätt genom att ta DevOps-arbetet till nästa nivå. En central del av uppdraget är att driva automatisering av flöden, där AI är ett naturligt verktyg för att effektivisera och förbättra kvaliteten för både ditt och affärsområdenas team.
   

  

**I din roll som ledare**
 Som ledare på Tre är du tydlig och framåtriktad samtidigt som du är närvarande och coachande i vardagen. Du skapar förutsättningar för teamet att ta ett gemensamt ansvar för hela leveransen – från analys, utveckling, till produktion och vidare drift.
   

  

 Du driver aktivt en kultur präglad av samarbete, ansvarstagande och kontinuerligt lärande. I rollen ingår du i ledningsgruppen för Enterprise Solutions, där ni tillsammans driver den övergripande utvecklingen av området. Du verkar i en miljö under förändring som ställer höga krav på ett tryggt, tydligt och engagerande ledarskap.
   

  

**Du kan se fram emot att**
* leda ett team med bred kompetens och stort ansvar i en affärskritisk del av verksamheten
* tillsammans med andra teknikledare driva utvecklingen mot en mer mogen DevOps-organisation med fokus på kontinuerliga förbättringar, automatisering och AI-katalysator
* vara en del av att leverera kritisk infrastruktur och bidra direkt till samhällsnyttan
* ta dig an en roll som både utvecklar och utmanar dig i ditt ledarskap
* vara en del av en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place To Work, samt arbeta i en organisation som är stolt samarbetspartner till Women in Tech och Tjejer Kodar


 ,
   

  

**Lite mer om dig**
 Ditt ledarskap präglas av ett coachande och situationsanpassat förhållningssätt. Du är trygg i att leda andra, bygger tillit genom tydlighet och närvaro och drivs av att utveckla både individer och team. Du är nyfiken och trivs i förändring, där du aktivt itererar arbetssätt för att nå i mål tillsammans med andra.
   

  

 Du har en stark teknisk förståelse och erfarenhet av att arbeta i komplexa IT-miljöer där många system samverkar. Du är van vid DevOps, systemutvecklingens livscykel och agila arbetssätt, och har själv en operativ bakgrund inom en teknikorganisation. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med Oracle ERP.
   

  

 Vi ser att du har flera års erfarenhet av att leda teknisk leverans, där du tagit ansvar för prioritering, planering och genomförande. Du har mångårig erfarenhet av informellt ledarskap och det är meriterande om du haft personalansvar.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara stark i stakeholder management och trivas i en kontext där du balanserar olika slutanvändarbehov och prioriteringar – både mellan teknik och affär samt marknader. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan**
 Vi tar emot ansökningar via denna annons och kommer hålla intervjuer löpande. Personligt brev behövs inte, men vi vill gärna att du svarar på några frågor vi ställer i samband med att du söker. Vi använder tester för att säkra objektiva bedömningar i samband med urval. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Bakgrundskontroll genomförs på slutkandidat.
   

  

 Om du har frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterande chef Frida Brodén (frida.broden@tre.se).

 Xenit is a growth company which specializes in Cloud and Modern Work. Our committed employees inspire, challenge and encourage each other, while providing extensive value for our customers. Xenit is

title: Teamcenter Easy Plan Specialist
description:
*Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar.*
**Your Role**
 We are part of a large-scale digital transformation programme aimed at digitalising and streamlining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) across our engineering and manufacturing organisation. The programme spans multiple business units and involves deep integration between PLM and ERP systems.
   

  

 We are seeking a specialist with real, hands-on expertise in Siemens Teamcenter Easy Plan. This is a focused and high-impact role where Easy Plan knowledge is the core requirement. We are open to candidates with varying levels of experience; what matters most is hands-on expertise in Teamcenter Easy Plan and the ability to contribute from day one.
   

  

 Beyond the project, you will play an important role in the continued development and application management of our Teamcenter platform, helping ensure a stable, scalable and sustainable PLM environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Configure, maintain and develop Teamcenter Easy Plan solutions.
* Define and manage manufacturing process structures (MBOM, operations, resources).
* Work closely with manufacturing engineers and PLM administrators to align Easy Plan workflows with production requirements.
* Support integration points between Easy Plan and downstream systems such as ERP and MES.
* Drive user adoption through training and hands-on support.
* Contribute to the ongoing development and application management of the Teamcenter platform.
* Support releases, deployments, platform improvements and technical troubleshooting in collaboration with the wider IT organisation.


**Your profile**
 Required Skills & Experience:
   

  

* Demonstrable hands-on experience with Teamcenter Easy Plan – this is the key requirement.
* Understanding of manufacturing process planning concepts, including operations, work instructions and BOM structures.
* Ability to bridge the gap between engineering, manufacturing and IT.
* Structured and analytical approach to problem-solving.
* Fluent in English; Swedish is an advantage.


 It is an advantage if you have:
   

  

* Experience with Teamcenter Manufacturing Process Planner (MPP) or Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM).
* Experience with ERP integrations.
* Knowledge of SQL and database concepts.
* Experience with system administration, deployments, version management or DevOps practices.
* Background in aerospace, defence or other high-complexity manufacturing environments.


 This role offers the opportunity to influence both the implementation of new capabilities and the long-term evolution of a business-critical Teamcenter environment.
   

  

 This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.
   

  

**What You Will Be a Part Of**
 Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters. Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring mission, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 26,100 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
   

  

 Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations. Read more about us here.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
*Vi tror att framsteg och möjligheter skapas bäst tillsammans. Välkommen till en plats där samarbete gör skillnad.*
 Din roll
   

  

 Vi söker nu en projektledare till att ansvara för planering, genomförande och leverans av mjukvaruprojekt. Fokus ligger på teknisk kvalitet, effektivt samarbete och måluppfyllelse. Vi ser därför gärna att du, som erfaren projektledare, också har en teknisk ådra.
   

  

 De huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifterna är:
   

  

* Leda och samordna teamen
* Säkerställa att tekniska lösningar uppfyller krav på prestanda, säkerhet, skalbarhet och underhållbarhet
* Upprätta och följa projektplaner, budgetar, riskhantering och tidplaner
* Ansvara för kravhantering tillsammans med intressenter
* Koordinera leveranser mellan olika tekniska team
* Rapportera projektstatus
* Fatta beslut i tekniska frågor i samråd med arkitekter och utvecklingsteam


**Din profil**
 Vi söker dig som har god förståelse för mjukvaruutveckling, erfarenhet av systemintegration och gärna en förståelse för arkitekturprinciper och teknisk skuldförvaltning.
   

  

 Som person är du analytisk och strukturerad, med en stark resultat- och lösningsorientering. Du är ivrig att, genom gott samarbete, ta ansvar för att leda projekt som syftar till att säkerställa människors och samhällens säkerhet.
   

  

 Du har tidigare erfarenhet av att leda tekniska utvecklingsprojekt och därmed kunskaper om olika projektmetoder och verktyg som Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps eller motsvarande. Du har också god vana av att skapa och följa upp projektplaner, budget och resurser.
   

  

 För att lyckas, och trivas, i denna roll krävs ett tydligt ledarskap och god förmåga att motivera team. Förutom tydlighet, är du transparent i din kommunikation med både tekniska och icke-tekniska intressenter. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift.
   

  

 Du är utbildad Civilingenjör, högskoleingenjör eller motsvarande utbildning inom datateknik, systemvetenskap eller relaterat område. En examen är inte ett krav om du har motsvarande erfarenhet från yrkeslivet.
   

  

 Erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin, eller arbete med regulatoriska krav, ses som meriterande.
   

  

*Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.*
 Vad du blir en del av
